```{r}
)

all_numeric_vars <- c(production_vars, quality_vars, temporal_vars, physical_vars, historical_vars)

# Enhanced data preparation function
prepare_correlation_data <- function(data, variables, min_observations = 15, min_pairs = 10) {
  
  cat("Preparing correlation data...\n")
  
  # Select and convert variables
  correlation_data <- data %>%
    select(any_of(variables)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), ~as.numeric(as.character(.)))) %>%
    # Remove columns with too few observations
    select(where(~sum(!is.na(.)) >= min_observations)) %>%
    # Remove rows with too many missing values (keep if at least 30% of variables are present)
    filter(rowSums(!is.na(.)) >= max(3, ceiling(0.3 * ncol(.))))
  
  cat(sprintf("Selected %d variables with %d observations\n", ncol(correlation_data), nrow(correlation_data)))
  
  # Check for sufficient pairs for each variable combination
  valid_pairs <- matrix(FALSE, ncol(correlation_data), ncol(correlation_data))
  colnames(valid_pairs) <- names(correlation_data)
  rownames(valid_pairs) <- names(correlation_data)
  
  for (i in 1:ncol(correlation_data)) {
    for (j in 1:ncol(correlation_data)) {
      complete_pairs <- sum(!is.na(correlation_data[,i]) & !is.na(correlation_data[,j]))
      valid_pairs[i,j] <- complete_pairs >= min_pairs
    }
  }
  
  # Remove variables with too few valid pairs
  vars_to_keep <- rowSums(valid_pairs) >= max(3, ceiling(0.3 * ncol(correlation_data)))
  correlation_data <- correlation_data[, vars_to_keep, drop = FALSE]
  
  cat(sprintf("Final dataset: %d variables, %d observations\n", ncol(correlation_data), nrow(correlation_data)))
  
  return(correlation_data)
}

# Safe correlation calculation function
calculate_safe_correlation <- function(data, method = "pearson") {
  
  tryCatch({
    # Try Hmisc rcorr first (more robust)
    cat("Calculating correlations using Hmisc::rcorr...\n")
    cor_result <- rcorr(as.matrix(data), type = method)
    
    cor_matrix <- cor_result$r
    p_matrix <- cor_result$P
    n_matrix <- cor_result$n
    
    # Clean matrices
    cor_matrix[is.na(cor_matrix)] <- 0
    cor_matrix[is.infinite(cor_matrix)] <- 0
    diag(cor_matrix) <- 1
    
    # Remove correlations based on too few observations
    insufficient_n <- n_matrix < 10
    cor_matrix[insufficient_n] <- NA
    if (!is.null(p_matrix)) p_matrix[insufficient_n] <- NA
    
    return(list(correlation = cor_matrix, p_values = p_matrix, n_obs = n_matrix, method = "rcorr"))
    
  }, error = function(e1) {
    cat("Hmisc failed, trying base R correlation...\n")
    
    tryCatch({
      cor_matrix <- cor(data, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = method)
      cor_matrix[is.na(cor_matrix)] <- 0
      cor_matrix[is.infinite(cor_matrix)] <- 0
      diag(cor_matrix) <- 1
      
      return(list(correlation = cor_matrix, p_values = NULL, n_obs = NULL, method = "base_r"))
      
    }, error = function(e2) {
      cat("Base R correlation failed, using simple approach...\n")
      
      # Manual correlation calculation for problematic cases
      n_vars <- ncol(data)
      cor_matrix <- matrix(0, n_vars, n_vars)
      colnames(cor_matrix) <- names(data)
      rownames(cor_matrix) <- names(data)
      diag(cor_matrix) <- 1
      
      for (i in 1:(n_vars-1)) {
        for (j in (i+1):n_vars) {
          valid_data <- complete.cases(data[,c(i,j)])
          if (sum(valid_data) >= 10) {
            cor_val <- cor(data[valid_data, i], data[valid_data, j], method = method)
            if (!is.na(cor_val) && is.finite(cor_val)) {
              cor_matrix[i,j] <- cor_val
              cor_matrix[j,i] <- cor_val
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      return(list(correlation = cor_matrix, p_values = NULL, n_obs = NULL, method = "manual"))
    })
  })
}

# Enhanced plotting function
create_correlation_plots <- function(cor_result, data, output_dir = "Sugarcane_Analysis_Publication") {
  
  # Create output directory
  if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) {
    dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)
  }
  
  cor_matrix <- cor_result$correlation
  p_matrix <- cor_result$p_values
  n_vars <- ncol(cor_matrix)
  
  # Clean correlation matrix for plotting
  clean_cor_matrix <- cor_matrix
  
  # Replace any remaining NA/NaN/Inf values
  clean_cor_matrix[is.na(clean_cor_matrix)] <- 0
  clean_cor_matrix[is.infinite(clean_cor_matrix)] <- 0
  clean_cor_matrix[is.nan(clean_cor_matrix)] <- 0
  
  # Ensure diagonal is 1
  diag(clean_cor_matrix) <- 1
  
  # Ensure matrix is symmetric
  clean_cor_matrix[lower.tri(clean_cor_matrix)] <- t(clean_cor_matrix)[lower.tri(clean_cor_matrix)]
  
  # Check if clustering is possible
  can_cluster <- TRUE
  tryCatch({
    # Test clustering
    dist_matrix <- as.dist(1 - abs(clean_cor_matrix))
    if (any(is.na(dist_matrix)) || any(is.infinite(dist_matrix))) {
      can_cluster <- FALSE
    } else {
      test_hclust <- hclust(dist_matrix, method = "complete")
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    can_cluster <<- FALSE
    cat("Clustering failed, will use original order\n")
  })
  
  # 1. Main correlation plot
  cat("Creating main correlation plot...\n")
  
  png(file.path(output_dir, "13_Comprehensive_Correlation_Matrix.png"), 
      width = 12, height = 10, units = "in", res = 300, bg = "white")
  
  par(mar = c(2, 2, 4, 2))
  
  # Enhanced color palette
  corr_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#053061", "#2166AC", "#4393C3", "#92C5DE", 
                                   "#D1E5F0", "#FFFFFF", 
                                   "#FDDBC7", "#F4A582", "#D6604D", "#B2182B", "#67001F"))(200)
  
  # Use clustering only if possible, otherwise use original order
  plot_order <- if (can_cluster) "hclust" else "original"
  
  corrplot(clean_cor_matrix,
           method = "color",
           type = "upper",
           order = plot_order,
           col = corr_colors,
           tl.col = "#000000",
           tl.srt = 45,
           tl.cex = 0.7,
           tl.font = 2,
           cl.cex = 1.0,
           title = paste("Sugarcane Variables Correlation Matrix\n", 
                        if (can_cluster) "(Hierarchically Clustered)" else "(Original Order)"),
           mar = c(0,0,3,0),
           diag = FALSE,
           addCoef.col = "#000000",
           number.cex = 0.4,
           number.digits = 2,
           number.font = 1,
           outline = TRUE,
           cl.ratio = 0.15,
           addgrid.col = "#CCCCCC")
  
  dev.off()
  
  # 2. Significance overlay plot (if p-values available)
  if (!is.null(p_matrix)) {
    cat("Creating significance plot...\n")
    
    # Clean p-values matrix
    clean_p_matrix <- p_matrix
    clean_p_matrix[is.na(clean_p_matrix)] <- 1  # Set NA p-values to 1 (non-significant)
    clean_p_matrix[is.infinite(clean_p_matrix)] <- 1
    clean_p_matrix[is.nan(clean_p_matrix)] <- 1
    
    png(file.path(output_dir, "13_Correlation_with_Significance.png"), 
        width = 12, height = 10, units = "in", res = 300, bg = "white")
    
    par(mar = c(2, 2, 4, 2))
    
    tryCatch({
      corrplot(clean_cor_matrix,
               method = "color",
               type = "upper",
               order = plot_order,
               col = corr_colors,
               tl.col = "#000000",
               tl.srt = 45,
               tl.cex = 0.7,
               tl.font = 2,
               cl.cex = 1.0,
               title = "Correlation Matrix with Significance Levels\n(* p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001)",
               mar = c(0,0,4,0),
               diag = FALSE,
               p.mat = clean_p_matrix,
               sig.level = 0.05,
               insig = "label_sig",
               pch.cex = 0.6,
               outline = TRUE,
               cl.ratio = 0.15)
    }, error = function(e) {
      # Fallback: plot without significance if it fails
      corrplot(clean_cor_matrix,
               method = "color",
               type = "upper",
               order = plot_order,
               col = corr_colors,
               tl.col = "#000000",
               tl.srt = 45,
               tl.cex = 0.7,
               tl.font = 2,
               cl.cex = 1.0,
               title = "Correlation Matrix\n(Significance overlay failed)",
               mar = c(0,0,3,0),
               diag = FALSE,
               outline = TRUE,
               cl.ratio = 0.15)
    })
    
    dev.off()
  }
  
  # 3. Strong correlations heatmap
  cat("Creating strong correlations plot...\n")
  
  # Extract strong correlations (|r| > 0.5) from clean matrix
  strong_cors <- which(abs(clean_cor_matrix) > 0.5 & abs(clean_cor_matrix) < 1, arr.ind = TRUE)
  
  if (nrow(strong_cors) > 0) {
    strong_cor_data <- data.frame(
      Var1 = rownames(clean_cor_matrix)[strong_cors[,1]],
      Var2 = colnames(clean_cor_matrix)[strong_cors[,2]],
      Correlation = clean_cor_matrix[strong_cors],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    # Remove duplicates and self-correlations
    strong_cor_data <- strong_cor_data[strong_cor_data$Var1 != strong_cor_data$Var2, ]
    
    # For symmetric matrix, keep only upper triangle relationships
    strong_cor_data$pair_id <- apply(strong_cor_data[,1:2], 1, function(x) paste(sort(x), collapse = "_"))
    strong_cor_data <- strong_cor_data[!duplicated(strong_cor_data$pair_id), ]
    strong_cor_data$pair_id <- NULL
    
    if (nrow(strong_cor_data) > 0) {
      strong_cor_data <- strong_cor_data[order(abs(strong_cor_data$Correlation), decreasing = TRUE), ]
      
      # Create bar plot of strong correlations
      tryCatch({
        # Limit to top 20 for readability
        top_cors <- head(strong_cor_data, 20)
        top_cors$Pair <- paste(top_cors$Var1, "-", top_cors$Var2)
        top_cors$Pair <- factor(top_cors$Pair, levels = rev(top_cors$Pair))
        
        p <- ggplot(top_cors, aes(x = Pair, y = Correlation)) +
          geom_col(aes(fill = Correlation > 0), width = 0.7) +
          scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#D6604D", "FALSE" = "#4393C3"),
                           labels = c("Negative", "Positive")) +
          coord_flip() +
          labs(title = "Strongest Variable Correlations (|r| > 0.5)",
               subtitle = paste("Top", min(20, nrow(strong_cor_data)), "correlations by absolute magnitude"),
               x = "Variable Pairs",
               y = "Correlation Coefficient",
               fill = "Direction") +
          theme_minimal() +
          theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
                plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12),
                axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
                legend.position = "bottom") +
          geom_text(aes(label = round(Correlation, 2)), 
                    hjust = ifelse(top_cors$Correlation > 0, -0.1, 1.1),
                    size = 3)
        
        ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "13_Strong_Correlations.png"), plot = p, 
               width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
        
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("Strong correlations plot failed, creating alternative...\n")
        
        # Simple alternative plot
        png(file.path(output_dir, "13_Strong_Correlations.png"), 
            width = 12, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300, bg = "white")
        
        top_cors <- head(strong_cor_data, 15)
        par(mar = c(5, 12, 4, 2))
        
        colors <- ifelse(top_cors$Correlation > 0, "#D6604D", "#4393C3")
        barplot(top_cors$Correlation, 
                names.arg = paste(top_cors$Var1, "-", top_cors$Var2),
                horiz = TRUE, 
                col = colors,
                main = "Strongest Variable Correlations (|r| > 0.5)",
                xlab = "Correlation Coefficient",
                las = 1,
                cex.names = 0.8)
        
        dev.off()
      })
    } else {
      cat("No strong correlations found (|r| > 0.5)\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("No strong correlations found (|r| > 0.5)\n")
  }
  
  # 4. Summary statistics
  cat("Creating correlation summary...\n")
  
  # Calculate summary statistics using clean matrix
  cor_values <- clean_cor_matrix[upper.tri(clean_cor_matrix)]
  cor_values <- cor_values[!is.na(cor_values) & cor_values != 0 & is.finite(cor_values)]
  
  if (length(cor_values) > 0) {
    summary_stats <- data.frame(
      Statistic = c("Total Correlations", "Mean |r|", "Median |r|", "Max |r|", "Min |r|",
                    "Strong (|r| > 0.7)", "Moderate (0.3 < |r| ≤ 0.7)", "Weak (|r| ≤ 0.3)"),
      Value = c(
        length(cor_values),
        round(mean(abs(cor_values)), 3),
        round(median(abs(cor_values)), 3),
        round(max(abs(cor_values)), 3),
        round(min(abs(cor_values)), 3),
        sum(abs(cor_values) > 0.7),
        sum(abs(cor_values) > 0.3 & abs(cor_values) <= 0.7),
        sum(abs(cor_values) <= 0.3)
      )
    )
  } else {
    summary_stats <- data.frame(
      Statistic = c("Status"),
      Value = c("No valid correlations found")
    )
  }
  
  # Save summary
  write.csv(summary_stats, file.path(output_dir, "13_Correlation_Summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
  return(summary_stats)
}

# Main execution
cat("Starting enhanced correlation analysis...\n")

# Check if sugarcane_data exists
if (!exists("sugarcane_data")) {
  stop("sugarcane_data not found. Please load your dataset first.")
}

# Prepare data
correlation_data <- prepare_correlation_data(sugarcane_data, all_numeric_vars)

# Check if we have enough data
if (ncol(correlation_data) < 3) {
  stop("Insufficient variables for correlation analysis")
}

if (nrow(correlation_data) < 10) {
  stop("Insufficient observations for correlation analysis")
}

# Calculate correlations
cor_result <- calculate_safe_correlation(correlation_data)

cat(sprintf("Correlation calculation completed using %s method\n", cor_result$method))

# Create plots and summaries
summary_stats <- create_correlation_plots(cor_result, correlation_data)

# Display summary
cat("\n=== CORRELATION ANALYSIS SUMMARY ===\n")
print(summary_stats)

# Additional insights
cat("\n=== KEY INSIGHTS ===\n")
cor_matrix <- cor_result$correlation

# Clean the matrix for analysis
clean_analysis_matrix <- cor_matrix
clean_analysis_matrix[is.na(clean_analysis_matrix)] <- 0
clean_analysis_matrix[is.infinite(clean_analysis_matrix)] <- 0
clean_analysis_matrix[is.nan(clean_analysis_matrix)] <- 0

# Find most correlated pairs
if (!is.null(clean_analysis_matrix) && nrow(clean_analysis_matrix) > 1) {
  upper_tri <- upper.tri(clean_analysis_matrix)
  cor_pairs <- which(upper_tri, arr.ind = TRUE)
  
  if (length(cor_pairs) > 0) {
    cor_df <- data.frame(
      Var1 = rownames(clean_analysis_matrix)[cor_pairs[,1]],
      Var2 = colnames(clean_analysis_matrix)[cor_pairs[,2]],
      Correlation = clean_analysis_matrix[cor_pairs]
    )
    
    # Filter valid correlations
    cor_df <- cor_df[!is.na(cor_df$Correlation) & 
                     cor_df$Correlation != 0 & 
                     is.finite(cor_df$Correlation), ]
    
    if (nrow(cor_df) > 0) {
      # Top positive correlations
      positive_cors <- cor_df[cor_df$Correlation > 0, ]
      if (nrow(positive_cors) > 0) {
        top_positive <- positive_cors[order(positive_cors$Correlation, decreasing = TRUE), ][1:min(5, nrow(positive_cors)), ]
        cat("Top positive correlations:\n")
        for (i in 1:nrow(top_positive)) {
          cat(sprintf("  %s ↔ %s: r = %.3f\n", 
                     top_positive$Var1[i], top_positive$Var2[i], top_positive$Correlation[i]))
        }
      }
      
      # Top negative correlations
      negative_cors <- cor_df[cor_df$Correlation < 0, ]
      if (nrow(negative_cors) > 0) {
        top_negative <- negative_cors[order(negative_cors$Correlation, decreasing = FALSE), ][1:min(5, nrow(negative_cors)), ]
        cat("\nTop negative correlations:\n")
        for (i in 1:nrow(top_negative)) {
          cat(sprintf("  %s ↔ %s: r = %.3f\n", 
                     top_negative$Var1[i], top_negative$Var2[i], top_negative$Correlation[i]))
        }
      }
      
      if (nrow(positive_cors) == 0 && nrow(negative_cors) == 0) {
        cat("No significant correlations found.\n")
      }
    } else {
      cat("No valid correlation pairs found after cleaning.\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("No correlation pairs could be calculated.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Correlation matrix insufficient for analysis.\n")
}

cat("\n=== ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
cat("Output files saved to: Sugarcane_Analysis_Publication/\n")
cat("- 13_Comprehensive_Correlation_Matrix.png\n")
cat("- 13_Correlation_with_Significance.png (if p-values available)\n") 
cat("- 13_Strong_Correlations.png\n")
cat("- 13_Correlation_Summary.csv\n")
```

# II. Multivariate Data Analysis - PCA

```{r}
# Multivariate Data Analysis
# Load required libraries
library(explor)
library(FactoMineR)
library(factoextra)
library(corrplot)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(RColorBrewer)

cat("================================================================\n")
cat("MULTIVARIATE DATA ANALYSIS - SUGARCANE DATASET\n")
cat("================================================================\n")

# Prepare the data for multivariate analysis
cat("Preparing sugarcane data for multivariate analysis...\n")

# First, let's examine the data structure
cat("Examining sugarcane_data structure...\n")
cat("• Total rows in sugarcane_data:", nrow(sugarcane_data), "\n")
cat("• Total columns:", ncol(sugarcane_data), "\n")
cat("• Column names:", paste(names(sugarcane_data)[1:min(10, ncol(sugarcane_data))], collapse = ", "), "...\n\n")

# Define variable categories for sugarcane analysis
# Production variables
production_vars <- c(
  "tc_per_ha_estimated", "tc_estimated", "tc_actual", "tc_actual_per_week",
  "tc_per_ha_actual", "tc_per_ha_per_week", "tc_52_weeks", "tc_per_ha_52_weeks",
  "tons_per_harvest", "tons_per_week_actual", "tons_per_ha", "tons_per_ha_per_week",
  "tons_52_weeks", "tons_per_ha_52_weeks", "potential_yield", "potential_tc"
)

# Quality variables
quality_vars <- c(
  "brix_percent", "pol_juice_percent", "purity_percent", "fiber_percent",
  "pol_cane_percent", "percent_cane_percent", "glucose_cane_percent",
  "hugot_sugar", "purity_tc_percent", "fiber_content_percent",
  "juice_tons", "tmss", "tpj", "tpc", "ts", "tsr"
)

# Temporal/Age variables
temporal_vars <- c(
  "age_years_surface", "age_weeks", "age_weeks_surface",
  "drying_duration_expected_days", "drying_duration_actual_days",
  "drying_duration_difference_days", "maturant_action_duration_days"
)

# Physical/Environmental variables
physical_vars <- c(
  "surface_area_ha", "evaporation_balance", "flowering_inhibition_flag"
)

# Historical/Comparative variables
historical_vars <- c(
  "tc_per_ha_n1", "surface_area_n1", "tonnage_n1",
  "tc_per_ha_52_weeks_n1", "tonnage_n1_52_weeks", 
  "difference_tc_per_ha_52_surface", "difference_tc_per_ha_52_weeks"
)

# Combine all numeric variables
all_numeric_vars <- c(production_vars, quality_vars, temporal_vars, physical_vars, historical_vars)

# Get variables that exist in the dataset
existing_vars <- intersect(all_numeric_vars, names(sugarcane_data))

cat("Identified sugarcane variables by category:\n")
cat("• Production variables:", sum(production_vars %in% names(sugarcane_data)), "/", length(production_vars), "\n")
cat("• Quality variables:", sum(quality_vars %in% names(sugarcane_data)), "/", length(quality_vars), "\n")
cat("• Temporal variables:", sum(temporal_vars %in% names(sugarcane_data)), "/", length(temporal_vars), "\n")
cat("• Physical variables:", sum(physical_vars %in% names(sugarcane_data)), "/", length(physical_vars), "\n")
cat("• Historical variables:", sum(historical_vars %in% names(sugarcane_data)), "/", length(historical_vars), "\n")
cat("• Total variables for analysis:", length(existing_vars), "\n\n")

if(length(existing_vars) == 0) {
  cat("ERROR: No matching numeric variables found!\n")
  cat("Available numeric columns:\n")
  numeric_cols <- sapply(sugarcane_data, is.numeric)
  print(names(sugarcane_data)[numeric_cols])
  stop("Please check your variable names")
}

cat("Variables for PCA:\n")
for(i in 1:length(existing_vars)) {
  cat("  ", i, ". ", existing_vars[i], "\n")
}

# Convert all numeric variables to proper numeric format
for(var in existing_vars) {
  sugarcane_data[[var]] <- as.numeric(as.character(sugarcane_data[[var]]))
}

# Check for missing values in each variable
missing_summary <- sugarcane_data %>%
  select(all_of(existing_vars)) %>%
  summarise_all(~sum(is.na(.))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "missing_count") %>%
  mutate(missing_percent = round(missing_count / nrow(sugarcane_data) * 100, 2)) %>%
  arrange(desc(missing_count))

cat("\nMissing values summary:\n")
print(missing_summary)

# Remove variables with too many missing values (>70% for agricultural data)
vars_to_keep <- missing_summary %>%
  filter(missing_percent <= 70) %>%
  pull(variable)

cat("\nKeeping", length(vars_to_keep), "variables with ≤70% missing values\n")

# Variables removed due to high missingness
vars_removed <- missing_summary %>%
  filter(missing_percent > 70) %>%
  pull(variable)

if(length(vars_removed) > 0) {
  cat("Variables removed due to >70% missing:\n")
  for(var in vars_removed) {
    cat("  •", var, "(", missing_summary$missing_percent[missing_summary$variable == var], "% missing)\n")
  }
}

# Identify potential categorical/grouping variables
categorical_vars <- c(
  "farm",
  "campaign",
  "block",
  "variety",
  "harvest",
  "irrigation_type",
  "class",
  "tillage_flag"
)



existing_categorical <- intersect(categorical_vars, names(sugarcane_data))

# Also check for any factor columns
factor_cols <- names(sugarcane_data)[sapply(sugarcane_data, is.factor)]
existing_categorical <- unique(c(existing_categorical, factor_cols))

# Create analysis dataset
analysis_data <- sugarcane_data %>%
  select(all_of(vars_to_keep), any_of(existing_categorical))

# Remove rows with too many missing values (>50% of numeric variables for agricultural data)
numeric_data_for_filtering <- analysis_data %>% select(all_of(vars_to_keep))
rows_to_keep <- rowSums(is.na(numeric_data_for_filtering)) <= length(vars_to_keep) * 0.5

analysis_data <- analysis_data[rows_to_keep, ]

cat("\nAfter filtering:\n")
cat("• Numeric variables:", length(vars_to_keep), "\n")
cat("• Categorical variables:", length(existing_categorical), "\n")
cat("• Observations:", nrow(analysis_data), "\n\n")

if(nrow(analysis_data) == 0) {
  stop("ERROR: No observations left after filtering!")
}

if(length(vars_to_keep) < 3) {
  stop("ERROR: Need at least 3 variables for meaningful PCA!")
}

# Extract numeric data for PCA and handle remaining missing values
pca_data <- analysis_data %>%
  select(all_of(vars_to_keep))

# Replace remaining missing values with column medians (robust for agricultural data)
pca_data <- pca_data %>%
  mutate_all(~ifelse(is.na(.), median(., na.rm = TRUE), .))

# Check for and remove variables with zero variance or other issues
var_check <- apply(pca_data, 2, function(x) {
  if(all(is.na(x)) || all(is.infinite(x))) {
    return(NA)
  } else {
    return(var(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  }
})

# Identify problematic columns
zero_var_cols <- names(var_check)[var_check == 0 | is.na(var_check) | is.infinite(var_check)]

if(length(zero_var_cols) > 0) {
  cat("Removing", length(zero_var_cols), "variables with zero/NA/infinite variance:\n")
  cat(paste(zero_var_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
  pca_data <- pca_data %>% select(-all_of(zero_var_cols))
  vars_to_keep <- setdiff(vars_to_keep, zero_var_cols)
} else {
  cat("All variables have valid variance.\n\n")
}

# Remove any remaining infinite or extreme values
pca_data <- pca_data %>%
  mutate_all(~ifelse(is.infinite(.), median(., na.rm = TRUE), .)) %>%
  mutate_all(~ifelse(abs(.) > 1e6, median(., na.rm = TRUE), .))

# Scale the data (essential for PCA when variables have different units)
pca_data_scaled <- scale(pca_data)

# Add meaningful rownames
rownames(pca_data_scaled) <- paste0("Sugarcane_Plot_", 1:nrow(pca_data_scaled))

# Update final variables
numeric_vars_final <- vars_to_keep

cat("Final dataset for PCA:\n")
cat("• Variables:", ncol(pca_data_scaled), "\n")
cat("• Observations:", nrow(pca_data_scaled), "\n")
cat("• Final variables:", paste(numeric_vars_final[1:min(10, length(numeric_vars_final))], collapse = ", "), 
    if(length(numeric_vars_final) > 10) "..." else "", "\n\n")

# Create output directory
if(!dir.exists("Enhanced_Sugarcane_PCA_Analysis")) {
  dir.create("Enhanced_Sugarcane_PCA_Analysis", recursive = TRUE)
}

cat("================================================================\n")
cat("1. PRINCIPAL COMPONENT ANALYSIS (PCA)\n")
cat("================================================================\n")

# Perform PCA using FactoMineR
# Include supplementary categorical variables if available
if(length(existing_categorical) > 0) {
  # Prepare supplementary qualitative variables
  sup_data <- analysis_data %>% 
    select(all_of(existing_categorical))
  
  # Handle NA values in supplementary variables PROPERLY
  for(col in names(sup_data)) {
    # Convert to character first to avoid factor level issues
    sup_data[[col]] <- as.character(sup_data[[col]])
    # Replace NAs with "Unknown"
    sup_data[[col]][is.na(sup_data[[col]]) | sup_data[[col]] == ""] <- "Unknown"
    # Now convert to factor (this includes "Unknown" as a valid level)
    sup_data[[col]] <- as.factor(sup_data[[col]])
  }
  
  # Find columns in supplementary data
  sup_quali <- which(names(cbind(pca_data_scaled, sup_data)) %in% existing_categorical)
  
  cat("Including supplementary categorical variables:", paste(existing_categorical, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  pca_result <- PCA(
    cbind(pca_data_scaled, sup_data), 
    scale.unit = FALSE,  # Already scaled
    quali.sup = sup_quali,  # Supplementary qualitative variables
    graph = FALSE,       # Don't show default plots
    ncp = min(10, ncol(pca_data_scaled))  # Max 10 components
  )
} else {
  cat("No supplementary categorical variables found\n")
  pca_result <- PCA(pca_data_scaled, 
                    scale.unit = FALSE,
                    graph = FALSE,
                    ncp = min(10, ncol(pca_data_scaled)))
}

cat("================================================================\n")
cat("2. INTERACTIVE PCA EXPLORATION\n")
cat("================================================================\n")

explor(pca_result)

cat("================================================================\n")
cat("3. CORRELATION ANALYSIS\n")
cat("================================================================\n")

# Create correlation matrix with safe handling
tryCatch({
  cor_matrix <- cor(pca_data, use = "complete.obs")
  
  # Clean correlation matrix
  cor_matrix[is.na(cor_matrix)] <- 0
  cor_matrix[is.infinite(cor_matrix)] <- 0
  diag(cor_matrix) <- 1
  
  # Enhanced correlation plot
  png("Enhanced_Sugarcane_PCA_Analysis/sugarcane_correlation_matrix.png", 
      width = 16, height = 14, units = "in", res = 300, bg = "white")
  
  par(mar = c(2, 2, 4, 2))
  
  # Check if clustering is possible
  can_cluster <- TRUE
  tryCatch({
    dist_matrix <- as.dist(1 - abs(cor_matrix))
    if (any(is.na(dist_matrix)) || any(is.infinite(dist_matrix))) {
      can_cluster <- FALSE
    } else {
      test_hclust <- hclust(dist_matrix, method = "complete")
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    can_cluster <<- FALSE
  })
  
  corrplot(cor_matrix, 
           method = "color",
           type = "upper",
           order = if(can_cluster) "hclust" else "original",
           tl.col = "#000000",
           tl.srt = 45,
           tl.cex = 0.7,
           tl.font = 2,
           cl.cex = 1.0,
           col = colorRampPalette(c("#053061", "#2166AC", "#4393C3", "#92C5DE", 
                                   "#D1E5F0", "#F7F7F7", 
                                   "#FDDBC7", "#F4A582", "#D6604D", "#B2182B", "#67001F"))(100),
           title = paste("Sugarcane Dataset - Correlation Matrix\n", 
                        if(can_cluster) "(Hierarchically Clustered)" else "(Original Order)"),
           mar = c(0,0,3,0),
           diag = FALSE,
           addCoef.col = "#000000",
           number.cex = 0.4,
           number.digits = 2,
           outline = TRUE)
  
  dev.off()
  
  cat("Correlation matrix saved as sugarcane_correlation_matrix.png\n\n")
  
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Error creating correlation matrix:", e$message, "\n")
  cat("Proceeding with PCA analysis...\n\n")
})

cat("================================================================\n")
cat("4. PCA SUMMARY STATISTICS\n")
cat("================================================================\n")

# Print PCA summary
cat("Eigenvalues and variance explained:\n")
eigen_summary <- round(pca_result$eig, 3)
print(eigen_summary)

# Calculate how many components explain 80% of variance
cum_var <- pca_result$eig[,3]
components_80 <- which(cum_var >= 80)[1]
if(is.na(components_80)) components_80 <- nrow(pca_result$eig)
cat("\nComponents needed to explain 80% variance:", components_80, "\n")

cat("\nVariables with highest contributions to PC1 (Primary Production Factor):\n")
contrib_pc1 <- sort(pca_result$var$contrib[,1], decreasing = TRUE)[1:min(10, nrow(pca_result$var$contrib))]
print(round(contrib_pc1, 2))

if(ncol(pca_result$var$contrib) >= 2) {
  cat("\nVariables with highest contributions to PC2 (Secondary Factor):\n")
  contrib_pc2 <- sort(pca_result$var$contrib[,2], decreasing = TRUE)[1:min(10, nrow(pca_result$var$contrib))]
  print(round(contrib_pc2, 2))
}

cat("\nVariables with highest quality of representation (Cos2) on PC1-PC2:\n")
if(ncol(pca_result$var$cos2) >= 2) {
  cos2_pc12 <- pca_result$var$cos2[,1] + pca_result$var$cos2[,2]
} else {
  cos2_pc12 <- pca_result$var$cos2[,1]
}
best_represented <- sort(cos2_pc12, decreasing = TRUE)[1:min(10, length(cos2_pc12))]
print(round(best_represented, 3))

cat("================================================================\n")
cat("5. DETAILED PCA VISUALIZATIONS\n")
cat("================================================================\n")

# 1. Enhanced scree plot
scree_plot <- fviz_eig(pca_result, 
                       addlabels = TRUE, 
                       ylim = c(0, max(pca_result$eig[,2]) * 1.1),
                       barfill = "#228B22",
                       barcolor = "#006400",
                       linecolor = "#FF6347") +
  ggtitle("PCA Scree Plot - Sugarcane Dataset") +
  labs(subtitle = paste("First", components_80, "components explain 80% of variance")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12))

ggsave("Enhanced_Sugarcane_PCA_Analysis/sugarcane_pca_scree_plot.png", scree_plot,
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# 2. Enhanced biplot
if(ncol(pca_result$var$coord) >= 2) {
  biplot <- fviz_pca_biplot(pca_result, 
                           repel = TRUE,
                           col.var = "#228B22",
                           col.ind = "#8B4513",
                           alpha.ind = 0.3,
                           alpha.var = 0.8,
                           title = "PCA Biplot - Sugarcane Variables and Plots",
                           subtitle = paste("PC1 (", round(pca_result$eig[1,2], 1), "%) vs PC2 (", 
                                          round(pca_result$eig[2,2], 1), "%)", sep="")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11))
  
  ggsave("Enhanced_Sugarcane_PCA_Analysis/sugarcane_pca_biplot.png", biplot,
         width = 12, height = 9, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
}

# 3. Variables contribution plot
var_plot <- fviz_pca_var(pca_result,
                        col.var = "contrib",
                        gradient.cols = c("#00AFBB", "#E7B800", "#FC4E07"),
                        repel = TRUE,
                        title = "Sugarcane Variables Contribution to PC1-PC2",
                        subtitle = "Color intensity = Contribution level") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11))

ggsave("Enhanced_Sugarcane_PCA_Analysis/sugarcane_pca_variables_plot.png", var_plot,
       width = 12, height = 9, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# 4. Variables quality plot (cos2)
cos2_plot <- fviz_pca_var(pca_result,
                         col.var = "cos2",
                         gradient.cols = c("#BB4444", "#EE9988", "#FFFFFF", "#77AADD", "#4477AA"),
                         repel = TRUE,
                         title = "Sugarcane Variables Quality of Representation (Cos2)",
                         subtitle = "How well variables are represented by PC1-PC2") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11))

ggsave("Enhanced_Sugarcane_PCA_Analysis/sugarcane_pca_variables_cos2_plot.png", cos2_plot,
       width = 12, height = 9, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# 5. Individuals plot colored by contribution
ind_plot <- fviz_pca_ind(pca_result,
                        col.ind = "contrib",
                        gradient.cols = c("#00AFBB", "#E7B800", "#FC4E07"),
                        repel = FALSE,
                        alpha.ind = 0.6,
                        title = "Sugarcane Plots - Colored by Contribution",
                        subtitle = "Each point represents one sugarcane plot/observation") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11))

ggsave("Enhanced_Sugarcane_PCA_Analysis/sugarcane_pca_individuals_plot.png", ind_plot,
       width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

cat("================================================================\n")
cat("6. SUPPLEMENTARY CATEGORICAL ANALYSIS\n")
cat("================================================================\n")

# Analyze supplementary categorical variables if available
if(length(existing_categorical) > 0) {
  for(cat_var in existing_categorical) {
    if(cat_var %in% names(analysis_data)) {
      cat("Analyzing", cat_var, "...\n")
      
      # Create plot colored by categorical variable
      cat_levels <- unique(analysis_data[[cat_var]])
      cat_levels <- cat_levels[!is.na(cat_levels) & cat_levels != "" & cat_levels != "Unknown"]
      
      if(length(cat_levels) > 1 && length(cat_levels) <= 20) {
        # Create color palette
        if(length(cat_levels) <= 8) {
          colors <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(max(3, length(cat_levels)), "Set2")[1:length(cat_levels)]
        } else {
          colors <- rainbow(length(cat_levels))
        }
        
        # Plot individuals colored by categorical variable
        tryCatch({
          sup_plot <- fviz_pca_ind(pca_result,
                                  habillage = cat_var,
                                  palette = colors,
                                  addEllipses = TRUE,
                                  ellipse.level = 0.68,
                                  repel = FALSE,
                                  alpha.ind = 0.7,
                                  title = paste("PCA - Sugarcane Plots colored by", cat_var),
                                  subtitle = paste("Ellipses show 68% confidence intervals")) +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
                  plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
                  legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
          
          filename <- paste0("Enhanced_Sugarcane_PCA_Analysis/sugarcane_pca_by_", 
                            gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", tolower(cat_var)), ".png")
          ggsave(filename, sup_plot, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
          
          cat("  • Saved:", filename, "\n")
        }, error = function(e) {
          cat("  • Could not create plot for", cat_var, ":", e$message, "\n")
        })
      } else {
        cat("  • Skipping", cat_var, "- too many levels (", length(cat_levels), ") or insufficient data\n")
      }
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("No supplementary categorical variables available for grouping analysis.\n")
}

cat("================================================================\n")
cat("7. AGRICULTURAL INTERPRETATION ANALYSIS\n")
cat("================================================================\n")

# Group variables by agricultural/sugarcane science meaning
agricultural_groups <- list(
  # Production Metrics
  Production_Yield = intersect(c("tc_per_ha_estimated", "tc_estimated", "tc_actual", "tc_per_ha_actual",
                                "tons_per_harvest", "tons_per_ha", "potential_yield", "potential_tc"), 
                              numeric_vars_final),
  
  # Quality Parameters
  Sugar_Quality = intersect(c("brix_percent", "pol_juice_percent", "pol_cane_percent", 
                             "purity_percent", "hugot_sugar", "purity_tc_percent"), 
                           numeric_vars_final),
  
  # Physical Properties
  Fiber_Content = intersect(c("fiber_percent", "fiber_content_percent"), numeric_vars_final),
  
  # Temporal Factors
  Age_Maturity = intersect(c("age_years_surface", "age_weeks", "age_weeks_surface"), numeric_vars_final),
  
  # Process Variables
  Processing_Quality = intersect(c("tmss", "tpj", "tpc", "ts", "tsr", "juice_tons"), numeric_vars_final),
  
  # Management Factors
  Drying_Management = intersect(c("drying_duration_expected_days", "drying_duration_actual_days",
                                 "drying_duration_difference_days", "maturant_action_duration_days"), 
                               numeric_vars_final),
  
  # Environmental
  Environmental = intersect(c("evaporation_balance", "flowering_inhibition_flag"), numeric_vars_final),
  
  # Historical Performance
  Historical_Comparison = intersect(c("tc_per_ha_n1", "tonnage_n1", "difference_tc_per_ha_52_weeks"), 
                                   numeric_vars_final),
  
  # Weekly/Temporal Production
  Weekly_Production = intersect(c("tc_actual_per_week", "tc_per_ha_per_week", "tons_per_week_actual",
                                 "tons_per_ha_per_week"), numeric_vars_final),
  
  # 52-Week Projections
  Annual_Projections = intersect(c("tc_52_weeks", "tc_per_ha_52_weeks", "tons_52_weeks", 
                                  "tons_per_ha_52_weeks"), numeric_vars_final)
)

# Remove empty groups and overlapping variables
agricultural_groups <- agricultural_groups[sapply(agricultural_groups, length) > 0]

# Remove variables that appear in multiple groups (keep in first occurrence)
used_vars <- c()
for(group_name in names(agricultural_groups)) {
  agricultural_groups[[group_name]] <- setdiff(agricultural_groups[[group_name]], used_vars)
  used_vars <- c(used_vars, agricultural_groups[[group_name]])
}

# Remove empty groups after deduplication
agricultural_groups <- agricultural_groups[sapply(agricultural_groups, length) > 0]

cat("Agricultural variable groups identified:\n")
for(group_name in names(agricultural_groups)) {
  cat("•", group_name, ":", length(agricultural_groups[[group_name]]), "variables\n")
  if(length(agricultural_groups[[group_name]]) > 0) {
    cat("  Variables:", paste(agricultural_groups[[group_name]], collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
}

# Create contribution analysis by agricultural groups
n_pcs_to_analyze <- min(3, ncol(pca_result$var$contrib))
cat("\nContribution of agricultural groups to first", n_pcs_to_analyze, "PCs:\n")
for(i in 1:n_pcs_to_analyze) {
  cat("\n--- PC", i, "(", round(pca_result$eig[i,2], 1), "% variance) ---\n")
  
  group_contribs <- c()
  for(group_name in names(agricultural_groups)) {
    group_vars <- intersect(agricultural_groups[[group_name]], rownames(pca_result$var$contrib))
    if(length(group_vars) > 0) {
      group_contrib <- sum(pca_result$var$contrib[group_vars, i], na.rm = TRUE)
      group_contribs <- c(group_contribs, group_contrib)
      names(group_contribs)[length(group_contribs)] <- group_name
    }
  }
  
  # Sort by contribution
  group_contribs <- sort(group_contribs, decreasing = TRUE)
  for(j in 1:length(group_contribs)) {
    cat(names(group_contribs)[j], ":", round(group_contribs[j], 2), "%\n")
  }
}

cat("================================================================\n")
cat("8. SAVE COMPREHENSIVE RESULTS\n")
cat("================================================================\n")

# Save all PCA results
save(pca_result, pca_data, pca_data_scaled, 
     agricultural_groups, analysis_data, numeric_vars_final,
     file = "Enhanced_Sugarcane_PCA_Analysis/sugarcane_pca_complete_results.RData")
```

```{r}
theme_pca_sugarcane <- function() {
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(

# Enhanced function to create PCA variable plot showing ALL variables for SUGARCANE data
create_sugarcane_pca_plot <- function(pca_result, axes = c(1, 2), plot_title = "", 
                                     color_type = "contrib") {
  
  # Check if axes exist
  if (max(axes) > max_dims) {
    return(create_placeholder_plot(plot_title, axes))
  }
  
  # Variance explained for axis labels
  var_exp_1 <- round(pca_result$eig[axes[1], 2], 1)
  var_exp_2 <- round(pca_result$eig[axes[2], 2], 1)
  
  # --- CASE 1: Contribution ---
  if (color_type == "contrib") {
    # Get contribution values for this specific axes combination
    contrib_values <- pca_result$var$contrib[, axes[1]] + pca_result$var$contrib[, axes[2]]
    contrib_min <- min(contrib_values, na.rm = TRUE)
    contrib_max <- max(contrib_values, na.rm = TRUE)
    contrib_mid <- mean(c(contrib_min, contrib_max))
    
    cat("  Contribution range:", round(contrib_min, 2), "to", round(contrib_max, 2), "\n")
    
    p <- fviz_pca_var(pca_result,
                      axes = axes,
                      col.var = "contrib",
                      alpha.var = 0.85,
                      repel = TRUE,
                      labelsize = 3.0,
                      pointsize = 2.2,
                      arrowsize = 0.7,
                      select.var = list(contrib = Inf)) +  # Show ALL variables
      scale_color_gradient2(low = "#90EE90", 
                            mid = "#FF8C00", 
                            high = "#8B0000",
                            midpoint = contrib_mid,
                            name = "Contrib\n%",
                            limits = c(contrib_min, contrib_max),
                            guide = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", 
                                                   title.hjust = 0.5,
                                                   barwidth = 1.3,
                                                   barheight = 5.0,
                                                   ticks.colour = "#2F4F2F",
                                                   ticks.linewidth = 0.6,
                                                   frame.colour = "#2F4F2F",
                                                   frame.linewidth = 0.8)) +
      labs(title = plot_title,
           subtitle = paste0("PC", axes[1], " & PC", axes[2], " • All Sugarcane Variables"),
           x = paste0("PC", axes[1], " (", var_exp_1, "% variance)"),
           y = paste0("PC", axes[2], " (", var_exp_2, "% variance)"))
    
  # --- CASE 2: Cos² quality ---
  } else if (color_type == "cos2") {
    p <- fviz_pca_var(pca_result,
                      axes = axes,
                      col.var = "cos2",
                      alpha.var = 0.85,
                      repel = TRUE,
                      labelsize = 3.0,
                      pointsize = 2.2,
                      arrowsize = 0.7,
                      select.var = list(cos2 = 0)) +  # Show ALL variables
      scale_color_viridis_c(option = "viridis", name = "Quality\n(Cos²)",
                            guide = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", 
                                                   title.hjust = 0.5,
                                                   barwidth = 1.3,
                                                   barheight = 5.0,
                                                   ticks.colour = "#2F4F2F",
                                                   ticks.linewidth = 0.6,
                                                   frame.colour = "#2F4F2F",
                                                   frame.linewidth = 0.8)) +
      labs(title = plot_title,
           subtitle = paste0("PC", axes[1], " & PC", axes[2], " • All Sugarcane Variables"),
           x = paste0("PC", axes[1], " (", var_exp_1, "% variance)"),
           y = paste0("PC", axes[2], " (", var_exp_2, "% variance)"))
  }
  
  # Apply sugarcane theme
  p <- p + theme_pca_sugarcane()
  
  # Add reference lines, border, and fixed square ratio
  p <- p +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "#228B22", size = 0.9, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "#228B22", size = 0.9, alpha = 0.8) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = NA, color = "#2F4F2F", size = 1.3) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1,
                xlim = c(-1.1, 1.1),
                ylim = c(-1.1, 1.1),
                expand = FALSE,
                clip = "on")
  
  return(p)
}
```

## III. Comprehensive Sugarcane Dataset Analysis : plantation timing, crop cycles, varieties & seasonal patterns

```{r}
# Comprehensive Sugarcane Dataset Analysis
# Deep dive into plantation timing, crop cycles, varieties, and seasonal patterns

# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)  # For map functions

# Function to safely convert campaign to numeric years
extract_campaign_years <- function(campaign_str) {
  if (is.na(campaign_str) || campaign_str == "") return(list(start = NA, end = NA))
  
  # Handle formats like "02-03", "2002-2003", etc.
  campaign_clean <- gsub("[^0-9-]", "", campaign_str)
  parts <- strsplit(campaign_clean, "-")[[1]]
  
  if (length(parts) == 2) {
    start_year <- as.numeric(parts[1])
    end_year <- as.numeric(parts[2])
    
    # Handle 2-digit years (assume 2000s for years < 50, 1900s for >= 50)
    if (start_year < 100) {
      if (start_year < 50) {
        start_year <- start_year + 2000
      } else {
        start_year <- start_year + 1900
      }
    }
    
    if (end_year < 100) {
      if (end_year < 50) {
        end_year <- end_year + 2000
      } else {
        end_year <- end_year + 1900
      }
    }
    
    return(list(start = start_year, end = end_year))
  }
  
  return(list(start = NA, end = NA))
}

# Function to determine crop type (Plant Cane vs Ratoon)
determine_crop_type <- function(crop_cycle) {
  if (is.na(crop_cycle) || crop_cycle == "" || crop_cycle == "NA") return("Unknown")
  
  # Convert to numeric if it's character/factor, handle errors
  cycle_num <- tryCatch({
    if (is.character(crop_cycle) || is.factor(crop_cycle)) {
      as.numeric(as.character(crop_cycle))
    } else {
      as.numeric(crop_cycle)
    }
  }, error = function(e) NA, warning = function(w) NA)
  
  if (is.na(cycle_num)) return("Unknown")
  
  if (cycle_num == 1) return("Plant Cane")
  else if (cycle_num >= 2) return("Ratoon")
  else return("Unknown")
}

cat("=== COMPREHENSIVE SUGARCANE DATASET ANALYSIS ===\n\n")

# Check if data exists and has the required columns
if (!exists("data")) {
  stop("Error: 'data' object not found. Please load your dataset first.")
}

# Fix column names - remove NA or empty column names
cat("Checking and fixing column names...\n")
original_ncol <- ncol(data)

# Identify problematic column names
problematic_cols <- is.na(names(data)) | names(data) == "" | names(data) == "NA"

if (any(problematic_cols)) {
  cat("Found", sum(problematic_cols), "columns with problematic names. Fixing...\n")
  
  # Give temporary names to problematic columns
  temp_names <- names(data)
  temp_names[problematic_cols] <- paste0("temp_col_", seq_len(sum(problematic_cols)))
  names(data) <- temp_names
  
  # Remove columns that are completely empty or have no useful data
  empty_cols <- sapply(data, function(x) all(is.na(x) | x == "" | x == "NA"))
  if (any(empty_cols)) {
    cat("Removing", sum(empty_cols), "completely empty columns...\n")
    data <- data[, !empty_cols]
  }
}

cat("Dataset now has", ncol(data), "columns (was", original_ncol, ")\n")
cat("Column names:", paste(names(data)[1:min(10, ncol(data))], collapse = ", "), 
    if(ncol(data) > 10) "..." else "", "\n")

required_cols <- c("campaign", "planting_date", "harvest_date", "crop_cycle", "parcel", "block", "variety")
missing_cols <- required_cols[!required_cols %in% names(data)]
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  cat("Warning: Missing columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# Data preparation
cat("1. PREPARING DATA...\n")

# Create safe versions of map functions for cases where purrr isn't available
safe_map <- function(x, f) {
  result <- vector("list", length(x))
  for (i in seq_along(x)) {
    result[[i]] <- f(x[i])
  }
  result
}

safe_map_dbl <- function(x, f) {
  result <- numeric(length(x))
  for (i in seq_along(x)) {
    val <- f(x[[i]])
    result[i] <- if (is.null(val) || is.na(val)) NA else as.numeric(val)
  }
  result
}

safe_map_chr <- function(x, f) {
  result <- character(length(x))
  for (i in seq_along(x)) {
    val <- f(x[i])
    result[i] <- if (is.null(val) || is.na(val)) "Unknown" else as.character(val)
  }
  result
}

# Safe date conversion function
safe_date_convert <- function(date_col) {
  if (is.null(date_col) || all(is.na(date_col))) return(rep(as.Date(NA), length(date_col)))
  
  # If already Date, return as is
  if (inherits(date_col, "Date")) return(date_col)
  
  result <- rep(as.Date(NA), length(date_col))
  
  for (i in seq_along(date_col)) {
    if (!is.na(date_col[i]) && date_col[i] != "" && date_col[i] != "NA") {
      # Try different date formats
      date_formats <- c("%Y-%m-%d", "%d/%m/%Y", "%m/%d/%Y", "%Y/%m/%d", "%d-%m-%Y")
      
      for (fmt in date_formats) {
        temp_date <- tryCatch(
          as.Date(as.character(date_col[i]), format = fmt),
          error = function(e) NA
        )
        if (!is.na(temp_date)) {
          result[i] <- temp_date
          break
        }
      }
      
      # If still NA, try as numeric (Excel dates)
      if (is.na(result[i])) {
        numeric_date <- tryCatch(as.numeric(as.character(date_col[i])), error = function(e) NA)
        if (!is.na(numeric_date) && numeric_date > 0) {
          result[i] <- as.Date("1899-12-30") + numeric_date
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(result)
}

# Safe month extraction function
safe_month_name <- function(date_col) {
  if (is.null(date_col) || all(is.na(date_col))) return(rep(NA_character_, length(date_col)))
  
  month_names <- c("January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June",
                   "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December")
  
  result <- rep(NA_character_, length(date_col))
  
  # Convert to Date first
  dates <- safe_date_convert(date_col)
  valid_dates <- !is.na(dates)
  
  if (any(valid_dates)) {
    month_nums <- as.numeric(format(dates[valid_dates], "%m"))
    result[valid_dates] <- month_names[month_nums]
  }
  
  return(result)
}

analysis_data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert variety to uppercase first
    variety = if("variety" %in% names(data)) {
      toupper(as.character(variety))
    } else rep(NA_character_, nrow(data)),
    
    # Convert dates to proper Date objects first
    planting_date_clean = if("planting_date" %in% names(data)) {
      safe_date_convert(planting_date)
    } else rep(as.Date(NA), nrow(data)),
    
    harvest_date_clean = if("harvest_date" %in% names(data)) {
      safe_date_convert(harvest_date)
    } else rep(as.Date(NA), nrow(data)),
    
    # Extract campaign years
    campaign_years = safe_map(campaign, extract_campaign_years),
    campaign_start = safe_map_dbl(campaign_years, function(x) x$start),
    campaign_end = safe_map_dbl(campaign_years, function(x) x$end),
    
    # Determine crop type
    crop_type = safe_map_chr(crop_cycle, determine_crop_type),
    
    # Extract months from dates using safe function
    planting_month = safe_month_name(planting_date_clean),
    harvest_month = safe_month_name(harvest_date_clean),
    
    # Calculate growing period in days (now using clean dates)
    growing_days = ifelse(!is.na(planting_date_clean) & !is.na(harvest_date_clean),
                         as.numeric(harvest_date_clean - planting_date_clean),
                         NA),
    
    # Calculate growing period in months (approximate)
    growing_months = ifelse(!is.na(growing_days), growing_days / 30.44, NA),
    
    # Create unique parcel identifier
    parcel_id = if(all(c("campaign", "block", "parcel") %in% names(data))) {
      paste(campaign, block, parcel, sep = "_")
    } else paste("row", row_number(), sep = "_")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(campaign_start))  # Remove records with invalid campaigns

cat("Data prepared. Analyzing", nrow(analysis_data), "records.\n\n")

# =============================================================================
# CAMPAIGN ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
cat("2. CAMPAIGN TIME RANGE ANALYSIS\n")
cat("===============================\n")

campaign_summary <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(campaign, campaign_start, campaign_end) %>%
  summarise(
    n_parcels = n(),
    n_unique_parcels = n_distinct(parcel_id),
    
    # Planting dates (using cleaned dates)
    earliest_planting = ifelse(any(!is.na(planting_date_clean)), 
                              as.character(min(planting_date_clean, na.rm = TRUE)), 
                              "No data"),
    latest_planting = ifelse(any(!is.na(planting_date_clean)), 
                            as.character(max(planting_date_clean, na.rm = TRUE)), 
                            "No data"),
    mean_planting = ifelse(any(!is.na(planting_date_clean)), 
                          as.character(as.Date(mean(as.numeric(planting_date_clean), na.rm = TRUE), origin = "1970-01-01")), 
                          "No data"),
    
    # Harvest dates (using cleaned dates)
    earliest_harvest = ifelse(any(!is.na(harvest_date_clean)), 
                             as.character(min(harvest_date_clean, na.rm = TRUE)), 
                             "No data"),
    latest_harvest = ifelse(any(!is.na(harvest_date_clean)), 
                           as.character(max(harvest_date_clean, na.rm = TRUE)), 
                           "No data"),
    mean_harvest = ifelse(any(!is.na(harvest_date_clean)), 
                         as.character(as.Date(mean(as.numeric(harvest_date_clean), na.rm = TRUE), origin = "1970-01-01")), 
                         "No data"),
    
    # Growing periods
    min_growing_months = ifelse(any(!is.na(growing_months)), 
                               round(min(growing_months, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
```

```{r}
# Comprehensive Sugarcane Dataset Analysis
# Deep dive into plantation timing, crop cycles, varieties, and seasonal patterns

# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)  # For map functions

# Function to safely convert campaign to numeric years
extract_campaign_years <- function(campaign_str) {
  if (is.na(campaign_str) || campaign_str == "") return(list(start = NA, end = NA))
  
  # Handle formats like "02-03", "2002-2003", etc.
  campaign_clean <- gsub("[^0-9-]", "", campaign_str)
  parts <- strsplit(campaign_clean, "-")[[1]]
  
  if (length(parts) == 2) {
    start_year <- as.numeric(parts[1])
    end_year <- as.numeric(parts[2])
    
    # Handle 2-digit years (assume 2000s for years < 50, 1900s for >= 50)
    if (start_year < 100) {
      if (start_year < 50) {
        start_year <- start_year + 2000
      } else {
        start_year <- start_year + 1900
      }
    }
    
    if (end_year < 100) {
      if (end_year < 50) {
        end_year <- end_year + 2000
      } else {
        end_year <- end_year + 1900
      }
    }
    
    return(list(start = start_year, end = end_year))
  }
  
  return(list(start = NA, end = NA))
}

# Function to determine crop type (Plant Cane vs Ratoon)
determine_crop_type <- function(crop_cycle) {
  if (is.na(crop_cycle) || crop_cycle == "" || crop_cycle == "NA") return("Unknown")
  
  # Convert to numeric if it's character/factor, handle errors
  cycle_num <- tryCatch({
    if (is.character(crop_cycle) || is.factor(crop_cycle)) {
      as.numeric(as.character(crop_cycle))
    } else {
      as.numeric(crop_cycle)
    }
  }, error = function(e) NA, warning = function(w) NA)
  
  if (is.na(cycle_num)) return("Unknown")
  
  if (cycle_num == 1) return("Plant Cane")
  else if (cycle_num >= 2) return("Ratoon")
  else return("Unknown")
}

cat("=== COMPREHENSIVE SUGARCANE DATASET ANALYSIS ===\n\n")

  if (any(empty_cols)) {
    cat("Removing", sum(empty_cols), "completely empty columns...\n")
    data <- data[, !empty_cols]
  }
}

missing_cols <- required_cols[!required_cols %in% names(data)]

# Data preparation
cat("1. PREPARING DATA...\n")

# Create safe versions of map functions for cases where purrr isn't available
safe_map <- function(x, f) {
  result <- vector("list", length(x))
  for (i in seq_along(x)) {
    result[[i]] <- f(x[i])
  }
  result
}

safe_map_dbl <- function(x, f) {
  result <- numeric(length(x))
  for (i in seq_along(x)) {
    val <- f(x[[i]])
    result[i] <- if (is.null(val) || is.na(val)) NA else as.numeric(val)
  }
  result
}

safe_map_chr <- function(x, f) {
  result <- character(length(x))
  for (i in seq_along(x)) {
    val <- f(x[i])
    result[i] <- if (is.null(val) || is.na(val)) "Unknown" else as.character(val)
  }
  result
}

# Safe date conversion function
safe_date_convert <- function(date_col) {
  if (is.null(date_col) || all(is.na(date_col))) return(rep(as.Date(NA), length(date_col)))
  
  # If already Date, return as is
  if (inherits(date_col, "Date")) return(date_col)
  
  result <- rep(as.Date(NA), length(date_col))
  
  for (i in seq_along(date_col)) {
    if (!is.na(date_col[i]) && date_col[i] != "" && date_col[i] != "NA") {
      # Try different date formats
      date_formats <- c("%Y-%m-%d", "%d/%m/%Y", "%m/%d/%Y", "%Y/%m/%d", "%d-%m-%Y")
      
      for (fmt in date_formats) {
        temp_date <- tryCatch(
          as.Date(as.character(date_col[i]), format = fmt),
          error = function(e) NA
        )
        if (!is.na(temp_date)) {
          result[i] <- temp_date
          break
        }
      }
      
      # If still NA, try as numeric (Excel dates)
      if (is.na(result[i])) {
        numeric_date <- tryCatch(as.numeric(as.character(date_col[i])), error = function(e) NA)
        if (!is.na(numeric_date) && numeric_date > 0) {
          result[i] <- as.Date("1899-12-30") + numeric_date
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  return(result)
}

# Safe month extraction function
safe_month_name <- function(date_col) {
  if (is.null(date_col) || all(is.na(date_col))) return(rep(NA_character_, length(date_col)))
  
  month_names <- c("January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June",
                   "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December")
  
  result <- rep(NA_character_, length(date_col))
  
  # Convert to Date first
  dates <- safe_date_convert(date_col)
  valid_dates <- !is.na(dates)
  
  if (any(valid_dates)) {
    month_nums <- as.numeric(format(dates[valid_dates], "%m"))
    result[valid_dates] <- month_names[month_nums]
  }
  
  return(result)
}

analysis_data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    # Convert variety to uppercase first
    variety = if("variety" %in% names(data)) {

    } else rep(NA_character_, nrow(data)),
    
    # Convert dates to proper Date objects first
    planting_date_clean = if("planting_date" %in% names(data)) {
      safe_date_convert(planting_date)
    } else rep(as.Date(NA), nrow(data)),
    
    harvest_date_clean = if("harvest_date" %in% names(data)) {
      safe_date_convert(harvest_date)
    } else rep(as.Date(NA), nrow(data)),
    
    # Extract campaign years
    campaign_years = safe_map(campaign, extract_campaign_years),
    campaign_start = safe_map_dbl(campaign_years, function(x) x$start),
    campaign_end = safe_map_dbl(campaign_years, function(x) x$end),
    
    # Determine crop type
    crop_type = safe_map_chr(crop_cycle, determine_crop_type),
    
    # Extract months from dates using safe function
    planting_month = safe_month_name(planting_date_clean),
    harvest_month = safe_month_name(harvest_date_clean),
    
    # Calculate growing period in days (now using clean dates)
    growing_days = ifelse(!is.na(planting_date_clean) & !is.na(harvest_date_clean),
                         as.numeric(harvest_date_clean - planting_date_clean),
                         NA),
    
    # Calculate growing period in months (approximate)
    growing_months = ifelse(!is.na(growing_days), growing_days / 30.44, NA),
    
    # Create unique parcel identifier
    parcel_id = if(all(c("campaign", "block", "parcel") %in% names(data))) {
      paste(campaign, block, parcel, sep = "_")
    } else paste("row", row_number(), sep = "_")
  ) %>%

    plant_cane_pct = round(100 * plant_cane_count / total_parcels, 1),
    ratoon_pct = round(100 * ratoon_count / total_parcels, 1),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(campaign_start)

      max_cycle = max(crop_cycle, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_cycle = round(mean(crop_cycle, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      median_cycle = median(crop_cycle, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  cat("\n--- CROP CYCLE STATISTICS ---\n")
  cat("Minimum crop cycle:", crop_cycle_stats$min_cycle, "\n")
  cat("Maximum crop cycle:", crop_cycle_stats$max_cycle, "\n")
  cat("Mean crop cycle:", crop_cycle_stats$mean_cycle, "\n")
  cat("Median crop cycle:", crop_cycle_stats$median_cycle, "\n")
}

# Find most common block for plant cane per campaign
most_plant_cane_blocks <- plant_cane_by_block %>%

cat("--- BLOCKS WITH MOST PLANT CANE PER CAMPAIGN ---\n")

# VARIETY ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
cat("\n6. VARIETY-SPECIFIC ANALYSIS\n")
cat("=============================\n")

if ("variety" %in% names(data) && any(!is.na(analysis_data$variety))) {
  
  # Growing period by variety
  variety_analysis <- analysis_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(variety) & !is.na(growing_months)) %>%
    group_by(variety) %>%
    summarise(
      n_parcels = n(),
      min_growing_months = round(min(growing_months, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      max_growing_months = round(max(growing_months, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      mean_growing_months = round(mean(growing_months, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      median_growing_months = round(median(growing_months, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      sd_growing_months = round(sd(growing_months, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    filter(n_parcels >= 5) %>%  # Only varieties with at least 5 observations
    arrange(mean_growing_months)
  
  cat("--- GROWING PERIOD BY VARIETY ---\n")
  cat("(Only varieties with 5+ observations)\n")
  print(variety_analysis)
  
  # Shortest and longest growing varieties
  if (nrow(variety_analysis) > 0) {
    cat("\nShortest growing varieties:\n")
    shortest_varieties <- head(variety_analysis, 3)
    for (i in 1:nrow(shortest_varieties)) {
      cat(i, ". ", shortest_varieties$variety[i], " (avg: ", 
          shortest_varieties$mean_growing_months[i], " months)\n", sep = "")
    }
    
    cat("\nLongest growing varieties:\n")
    longest_varieties <- tail(variety_analysis, 3)
    for (i in nrow(longest_varieties):1) {
      cat(nrow(longest_varieties) + 1 - i, ". ", longest_varieties$variety[i], 
          " (avg: ", longest_varieties$mean_growing_months[i], " months)\n", sep = "")
    }
  }
  
  # Variety planting seasons
  if ("planting_month" %in% names(analysis_data)) {
    variety_seasons <- analysis_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(variety) & !is.na(planting_month)) %>%
      group_by(variety, planting_month) %>%
      summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
      group_by(variety) %>%
      mutate(
        total_variety = sum(count),
        percentage = round(100 * count / total_variety, 1)
      ) %>%
      filter(total_variety >= 10) %>%  # Only varieties with 10+ observations
      arrange(variety, desc(count))
    
    cat("\n--- PREFERRED PLANTING MONTHS BY VARIETY ---\n")
    variety_top_months <- variety_seasons %>%
      group_by(variety) %>%
      slice_max(count, n = 2) %>%
      summarise(
        top_months = paste(planting_month, collapse = ", "),
        total_parcels = first(total_variety),
        .groups = 'drop'
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(total_parcels))
    
    print(variety_top_months)
  }
} else {
  cat("Variety analysis not possible - variety column not found or empty.\n")
}

# =============================================================================
# HIGH-RESOLUTION PLOTTING SECTION
# =============================================================================
cat("\n8. CREATING HIGH-RESOLUTION VISUALIZATIONS\n")
cat("==========================================\n")

# Load additional libraries for enhanced plotting
if (!require(RColorBrewer, quietly = TRUE)) {
  cat("Installing RColorBrewer...\n")
  install.packages("RColorBrewer", quiet = TRUE)
  library(RColorBrewer)
}

# Try to load scales, but provide fallback
scales_available <- FALSE
if (require(scales, quietly = TRUE)) {
  scales_available <- TRUE
} else {
  cat("Note: scales package not available, using base formatting\n")
}

# Helper function for percentage formatting
percent_format <- function(x) {
  if (scales_available) {
    scales::percent(x/100, accuracy = 0.1)
  } else {
    paste0(x, "%")
  }
}

# Set up high-resolution plotting parameters
plot_width <- 12
plot_height <- 8
plot_dpi <- 300

# Define a consistent theme for all plots
sugarcane_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray30", margin = margin(b = 20)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.5),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

# Color palettes - safe package checking and fallback options
n_campaigns <- n_distinct(analysis_data$campaign, na.rm = TRUE)

# Check if viridis package is available
viridis_available <- FALSE
if (require(viridis, quietly = TRUE)) {
  viridis_available <- TRUE
} else {
  cat("Note: viridis package not available, using alternative colors\n")
}

# Generate campaign colors with proper error handling
campaign_colors <- tryCatch({
  if (viridis_available && n_campaigns > 0 && n_campaigns <= 8) {
    viridis::viridis(n_campaigns, option = "plasma", alpha = 0.8)
  } else {
    # Use RColorBrewer or base colors as fallback
    if (n_campaigns > 0 && n_campaigns <= 8) {
      # Ensure we have at least 3 colors for brewer.pal
      n_colors <- max(3, min(n_campaigns, 8))
      colors <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n_colors, "Set2")
      colors[1:n_campaigns]  # Return only the number we need
    } else if (n_campaigns > 8) {
      rainbow(n_campaigns, alpha = 0.8)
    } else {
      # Fallback for edge cases (n_campaigns = 0 or negative)
      c("#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#2ca02c")  # Default colors
    }
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  # Ultimate fallback if everything fails
  cat("Warning: Color generation failed, using default colors\n")
  rep(c("#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#2ca02c", "#d62728", "#9467bd", 
        "#8c564b", "#e377c2", "#7f7f7f"), length.out = max(1, n_campaigns))
})

# Define other color palettes with error handling
crop_colors <- tryCatch({
  c("Plant Cane" = "#2E8B57", "Ratoon" = "#CD853F", "Unknown" = "#808080")
}, error = function(e) {
  c("Plant Cane" = "darkgreen", "Ratoon" = "brown", "Unknown" = "gray")
})

month_colors <- tryCatch({
  if (require(RColorBrewer, quietly = TRUE)) {
    RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Set3")
  } else {
    rainbow(12, alpha = 0.8)
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  rainbow(12, alpha = 0.8)
})

# Verify colors were generated correctly
cat("Campaign colors generated:", length(campaign_colors), "colors for", n_campaigns, "campaigns\n")

# Additional safety check - ensure we have the right number of colors
if (length(campaign_colors) != n_campaigns && n_campaigns > 0) {
  cat("Adjusting campaign colors to match number of campaigns...\n")
  campaign_colors <- rep(campaign_colors, length.out = n_campaigns)
}

crop_colors <- c("Plant Cane" = "#2E8B57", "Ratoon" = "#CD853F", "Unknown" = "#808080")
month_colors <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Set3")

# =============================================================================
# PLOT 1: CAMPAIGN OVERVIEW - PARCELS AND GROWING PERIODS
# =============================================================================
cat("Creating Plot 1: Campaign Overview...\n")

campaign_plot_data <- campaign_summary %>%
  filter(!is.na(campaign_start)) %>%
  mutate(
    campaign_label = paste0(campaign, "\n(", campaign_start, "-", campaign_end, ")"),
    mean_growing_numeric = as.numeric(mean_growing_months)
  )

p1 <- ggplot(campaign_plot_data, aes(x = reorder(campaign_label, campaign_start))) +
  geom_col(aes(y = n_parcels), fill = "#4472C4", alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_growing_numeric * 50), color = "#E74C3C", size = 4) +
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_growing_numeric * 50, group = 1), color = "#E74C3C", size = 1.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Number of Parcels",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / 50, name = "Average Growing Period (months)")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Sugarcane Campaigns: Parcel Count and Growing Periods",
    subtitle = "Blue bars show parcel count, red line shows average growing period",
    x = "Campaign Period"
  ) +
  sugarcane_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.y.left = element_text(color = "#4472C4"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "#E74C3C")
  )

ggsave("01_Campaign_Overview.png", p1, width = plot_width, height = plot_height, dpi = plot_dpi)

# =============================================================================
# PLOT 2: CROP CYCLE DISTRIBUTION BY CAMPAIGN
# =============================================================================
cat("Creating Plot 2: Plant Cane vs Ratoon Distribution...\n")

crop_distribution <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(crop_type != "Unknown") %>%
  group_by(campaign, campaign_start, crop_type) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  group_by(campaign) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = round(100 * count / sum(count), 1),
    campaign_label = paste0(campaign, "\n(", campaign_start, ")")
  )

p2 <- ggplot(crop_distribution, aes(x = reorder(campaign_label, campaign_start), y = percentage, fill = crop_type)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(percentage, "%")), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), 
            color = "white", size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = crop_colors, name = "Crop Type") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(
    title = "Plant Cane vs Ratoon Distribution by Campaign",
    subtitle = "Percentage distribution showing crop cycle patterns across campaigns",
    x = "Campaign Period",
    y = "Percentage of Parcels"
  ) +
  sugarcane_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave("02_Crop_Cycle_Distribution.png", p2, width = plot_width, height = plot_height, dpi = plot_dpi)

# =============================================================================
# PLOT 3: SEASONAL PLANTING AND HARVEST PATTERNS
# =============================================================================
cat("Creating Plot 3: Seasonal Patterns...\n")

if (any(!is.na(analysis_data$planting_month)) && any(!is.na(analysis_data$harvest_month))) {
  
  # Prepare seasonal data
  seasonal_data <- analysis_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(planting_month) | !is.na(harvest_month)) %>%
    select(planting_month, harvest_month) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(planting_month, harvest_month), 
                 names_to = "activity", values_to = "month") %>%
    filter(!is.na(month)) %>%
    mutate(
      activity = case_when(
        activity == "planting_month" ~ "Planting",
        activity == "harvest_month" ~ "Harvest"
      ),
      month = factor(month, levels = month.name)
    ) %>%
    group_by(activity, month) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    group_by(activity) %>%
    mutate(percentage = round(100 * count / sum(count), 1))
  
  p3 <- ggplot(seasonal_data, aes(x = month, y = percentage, fill = activity)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(percentage, "%")), 
              position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), 
              vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Planting" = "#228B22", "Harvest" = "#DAA520"), name = "Activity") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), 
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
    labs(
      title = "Seasonal Distribution of Planting and Harvest Activities",
      subtitle = "Percentage of activities by month showing peak seasons",
      x = "Month",
      y = "Percentage of Activities"
    ) +
    sugarcane_theme +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  ggsave("03_Seasonal_Patterns.png", p3, width = plot_width, height = plot_height, dpi = plot_dpi)
}

if (any(!is.na(analysis_data$growing_months))) {
  
  growing_period_data <- analysis_data %>%

  )

# Mini plot 1: Crop type distribution
mini_crop <- analysis_data %>%

dash_p1 <- ggplot(mini_crop, aes(x = "", y = percentage, fill = crop_type)) +

# Mini plot 2: Parcels per campaign
dash_p2 <- ggplot(campaign_plot_data, aes(x = reorder(campaign, campaign_start), y = n_parcels)) +

# Mini plot 3: Growing period box plot by crop type
if (any(!is.na(analysis_data$growing_months))) {
  dash_p3 <- analysis_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(growing_months) & crop_type != "Unknown" & growing_months > 0 & growing_months < 50) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = crop_type, y = growing_months, fill = crop_type)) +

    scale_fill_manual(values = crop_colors, guide = "none") +
    labs(title = "Growing Periods by Crop Type", x = "Crop Type", y = "Months") +
    dashboard_theme
} else {
  dash_p3 <- ggplot() + labs(title = "Growing Periods: No Data") + dashboard_theme
}

# Mini plot 4: Summary statistics text
summary_stats <- paste0(
  "Dataset Overview:\n",
  "• Total Records: ", format(nrow(analysis_data), big.mark = ","), "\n",
  "• Campaigns: ", n_distinct(analysis_data$campaign), "\n",
  "• Blocks: ", n_distinct(analysis_data$block, na.rm = TRUE), "\n",
  "• Plant Cane: ", sum(analysis_data$crop_type == "Plant Cane", na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
  round(100 * sum(analysis_data$crop_type == "Plant Cane", na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(analysis_data), 1), "%)\n",
  "• Ratoon: ", sum(analysis_data$crop_type == "Ratoon", na.rm = TRUE), " (", 
  round(100 * sum(analysis_data$crop_type == "Ratoon", na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(analysis_data), 1), "%)"
)

dash_p4 <- ggplot() +
  annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 0.5, label = summary_stats, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 3.5) +
  xlim(0, 1) + ylim(0, 1) +
  labs(title = "Summary Statistics") +
  dashboard_theme +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.title = element_blank())

# Combine into dashboard
dashboard <- grid.arrange(dash_p1, dash_p2, dash_p3, dash_p4, 
                         ncol = 2, nrow = 2,
                         top = textGrob("Sugarcane Cultivation Analysis Dashboard", 
                                       gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold")))

ggsave("07_Comprehensive_Dashboard.png", dashboard, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = plot_dpi)

cat("\n=== HIGH-RESOLUTION PLOTS CREATED ===\n")
cat("Generated plots:\n")
cat("1. 01_Campaign_Overview.png - Campaign parcels and growing periods\n")
cat("2. 02_Crop_Cycle_Distribution.png - Plant cane vs ratoon by campaign\n")
cat("3. 03_Seasonal_Patterns.png - Monthly planting and harvest patterns\n")
cat("4. 04_Growing_Period_Distribution.png - Distribution of growing periods\n")
cat("5. 05_Variety_Growing_Periods.png - Growing periods by variety\n")
cat("6. 06_Block_Plant_Cane_Analysis.png - Plant cane distribution by block\n")
cat("7. 07_Comprehensive_Dashboard.png - Multi-panel summary dashboard\n")
cat("\nAll plots saved at 300 DPI for high-quality printing and presentations.\n")

cat("\n=== ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
cat("Use the generated summaries to understand your sugarcane cultivation patterns!\n")
```
