```{r}
# Block-Variety Affinity Analysis Extension
# Analyzing variety preferences and dominance patterns by block over time

# Load required libraries 
if (!require(ggplot2)) library(ggplot2)
if (!require(dplyr)) library(dplyr)
if (!require(tidyr)) library(tidyr)
if (!require(RColorBrewer)) library(RColorBrewer)
if (!require(viridis)) library(viridis)
if (!require(scales)) library(scales)
if (!require(gridExtra)) library(gridExtra)

cat("=== BLOCK-VARIETY AFFINITY ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Ensure we have the necessary data (from previous analysis)
if (!exists("analysis_data")) {
  stop("Error: 'analysis_data' not found. Please run the main variety analysis script first.")
}

# Convert variety names to uppercase for consistency
analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(variety = toupper(variety))

cat("Variety names converted to uppercase\n")

# Use the same theme from previous analysis
if (!exists("theme_custom")) {
  theme_custom <- function() {
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 15)),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 10)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 10)),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 8)),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "gray80")
    )
  }
}

# ===== BLOCK-VARIETY AFFINITY CALCULATIONS =====

# Calculate variety dominance by block across all campaigns
block_variety_affinity <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(block, variety) %>%
  summarise(
    total_surface_ha = sum(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_parcels = n(),
    campaigns_present = n_distinct(campaign),
    avg_parcel_size = mean(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Calculate percentage within each block
  group_by(block) %>%
  mutate(
    block_total_surface = sum(total_surface_ha),
    variety_percentage = (total_surface_ha / block_total_surface) * 100,
    variety_rank = rank(desc(total_surface_ha), ties.method = "first")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Filter for meaningful blocks (at least 10 ha total)
  filter(block_total_surface >= 10)

# Identify blocks with strong variety preferences (where top variety > 40% or top 3 varieties > 80%)
strong_affinity_blocks <- block_variety_affinity %>%
  group_by(block) %>%
  summarise(
    top1_percentage = max(variety_percentage),
    top3_percentage = sum(head(sort(variety_percentage, decreasing = TRUE), 3)),
    dominant_variety = variety[which.max(variety_percentage)],
    total_varieties = n_distinct(variety),
    total_surface = first(block_total_surface),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(top1_percentage > 25 | top3_percentage > 70) %>%  # Blocks with clear preferences
  arrange(desc(top1_percentage))

cat("BLOCKS WITH STRONG VARIETY AFFINITIES:\n")
print(strong_affinity_blocks)

# Select top blocks for detailed analysis
top_affinity_blocks <- head(strong_affinity_blocks$block, 12)  # Top 12 blocks

# ===== CHART 1: OVERALL BLOCK-VARIETY AFFINITY HEATMAP =====

# Prepare data for heatmap (top varieties in top blocks)
top_varieties_in_blocks <- block_variety_affinity %>%
  filter(block %in% top_affinity_blocks) %>%
  group_by(variety) %>%
  summarise(total_across_blocks = sum(total_surface_ha), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_across_blocks)) %>%
  head(15) %>%
  pull(variety)

heatmap_data <- block_variety_affinity %>%
  filter(block %in% top_affinity_blocks, variety %in% top_varieties_in_blocks) %>%
  select(block, variety, variety_percentage) %>%
  complete(block, variety, fill = list(variety_percentage = 0))

# PLOT 1: Heatmap of variety affinity by block
p1 <- ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = variety, y = block, fill = variety_percentage)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Surface\n(%)", option = "plasma", 
                       trans = "sqrt", labels = function(x) paste0(round(x), "%")) +
  labs(
    title = "Block-Variety Affinity Matrix",
    subtitle = "Percentage of block surface area by variety (stronger affinities in brighter colors)",
    x = "Variety",
    y = "Block"
  ) +
  theme_custom() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p1)

# ===== CHART 2: EVOLUTION OF AFFINITY OVER TIME =====

# Fixed function to find varieties that make up specified percentage of area
find_dominant_varieties_by_threshold <- function(block_campaign_data, threshold = 80) {
  # Sort by surface area and calculate cumulative percentage
  sorted_data <- block_campaign_data %>%
    arrange(desc(surface_ha)) %>%
    mutate(
      cumulative_percentage = cumsum(surface_ha) / sum(surface_ha) * 100
    )
  
  # Get varieties that together make up the threshold percentage
  dominant_varieties <- sorted_data %>%
    filter(cumulative_percentage <= threshold | row_number() == 1) %>%  # Include at least the top variety
    pull(variety)
  
  return(dominant_varieties)
}

# Calculate variety percentage by block and campaign with dynamic selection
affinity_evolution_raw <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(block %in% top_affinity_blocks[1:8]) %>%  # Top 8 blocks for readability
  group_by(block, campaign, variety) %>%
  summarise(surface_ha = sum(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(block, campaign) %>%
  mutate(
    campaign_total = sum(surface_ha),
    variety_percentage = (surface_ha / campaign_total) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# FIXED: For each block-campaign combination, find varieties that make up ~80% of area
# Using map_dfr instead of do() to avoid the error
affinity_evolution <- affinity_evolution_raw %>%
  group_by(block, campaign) %>%
  group_split() %>%
  purrr::map_dfr(function(group_data) {
    # Find dominant varieties for this block-campaign combination
    dominant_vars <- find_dominant_varieties_by_threshold(group_data, threshold = 80)
    
    # Return only dominant varieties
    group_data %>% filter(variety %in% dominant_vars)
  })

# Alternative approach without purrr dependency:
# affinity_evolution <- affinity_evolution_raw %>%
#   nest_by(block, campaign) %>%
#   mutate(
#     dominant_varieties = list(find_dominant_varieties_by_threshold(data, threshold = 80))
#   ) %>%
#   unnest(c(data)) %>%
#   filter(variety %in% unlist(dominant_varieties)) %>%
#   select(-dominant_varieties) %>%
#   ungroup()

# Get all unique varieties that appear as dominant across all block-campaign combinations
all_dominant_varieties <- unique(affinity_evolution$variety)

# Create more distinct color palette using multiple color schemes
create_distinct_colors <- function(n) {
  if (n <= 8) {
    # Use Set1 for small numbers (most distinct)
    colors <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(min(n, 8), "Set1")
  } else if (n <= 12) {
    # Combine Set1 and Dark2
    colors <- c(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Set1"), 
                RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(min(n-8, 4), "Dark2"))
  } else {
    # For many varieties, use viridis with distinct endpoints
    colors <- viridis::viridis(n, option = "turbo", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9)
  }
  return(colors[1:n])
}

colors_affinity <- create_distinct_colors(length(all_dominant_varieties))
names(colors_affinity) <- all_dominant_varieties

cat("Using", length(all_dominant_varieties), "varieties that represent ~80% of area in each block-campaign\n")
cat("Dominant varieties found:", paste(all_dominant_varieties, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# PLOT 2: Evolution of variety dominance over time by block (enhanced)
p2 <- ggplot(affinity_evolution, aes(x = campaign, y = variety_percentage, fill = variety)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.7, color = "white", size = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_affinity, name = "Variety") +
  facet_wrap(~ block, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(
    title = "Evolution of Variety Dominance by Block Over Time",
    subtitle = "Varieties representing ~80% of block surface area per campaign (more distinct colors)",
    x = "Campaign",
    y = "Surface Area Percentage (%)"
  ) +
  theme_custom() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10)
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, override.aes = list(size = 0.8)))

print(p2)

# ===== CHART 3: DOMINANT VARIETY STABILITY INDEX =====

# Calculate stability of dominant varieties over time
variety_stability <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(block %in% top_affinity_blocks) %>%
  group_by(block, campaign) %>%
  summarise(
    dominant_variety = variety[which.max(surface_area_ha)],
    dominant_percentage = max(surface_area_ha) / sum(surface_area_ha) * 100,
    total_varieties = n_distinct(variety),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(block) %>%
  summarise(
    campaigns_count = n(),
    unique_dominants = n_distinct(dominant_variety),
    most_frequent_dominant = names(sort(table(dominant_variety), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
    dominant_frequency = max(table(dominant_variety)) / campaigns_count,
    avg_dominant_percentage = mean(dominant_percentage),
    stability_score = dominant_frequency * avg_dominant_percentage / 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(stability_score))

# PLOT 3: Block variety stability index
p3 <- ggplot(variety_stability, aes(x = reorder(block, stability_score), y = stability_score)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = most_frequent_dominant), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = most_frequent_dominant), 
            hjust = -0.1, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Most Frequent\nDominant Variety", option = "plasma") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    title = "Block Variety Stability Index",
    subtitle = "Stability = (Dominance Frequency) × (Average Dominance Percentage)",
    x = "Block",
    y = "Stability Score"
  ) +
  theme_custom() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p3)

# ===== CHART 4: VARIETY SPECIALIZATION BY BLOCK =====

# Calculate specialization index (how much more a variety is present in a block vs overall)
overall_variety_distribution <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(variety) %>%
  summarise(overall_percentage = sum(surface_area_ha) / sum(analysis_data$surface_area_ha) * 100, 
            .groups = "drop")

specialization_data <- block_variety_affinity %>%
  filter(block %in% top_affinity_blocks, variety_percentage > 5) %>%  # Only significant presences
  left_join(overall_variety_distribution, by = "variety") %>%
  mutate(
    specialization_index = variety_percentage / overall_percentage,
    is_specialized = specialization_index > 1.5  # 50% more than average
  ) %>%
  filter(specialization_index > 1.2) %>%  # Only show varieties with some specialization
  arrange(desc(specialization_index))

# PLOT 4: Variety specialization by block
p4 <- ggplot(specialization_data, aes(x = reorder(paste(block, variety, sep = " - "), specialization_index), 
                                      y = specialization_index)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = variety), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Variety", option = "turbo") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(
    title = "Block-Variety Specialization Index",
    subtitle = "Values > 1 indicate higher than average presence (red line = average)",
    x = "Block - Variety",
    y = "Specialization Index (Block % / Overall %)"
  ) +
  theme_custom() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

print(p4)

# ===== SUMMARY STATISTICS AND INSIGHTS =====

cat("\n=== BLOCK-VARIETY AFFINITY INSIGHTS ===\n")

cat("STRONGEST VARIETY AFFINITIES:\n")

print(head(strongest_affinities, 10))

print(head(block_diversity, 10))
```

### III.3.2. Sugarcane Variety Classification Analysis

```{r}
# Sugarcane Variety Classification Analysis
# Classify varieties by harvest period: début, milieu, fin de campagne

# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(gridExtra)
library(lubridate)

# Check if data exists
if (!exists("data")) {
  stop("Error: 'data' object not found. Please load your sugarcane dataset first.")
}

cat("=== SUGARCANE VARIETY CLASSIFICATION BY HARVEST PERIOD ===\n\n")

# Data preparation and cleaning
cat("=== DATA PREPARATION ===\n")

# Check data structure
cat("Dataset dimensions:", nrow(data), "rows x", ncol(data), "columns\n")

# Check for required columns
required_cols <- c("variety", "harvest_date", "maturant", "campaign")
missing_cols <- required_cols[!required_cols %in% names(data)]

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  cat("Warning: Missing columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
} else {
  cat("All required columns found!\n")
}

# Clean and prepare the analysis dataset
analysis_data <- data %>%
  # Ensure proper data types
  mutate(
    variety = toupper(as.character(variety)),  # Convert variety names to uppercase
    campaign = as.character(campaign),
    harvest_date = as.Date(harvest_date),
    maturant = as.character(maturant)
  ) %>%
  # Filter for valid data
  filter(
    !is.na(variety),
    !is.na(harvest_date),
    !is.na(campaign),
    variety != "",
    campaign != ""
  ) %>%
  # Extract harvest month information
  mutate(
    harvest_month = month(harvest_date),
    harvest_month_name = month.name[harvest_month],
    harvest_year = year(harvest_date),
    # Define harvest periods based on months
    harvest_period = case_when(
      harvest_month %in% c(10, 11, 12, 1) ~ "Début (Oct-Jan)",
      harvest_month %in% c(2, 3, 4) ~ "Milieu (Feb-Apr)", 
      harvest_month %in% c(5, 6, 7) ~ "Fin (May-Jul)",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    # Simplified period names
    period_simple = case_when(
      harvest_month %in% c(10, 11, 12, 1) ~ "Début",
      harvest_month %in% c(2, 3, 4) ~ "Milieu", 
      harvest_month %in% c(5, 6, 7) ~ "Fin",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    # Add maturant information
    has_maturant = !is.na(maturant) & maturant != "" & maturant != "0" & maturant != "None"
  )

# Data quality summary
cat("Data after cleaning:\n")
cat("Total observations:", nrow(analysis_data), "\n")
cat("Unique varieties:", n_distinct(analysis_data$variety), "\n")
cat("Unique campaigns:", n_distinct(analysis_data$campaign), "\n")
cat("Date range:", as.character(min(analysis_data$harvest_date)), "to", as.character(max(analysis_data$harvest_date)), "\n")

# Harvest period distribution
period_summary <- analysis_data %>%
  count(harvest_period) %>%
  mutate(percentage = round(n/sum(n)*100, 1))

cat("\nHarvest period distribution:\n")
print(period_summary)

# ===== VARIETY CLASSIFICATION =====

cat("\n=== VARIETY CLASSIFICATION BY HARVEST PERIOD ===\n")

# Calculate variety classification based on harvest patterns
variety_classification <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(period_simple != "Other") %>%
  group_by(variety, period_simple) %>%
  summarise(
    harvests = n(),
    campaigns = n_distinct(campaign),
    total_surface = sum(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "keep"
  ) %>%
  group_by(variety) %>%
  mutate(
    total_harvests = sum(harvests),
    period_percentage = round(harvests / total_harvests * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Simplified classification system: varieties appear in each period they qualify for
# A variety belongs to a period if it has >= 25% of harvests in that period
threshold <- 25

# Create separate datasets for each period
debut_varieties <- variety_classification %>%
  filter(period_simple == "Début", period_percentage >= threshold) %>%
  select(variety, harvests, campaigns, period_percentage)

milieu_varieties <- variety_classification %>%
  filter(period_simple == "Milieu", period_percentage >= threshold) %>%
  select(variety, harvests, campaigns, period_percentage)

fin_varieties <- variety_classification %>%
  filter(period_simple == "Fin", period_percentage >= threshold) %>%
  select(variety, harvests, campaigns, period_percentage)

# Create combined classification for summaries
final_variety_classification <- bind_rows(
  debut_varieties %>% mutate(classification = "Début"),
  milieu_varieties %>% mutate(classification = "Milieu"), 
  fin_varieties %>% mutate(classification = "Fin")
) %>%
  rename(primary_harvests = harvests, primary_campaigns = campaigns, primary_percentage = period_percentage)

# Add campaign range information
variety_campaign_info <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(variety) %>%
  summarise(
    first_campaign = min(campaign),
    last_campaign = max(campaign),
    total_campaigns = n_distinct(campaign),
    total_harvests = n(),
    avg_surface = mean(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    maturant_used = sum(has_maturant, na.rm = TRUE),
    maturant_percentage = round(maturant_used / total_harvests * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Final classification with full information
complete_classification <- final_variety_classification %>%
  left_join(variety_campaign_info, by = "variety") %>%
  arrange(classification, desc(primary_harvests))

cat("Variety classification completed!\n")
cat("Total variety-period combinations:", nrow(complete_classification), "\n")
cat("Unique varieties classified:", n_distinct(complete_classification$variety), "\n")

# Summary by classification type
type_summary <- complete_classification %>%
  count(classification, name = "variety_period_count") %>%
  arrange(desc(variety_period_count))

cat("\nVarieties by harvest period:\n")
print(type_summary)

# ===== VISUALIZATIONS =====

cat("\n=== CREATING VISUALIZATIONS ===\n")

# Define color palette - only three periods
colors_period <- c(
  "Début" = "#2E8B57",    # Sea Green
  "Milieu" = "#DAA520",   # Goldenrod  
  "Fin" = "#CD853F"       # Peru
)

# Custom theme
theme_harvest <- function() {
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 15)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
  )
}

# PLOT 1: Overall harvest distribution by month
monthly_harvest <- analysis_data %>%
  count(harvest_month, harvest_month_name, period_simple) %>%
  mutate(harvest_month_name = factor(harvest_month_name, levels = month.name))

p1 <- ggplot(monthly_harvest, aes(x = harvest_month_name, y = n, fill = period_simple)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, color = "white", size = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_period, name = "Harvest Period") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(
    title = "Harvest Distribution by Month and Period",
    subtitle = "Number of harvests per month across all campaigns",
    x = "Month",
    y = "Number of Harvests"
  ) +
  theme_harvest()

print(p1)

# PLOT 2: Variety classification summary
classification_summary <- complete_classification %>%
  count(classification) %>%
  mutate(
    classification = factor(classification, levels = names(colors_period))
  )

p2 <- ggplot(classification_summary, aes(x = classification, y = n, fill = classification)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "white", size = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), vjust = -0.5, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_period, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Varieties by Harvest Period",
    subtitle = "Varieties with ≥25% harvests in period (varieties can appear in multiple periods)",
    x = "Harvest Period",
    y = "Number of Varieties"
  ) +
  theme_harvest()

print(p2)

# PLOT 3: Top varieties by classification with harvest counts
top_varieties_per_type <- complete_classification %>%
  group_by(classification) %>%
  slice_max(primary_harvests, n = 10) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    variety_label = paste0(variety, " (", primary_harvests, ")"),
    classification = factor(classification, levels = names(colors_period))
  )

p3 <- ggplot(top_varieties_per_type, aes(x = reorder(variety_label, primary_harvests), 
                                        y = primary_harvests, fill = classification)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", size = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_period, name = "Period") +
  facet_wrap(~ classification, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Varieties by Harvest Period",
    subtitle = "Number in parentheses shows harvest count in that period",
    x = "Variety (Harvest Count in Period)",
    y = "Number of Harvests in Period"
  ) +
  theme_harvest() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

print(p3)

# PLOT 4: Harvest timeline by variety type across campaigns
campaign_period_data <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(period_simple != "Other") %>%
  count(campaign, period_simple, harvest_month) %>%
  group_by(campaign, period_simple) %>%
  summarise(
    harvests = sum(n),
    months_active = n_distinct(harvest_month),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p4 <- ggplot(campaign_period_data, aes(x = campaign, y = harvests, fill = period_simple)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.8, color = "white", size = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_period, name = "Harvest Period") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(
    title = "Harvest Evolution by Period Across All Campaigns",
    subtitle = "Stacked view showing harvest distribution by period type",
    x = "Campaign",
    y = "Number of Harvests"
  ) +
  theme_harvest()

print(p4)

# PLOT 5: Maturant usage by variety type
maturant_analysis <- complete_classification %>%
  group_by(classification) %>%
  summarise(
    varieties = n(),
    avg_maturant_usage = mean(maturant_percentage, na.rm = TRUE),
    varieties_using_maturant = sum(maturant_percentage > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage_varieties_using = round(varieties_using_maturant / varieties * 100, 1)
  )

p5 <- ggplot(maturant_analysis, aes(x = classification, y = avg_maturant_usage, fill = classification)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, color = "white", size = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(avg_maturant_usage, 1), "%")), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_period, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)), labels = percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Maturant Usage by Variety Period Type",
    subtitle = "Percentage of harvests where maturant was used",
    x = "Variety Period",
    y = "Average Maturant Usage (%)"
  ) +
  theme_harvest()

print(p5)

# ===== DETAILED SUMMARIES =====

cat("\n=== DETAILED CLASSIFICATION SUMMARIES ===\n")

# Summary for each period type
for (period_type in c("Début", "Milieu", "Fin")) {
  cat("\n", toupper(period_type), "VARIETIES:\n")
  cat("=" , rep("=", nchar(period_type) + 12), "\n", sep = "")
  
  period_varieties <- complete_classification %>%
    filter(classification == period_type) %>%
    arrange(desc(primary_harvests))
  
  if (nrow(period_varieties) > 0) {
    cat("Total varieties in this period:", nrow(period_varieties), "\n")
    
    # Show all varieties for this period (up to 20)
    cat("\nVarieties in this period:\n")
    display_count <- min(20, nrow(period_varieties))
    
    for (i in 1:display_count) {
      variety_info <- period_varieties[i, ]
      
      cat(sprintf("%2d. %-25s: %3d harvests (%4.1f%% in %s) | Total: %3d | Campaigns: %s-%s | Maturant: %4.1f%%\n",
                  i,
                  variety_info$variety,
                  variety_info$primary_harvests,
                  variety_info$primary_percentage,
                  period_type,
                  variety_info$total_harvests,
                  variety_info$first_campaign,
                  variety_info$last_campaign,
                  variety_info$maturant_percentage))
    }
    
    if (nrow(period_varieties) > 20) {
      cat("... and", nrow(period_varieties) - 20, "more varieties\n")
    }
    
    # Period statistics
    period_stats <- period_varieties %>%
      summarise(
        avg_harvests_in_period = round(mean(primary_harvests), 1),
        avg_total_harvests = round(mean(total_harvests), 1),
        avg_campaigns = round(mean(total_campaigns), 1),
        avg_maturant = round(mean(maturant_percentage, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
        total_harvests_in_period = sum(primary_harvests),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    
    cat("\nPeriod Statistics:\n")
    cat("- Average harvests in this period per variety:", period_stats$avg_harvests_in_period, "\n")
    cat("- Average total harvests per variety:", period_stats$avg_total_harvests, "\n")
    cat("- Average campaigns per variety:", period_stats$avg_campaigns, "\n") 
    cat("- Average maturant usage:", period_stats$avg_maturant, "%\n")
    cat("- Total harvests in this period:", period_stats$total_harvests_in_period, "\n")
  } else {
    cat("No varieties found for this period.\n")
  }
}

# Overall summary
cat("\n\n=== OVERALL CLASSIFICATION SUMMARY ===\n")
overall_stats <- complete_classification %>%
  summarise(
    total_variety_period_combinations = n(),
    unique_varieties = n_distinct(variety),
    campaigns_span = paste(min(first_campaign), "-", max(last_campaign)),
    varieties_with_maturant = sum(maturant_percentage > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    percentage_using_maturant = round(sum(maturant_percentage > 0, na.rm = TRUE) / n() * 100, 1)
  )

cat("Total variety-period combinations:", overall_stats$total_variety_period_combinations, "\n")
cat("Unique varieties classified:", overall_stats$unique_varieties, "\n")
cat("Campaign span:", overall_stats$campaigns_span, "\n")
cat("Variety-period combinations using maturant:", overall_stats$varieties_with_maturant, 
    "(", overall_stats$percentage_using_maturant, "%)\n")

# Show varieties that appear in multiple periods
multi_period_varieties <- complete_classification %>%
  count(variety, name = "periods_count") %>%
  filter(periods_count > 1) %>%
  arrange(desc(periods_count))

if (nrow(multi_period_varieties) > 0) {
  cat("\n=== VARIETIES APPEARING IN MULTIPLE PERIODS ===\n")
  cat("Varieties used in multiple periods:", nrow(multi_period_varieties), "\n\n")
  
  for (i in 1:min(10, nrow(multi_period_varieties))) {
    variety_name <- multi_period_varieties$variety[i]
    variety_periods <- complete_classification %>%
      filter(variety == variety_name) %>%
      arrange(desc(primary_percentage))
    
    cat(sprintf("%-25s: ", variety_name))
    for (j in 1:nrow(variety_periods)) {
      cat(sprintf("%s (%d harvests, %.1f%%)", 
                  variety_periods$classification[j], 
                  variety_periods$primary_harvests[j],
                  variety_periods$primary_percentage[j]))
      if (j < nrow(variety_periods)) cat(" | ")
    }
    cat("\n")
  }
  
  if (nrow(multi_period_varieties) > 10) {
    cat("... and", nrow(multi_period_varieties) - 10, "more multi-period varieties\n")
  }
}

# Campaign evolution summary
campaign_evolution <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(period_simple != "Other") %>%
  count(campaign, period_simple) %>%
  spread(period_simple, n, fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(
    total = Début + Milieu + Fin,
    debut_pct = round(Début / total * 100, 1),
    milieu_pct = round(Milieu / total * 100, 1),
    fin_pct = round(Fin / total * 100, 1)
  )

cat("\nCampaign Evolution (Harvest Distribution %):\n")
cat("Campaign     | Début | Milieu | Fin  | Total Harvests\n")
cat("-------------|-------|--------|------|---------------\n")
for (i in 1:nrow(campaign_evolution)) {
  row <- campaign_evolution[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("%-12s | %5.1f | %6.1f | %4.1f | %13d\n", 
              row$campaign, row$debut_pct, row$milieu_pct, row$fin_pct, row$total))
}

# Save results to CSV
write.csv(complete_classification, "variety_classification_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Results saved to: variety_classification_results.csv\n")
```

```{r}
# Sugarcane Variety Classification Analysis
# Classify varieties by harvest period: début, milieu, fin de campagne

# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(gridExtra)
library(lubridate)

# Check if data exists
if (!exists("data")) {
  stop("Error: 'data' object not found. Please load your sugarcane dataset first.")
}

cat("=== SUGARCANE VARIETY CLASSIFICATION BY HARVEST PERIOD ===\n\n")

# Data preparation and cleaning
cat("=== DATA PREPARATION ===\n")

# Check data structure
cat("Dataset dimensions:", nrow(data), "rows x", ncol(data), "columns\n")

# Check for required columns
required_cols <- c("variety", "harvest_date", "maturant", "campaign")
missing_cols <- required_cols[!required_cols %in% names(data)]

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  cat("Warning: Missing columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
} else {
  cat("All required columns found!\n")
}

# Clean and prepare the analysis dataset
analysis_data <- data %>%
  # Ensure proper data types
  mutate(
    variety = toupper(as.character(variety)),  # Convert variety names to uppercase
    campaign = as.character(campaign),
    harvest_date = as.Date(harvest_date),
    maturant = as.character(maturant)
  ) %>%
  # Filter for valid data
  filter(
    !is.na(variety),
    !is.na(harvest_date),
    !is.na(campaign),
    variety != "",
    campaign != ""
  ) %>%
  # Extract harvest month information
  mutate(
    harvest_month = month(harvest_date),
    harvest_month_name = month.name[harvest_month],
    harvest_year = year(harvest_date),
    # Define harvest periods based on months
    harvest_period = case_when(
      harvest_month %in% c(10, 11, 12, 1) ~ "Début (Oct-Jan)",
      harvest_month %in% c(2, 3, 4) ~ "Milieu (Feb-Apr)", 
      harvest_month %in% c(5, 6, 7) ~ "Fin (May-Jul)",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    # Simplified period names
    period_simple = case_when(
      harvest_month %in% c(10, 11, 12, 1) ~ "Début",
      harvest_month %in% c(2, 3, 4) ~ "Milieu", 
      harvest_month %in% c(5, 6, 7) ~ "Fin",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    # Add maturant information
    has_maturant = !is.na(maturant) & maturant != "" & maturant != "0" & maturant != "None"
  )

# Data quality summary
cat("Data after cleaning:\n")
cat("Total observations:", nrow(analysis_data), "\n")
cat("Unique varieties:", n_distinct(analysis_data$variety), "\n")
cat("Unique campaigns:", n_distinct(analysis_data$campaign), "\n")
cat("Date range:", as.character(min(analysis_data$harvest_date)), "to", as.character(max(analysis_data$harvest_date)), "\n")

# Harvest period distribution
period_summary <- analysis_data %>%
  count(harvest_period) %>%
  mutate(percentage = round(n/sum(n)*100, 1))

cat("\nHarvest period distribution:\n")
print(period_summary)

# ===== VARIETY CLASSIFICATION =====

cat("\n=== VARIETY CLASSIFICATION BY HARVEST PERIOD ===\n")

variety_classification <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(period_simple != "Other") %>%
  group_by(variety, period_simple) %>%
  summarise(
    harvests = n(),
    campaigns = n_distinct(campaign),
    total_surface = sum(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "keep"
  ) %>%
  group_by(variety) %>%
  mutate(
    total_harvests = sum(harvests),
    period_percentage = round(harvests / total_harvests * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Simplified classification system: any harvest in a period qualifies the variety
# No threshold - even 1 harvest is enough to be classified in that period

# Create separate datasets for each period - no threshold filter
debut_varieties <- variety_classification %>%
  filter(period_simple == "Début") %>%
  select(variety, harvests, campaigns, period_percentage)

milieu_varieties <- variety_classification %>%

  summarise(
    harvests = sum(n),
    months_active = n_distinct(harvest_month),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p4 <- ggplot(campaign_period_data, aes(x = campaign, y = harvests, fill = period_simple)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.8, color = "white", size = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_period, name = "Harvest Period") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(
    title = "Harvest Evolution by Period Across All Campaigns",
    subtitle = "Stacked view showing harvest distribution by period type",
    x = "Campaign",
    y = "Number of Harvests"
  ) +
  theme_harvest()

print(p4)

# PLOT 5: Maturant usage by variety type
maturant_analysis <- complete_classification %>%
  group_by(classification) %>%
  summarise(
    varieties = n(),

  ) %>%
  mutate(

  )

p5 <- ggplot(maturant_analysis, aes(x = classification, y = avg_maturant_usage, fill = classification)) +

            vjust = -0.5, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_period, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)), labels = percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  labs(

print(p5)

# ===== DETAILED SUMMARIES =====

cat("\n=== DETAILED CLASSIFICATION SUMMARIES ===\n")

# Summary for each period type
for (period_type in c("Début", "Milieu", "Fin")) {
  cat("\n", toupper(period_type), "VARIETIES:\n")
  cat("=" , rep("=", nchar(period_type) + 12), "\n", sep = "")
  
  period_varieties <- complete_classification %>%
    filter(classification == period_type) %>%
    arrange(desc(primary_harvests))
  
  if (nrow(period_varieties) > 0) {
    cat("Total varieties in this period:", nrow(period_varieties), "\n")
    
    # Show all varieties for this period (up to 20)
    cat("\nVarieties in this period:\n")
    display_count <- min(20, nrow(period_varieties))
    
    for (i in 1:display_count) {
      variety_info <- period_varieties[i, ]
      
      cat(sprintf("%2d. %-25s: %3d harvests (%4.1f%% in %s) | Total: %3d | Campaigns: %s-%s | Maturant: %4.1f%%\n",
                  i,
                  variety_info$variety,
                  variety_info$primary_harvests,
                  variety_info$primary_percentage,
                  period_type,
                  variety_info$total_harvests,
                  variety_info$first_campaign,
                  variety_info$last_campaign,
                  variety_info$maturant_percentage))
    }
    
    if (nrow(period_varieties) > 20) {
      cat("... and", nrow(period_varieties) - 20, "more varieties\n")
    }
    
    # Period statistics
    period_stats <- period_varieties %>%
      summarise(
        avg_harvests_in_period = round(mean(primary_harvests), 1),
        avg_total_harvests = round(mean(total_harvests), 1),
        avg_campaigns = round(mean(total_campaigns), 1),
        avg_maturant = round(mean(maturant_percentage, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
        total_harvests_in_period = sum(primary_harvests),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    
    cat("\nPeriod Statistics:\n")
    cat("- Average harvests in this period per variety:", period_stats$avg_harvests_in_period, "\n")
    cat("- Average total harvests per variety:", period_stats$avg_total_harvests, "\n")
    cat("- Average campaigns per variety:", period_stats$avg_campaigns, "\n") 
    cat("- Average maturant usage:", period_stats$avg_maturant, "%\n")
    cat("- Total harvests in this period:", period_stats$total_harvests_in_period, "\n")
  } else {
    cat("No varieties found for this period.\n")
  }
}

# Overall summary
cat("\n\n=== OVERALL CLASSIFICATION SUMMARY ===\n")
overall_stats <- complete_classification %>%
  summarise(
    total_variety_period_combinations = n(),
    unique_varieties = n_distinct(variety),
    campaigns_span = paste(min(first_campaign), "-", max(last_campaign)),
    varieties_with_maturant = sum(maturant_percentage > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    percentage_using_maturant = round(sum(maturant_percentage > 0, na.rm = TRUE) / n() * 100, 1)
  )

cat("Total variety-period combinations:", overall_stats$total_variety_period_combinations, "\n")
cat("Unique varieties classified:", overall_stats$unique_varieties, "\n")
cat("Campaign span:", overall_stats$campaigns_span, "\n")
cat("Variety-period combinations using maturant:", overall_stats$varieties_with_maturant, 
    "(", overall_stats$percentage_using_maturant, "%)\n")

# Show varieties that appear in multiple periods
multi_period_varieties <- complete_classification %>%
  count(variety, name = "periods_count") %>%
  filter(periods_count > 1) %>%
  arrange(desc(periods_count))

if (nrow(multi_period_varieties) > 0) {
  cat("\n=== VARIETIES APPEARING IN MULTIPLE PERIODS ===\n")
  cat("Varieties used in multiple periods:", nrow(multi_period_varieties), "\n\n")
  
  for (i in 1:min(10, nrow(multi_period_varieties))) {

    cat(sprintf("%-25s: ", variety_name))
    for (j in 1:nrow(variety_periods)) {

                  variety_periods$primary_harvests[j],

      if (j < nrow(variety_periods)) cat(" | ")
    }
    cat("\n")

  if (nrow(multi_period_varieties) > 10) {
    cat("... and", nrow(multi_period_varieties) - 10, "more multi-period varieties\n")
  }
}

# Campaign evolution summary
campaign_evolution <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(period_simple != "Other") %>%
  count(campaign, period_simple) %>%
  spread(period_simple, n, fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(
    total = Début + Milieu + Fin,
    debut_pct = round(Début / total * 100, 1),
    milieu_pct = round(Milieu / total * 100, 1),

  )

cat("\nCampaign Evolution (Harvest Distribution %):\n")

for (i in 1:nrow(campaign_evolution)) {
  row <- campaign_evolution[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("%-12s | %5.1f | %6.1f | %4.1f | %13d\n", 
              row$campaign, row$debut_pct, row$milieu_pct, row$fin_pct, row$total))
}

# Save results to CSV
write.csv(complete_classification, "variety_classification_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Results saved to: variety_classification_results.csv\n")
```

## III.4. Maturant Usage Analysis with Campaign Evolution

```{r}
# Maturant Usage Analysis with Campaign Evolution
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(gridExtra)
library(forcats)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)

# Check if data exists
if (!exists("data")) {
  stop("Error: 'data' object not found. Please load your sugarcane dataset first.")
}

cat("=== ENHANCED MATURANT CAMPAIGN ANALYSIS ===\n\n")

# Data preparation and cleaning
cat("=== DATA PREPARATION ===\n")

# Prepare maturant analysis data
maturant_data <- data %>%
  # Ensure proper data types and uppercase variety names
  mutate(
    variety = toupper(as.character(variety)),
    campaign = as.character(campaign),
    maturant = as.character(maturant),
    harvest_date = as.Date(harvest_date),
    surface_area_ha = as.numeric(surface_area_ha)
  ) %>%
  # Filter for records with maturant information
  filter(
    !is.na(variety),
    !is.na(maturant),
    !is.na(campaign),
    variety != "",
    campaign != "",
    # Filter out non-maturant entries
    maturant != "",
    maturant != "0", 
    maturant != "NA",
    maturant != "None",
    !is.na(maturant),
    maturant != "#N/A",
    maturant != "#VALEUR!",
    maturant != "#NULL!",
    maturant != "#DIV/0!"
  ) %>%
  # Clean maturant names
  mutate(
    maturant = str_trim(toupper(maturant)),
    maturant = str_replace_all(maturant, "[\\s\\-_]+", " "),  # Standardize separators
    maturant = str_replace_all(maturant, "\\s+", " ")        # Remove extra spaces
  ) %>%
  # Add harvest month information if harvest_date is available
  mutate(
    harvest_month = if("harvest_date" %in% names(.) && !all(is.na(harvest_date))) 
                      month(harvest_date) else NA,
    harvest_period = case_when(
      !is.na(harvest_month) & harvest_month %in% c(10, 11, 12, 1) ~ "Début (Oct-Jan)",
      !is.na(harvest_month) & harvest_month %in% c(2, 3, 4) ~ "Milieu (Feb-Apr)", 
      !is.na(harvest_month) & harvest_month %in% c(5, 6, 7) ~ "Fin (May-Jul)",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

cat("Data after cleaning:\n")
cat("Total maturant applications:", nrow(maturant_data), "\n")
cat("Unique varieties with maturant:", n_distinct(maturant_data$variety), "\n")
cat("Unique campaigns with maturant:", n_distinct(maturant_data$campaign), "\n")
cat("Campaign range:", min(maturant_data$campaign, na.rm = TRUE), "to", max(maturant_data$campaign, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# ===== CAMPAIGN-SPECIFIC ANALYSIS =====

cat("\n=== CAMPAIGN-SPECIFIC SURFACE AREA ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Surface area by campaign
campaign_surface_summary <- maturant_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(surface_area_ha)) %>%
  group_by(campaign) %>%
  summarise(
    total_surface_ha = round(sum(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    applications = n(),
    unique_maturants = n_distinct(maturant),
    unique_varieties = n_distinct(variety),
    avg_surface_per_app = round(mean(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(campaign)

cat("SURFACE AREA BY CAMPAIGN:\n")
cat("=" , rep("=", 25), "\n", sep = "")
for (i in 1:nrow(campaign_surface_summary)) {
  camp_info <- campaign_surface_summary[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("Campaign %s: %8.2f ha | %4d apps | %2d maturants | %3d varieties\n",
              camp_info$campaign,
              camp_info$total_surface_ha,
              camp_info$applications,
              camp_info$unique_maturants,
              camp_info$unique_varieties))
}

# ===== MATURANT EVOLUTION ANALYSIS =====

cat("\n=== MATURANT EVOLUTION ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Track maturant usage by campaign
maturant_campaign_matrix <- maturant_data %>%
  group_by(campaign, maturant) %>%
  summarise(
    applications = n(),
    surface_area = sum(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    varieties = n_distinct(variety),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(campaign, maturant)

# Create maturant evolution tracking
all_campaigns <- sort(unique(maturant_data$campaign))
all_maturants <- unique(maturant_data$maturant)

# For each maturant, track its usage across campaigns
maturant_evolution <- expand.grid(
  campaign = all_campaigns,
  maturant = all_maturants,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  left_join(maturant_campaign_matrix, by = c("campaign", "maturant")) %>%
  mutate(
    applications = ifelse(is.na(applications), 0, applications),
    surface_area = ifelse(is.na(surface_area), 0, surface_area),
    varieties = ifelse(is.na(varieties), 0, varieties),
    used = applications > 0
  ) %>%
  arrange(maturant, campaign)

# Categorize maturant usage patterns
maturant_usage_patterns <- maturant_evolution %>%
  group_by(maturant) %>%
  summarise(
    first_campaign = min(campaign[used]),
    last_campaign = max(campaign[used]),
    total_campaigns = sum(used),
    total_applications = sum(applications),
    total_surface = sum(surface_area),
    campaigns_used = paste(campaign[used], collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    usage_pattern = case_when(
      first_campaign == min(all_campaigns) & last_campaign == max(all_campaigns) ~ "Consistent (All periods)",
      total_campaigns >= length(all_campaigns) * 0.75 ~ "Frequent (Most periods)",
      total_campaigns >= 3 ~ "Regular (Multiple periods)",
      total_campaigns == 2 ~ "Limited (Two periods)",
      TRUE ~ "Single use"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_applications))

cat("MATURANT USAGE PATTERNS:\n")
cat("=" , rep("=", 25), "\n", sep = "")
pattern_summary <- maturant_usage_patterns %>%
  count(usage_pattern) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

for (i in 1:nrow(pattern_summary)) {
  cat(sprintf("%-25s: %2d maturants\n", pattern_summary$usage_pattern[i], pattern_summary$n[i]))
}

# ===== ENHANCED VISUALIZATIONS =====

cat("\n=== CREATING ENHANCED CAMPAIGN VISUALIZATIONS ===\n")

# Custom theme
theme_campaign <- function() {
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 15)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "gray80")
  )
}

# PLOT 1: Surface area evolution by campaign
p1 <- ggplot(campaign_surface_summary, aes(x = campaign)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = total_surface_ha), fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
  geom_line(aes(y = unique_maturants * max(total_surface_ha)/max(unique_maturants), group = 1), 
            color = "red", size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(y = unique_maturants * max(total_surface_ha)/max(unique_maturants)), 
             color = "red", size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Total Surface Area (hectares)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * max(campaign_surface_summary$unique_maturants) / max(campaign_surface_summary$total_surface_ha), 
                        name = "Number of Unique Maturants", 
                        labels = comma_format()),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)),
    labels = comma_format()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Maturant Usage Evolution by Campaign",
    subtitle = "Blue bars: Total surface area treated | Red line: Number of unique maturants used",
    x = "Campaign"
  ) +
  theme_campaign() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y.left = element_text(color = "steelblue"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "red"),
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(color = "red")
  )

print(p1)

# PLOT 2: Maturant usage timeline heatmap
top_maturants_timeline <- head(maturant_usage_patterns, 15)$maturant

timeline_data <- maturant_evolution %>%
  filter(maturant %in% top_maturants_timeline) %>%
  mutate(
    maturant = factor(maturant, levels = rev(top_maturants_timeline)),
    log_applications = log10(applications + 1)
  )

p2 <- ggplot(timeline_data, aes(x = campaign, y = maturant, fill = log_applications)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = filter(timeline_data, applications > 0), 
            aes(label = applications), color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Applications\n(log10 scale)", 
                       labels = function(x) round(10^x - 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Maturant Usage Timeline Heatmap",
    subtitle = "Numbers show actual applications per campaign (empty = not used)",
    x = "Campaign",
    y = "Maturant"
  ) +
  theme_campaign() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.height = unit(1, "cm")
  )

print(p2)

# PLOT 3: Maturant introduction and discontinuation
maturant_lifecycle <- maturant_evolution %>%
  group_by(maturant) %>%
  summarise(
    first_use = min(campaign[used]),
    last_use = max(campaign[used]),
    total_campaigns = sum(used),
    peak_applications = max(applications),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(total_campaigns > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    status = case_when(
      last_use == max(all_campaigns) ~ "Active",
      last_use == max(all_campaigns[all_campaigns != max(all_campaigns)]) ~ "Recently Discontinued",
      TRUE ~ "Discontinued"
    ),
    duration = as.numeric(factor(last_use)) - as.numeric(factor(first_use)) + 1
  )

p3 <- ggplot(maturant_lifecycle, aes(x = first_use, y = reorder(maturant, peak_applications))) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = last_use, yend = maturant, color = status), size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(size = peak_applications, color = status), alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Active" = "darkgreen", 
                                "Recently Discontinued" = "orange", 
                                "Discontinued" = "red"),
                     name = "Status") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Peak\nApplications", range = c(2, 8)) +
  labs(
    title = "Maturant Lifecycle Analysis",
    subtitle = "Timeline showing introduction, usage period, and current status",
    x = "Campaign",
    y = "Maturant (ordered by peak usage)"
  ) +
  theme_campaign() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))

print(p3)

# PLOT 4: New vs Continuing vs Discontinued maturants by campaign
maturant_status_by_campaign <- data.frame()

for (i in 2:length(all_campaigns)) {
  current_campaign <- all_campaigns[i]
  previous_campaign <- all_campaigns[i-1]
  
  current_maturants <- unique(maturant_data$maturant[maturant_data$campaign == current_campaign])
  previous_maturants <- unique(maturant_data$maturant[maturant_data$campaign == previous_campaign])
  
  new_maturants <- setdiff(current_maturants, previous_maturants)
  continuing_maturants <- intersect(current_maturants, previous_maturants)
  discontinued_maturants <- setdiff(previous_maturants, current_maturants)
  
  campaign_status <- data.frame(
    campaign = current_campaign,
    category = c("New", "Continuing", "Discontinued"),
    count = c(length(new_maturants), length(continuing_maturants), length(discontinued_maturants))
  )
  
  maturant_status_by_campaign <- rbind(maturant_status_by_campaign, campaign_status)
}

p4 <- ggplot(maturant_status_by_campaign, aes(x = campaign, y = count, fill = category)) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c("New" = "lightgreen", 
                               "Continuing" = "steelblue", 
                               "Discontinued" = "salmon"),
                    name = "Maturant Status") +
  labs(
    title = "Maturant Portfolio Evolution",
    subtitle = "Changes in maturant usage between consecutive campaigns",

  ) +
  theme_campaign()

p5 <- ggplot(surface_by_campaign_maturant, aes(x = campaign, y = surface_area, fill = maturant)) +

  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma_format(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(

    x = "Campaign",
    y = "Surface Area (hectares)"
  ) +
  theme_campaign() +

print(p5)

# PLOT 6: Maturant diversity index by campaign
diversity_by_campaign <- maturant_data %>%
  group_by(campaign) %>%
  summarise(
    total_applications = n(),
    unique_maturants = n_distinct(maturant),
    shannon_diversity = -sum((table(maturant)/n()) * log(table(maturant)/n())),

  )

p6 <- ggplot(diversity_by_campaign, aes(x = campaign)) +

            color = "darkred", size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +

             color = "darkred", size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Number of Unique Maturants",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * max(diversity_by_campaign$shannon_diversity) / max(diversity_by_campaign$unique_maturants), 
                        name = "Shannon Diversity Index"),

    title = "Maturant Diversity Evolution",

  ) +

  theme(
    axis.title.y.left = element_text(color = "steelblue"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "darkred"),
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(color = "darkred")
  )

print(p6)

# ===== DETAILED CAMPAIGN SUMMARIES =====

cat("\n=== DETAILED CAMPAIGN-SPECIFIC SUMMARIES ===\n")

# Summary for each campaign
for (campaign_name in all_campaigns) {
  cat("\n", toupper(paste("CAMPAIGN", campaign_name)), "\n")
  cat("=" , rep("=", nchar(campaign_name) + 10), "\n", sep = "")
  
  campaign_data <- filter(maturant_data, campaign == campaign_name)
  
  campaign_stats <- list(
    applications = nrow(campaign_data),
    surface_area = round(sum(campaign_data$surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    unique_maturants = n_distinct(campaign_data$maturant),
    unique_varieties = n_distinct(campaign_data$variety),
    avg_surface_per_app = round(mean(campaign_data$surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  )
  
  cat("Applications:", campaign_stats$applications, "\n")
  cat("Surface area:", campaign_stats$surface_area, "hectares\n")
  cat("Unique maturants:", campaign_stats$unique_maturants, "\n")
  cat("Unique varieties:", campaign_stats$unique_varieties, "\n")
  cat("Avg surface per application:", campaign_stats$avg_surface_per_app, "hectares\n")
  
  # Top maturants for this campaign
  campaign_maturants <- campaign_data %>%
    group_by(maturant) %>%
    summarise(
      applications = n(),
      surface_area = round(sum(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      varieties = n_distinct(variety),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(applications)) %>%
    head(8)
  
  cat("\nTop maturants used:\n")
  for (j in 1:nrow(campaign_maturants)) {
    mat_info <- campaign_maturants[j, ]
    cat(sprintf("  %2d. %-20s: %3d apps (%6.1f ha, %2d varieties)\n",
                j, mat_info$maturant, mat_info$applications, 
                mat_info$surface_area, mat_info$varieties))
  }
  
  # Compare with previous campaign if available
  if (campaign_name != all_campaigns[1]) {
    prev_campaign <- all_campaigns[which(all_campaigns == campaign_name) - 1]
    prev_maturants <- unique(filter(maturant_data, campaign == prev_campaign)$maturant)
    current_maturants <- unique(campaign_data$maturant)
    
    new_maturants <- setdiff(current_maturants, prev_maturants)
    discontinued_maturants <- setdiff(prev_maturants, current_maturants)
    
    if (length(new_maturants) > 0) {
      cat("\nNew maturants introduced:", paste(new_maturants, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    }
    if (length(discontinued_maturants) > 0) {
      cat("Discontinued maturants:", paste(discontinued_maturants, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    }
  }
}

# ===== MATURANT EVOLUTION SUMMARY =====

cat("\n\n=== MATURANT EVOLUTION SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("=" , rep("=", 28), "\n", sep = "")

cat("USAGE PATTERNS:\n")
for (i in 1:nrow(pattern_summary)) {
  pattern_maturants <- filter(maturant_usage_patterns, usage_pattern == pattern_summary$usage_pattern[i])
  cat("\n", pattern_summary$usage_pattern[i], "(", pattern_summary$n[i], "maturants):\n")
  
  if (nrow(pattern_maturants) <= 5) {
    for (j in 1:nrow(pattern_maturants)) {
      mat <- pattern_maturants[j, ]
      cat(sprintf("  - %-15s: %s to %s (%d campaigns, %d applications)\n",
                  mat$maturant, mat$first_campaign, mat$last_campaign, 
                  mat$total_campaigns, mat$total_applications))
    }
  } else {
    top_5 <- head(arrange(pattern_maturants, desc(total_applications)), 5)
    for (j in 1:nrow(top_5)) {
      mat <- top_5[j, ]
      cat(sprintf("  - %-15s: %s to %s (%d campaigns, %d applications)\n",
                  mat$maturant, mat$first_campaign, mat$last_campaign, 
                  mat$total_campaigns, mat$total_applications))
    }
    cat("  ... and", nrow(pattern_maturants) - 5, "others\n")
  }
}

# Overall evolution summary
total_surface_all_campaigns <- sum(campaign_surface_summary$total_surface_ha)
cat("\n\nOVERALL SUMMARY:\n")
cat("Total surface area across all campaigns:", round(total_surface_all_campaigns, 2), "hectares\n")
cat("Average surface area per campaign:", round(mean(campaign_surface_summary$total_surface_ha), 2), "hectares\n")
cat("Campaign with highest maturant usage:", 
    campaign_surface_summary$campaign[which.max(campaign_surface_summary$total_surface_ha)], 
    "(", max(campaign_surface_summary$total_surface_ha), "hectares)\n")

# Identify trends
if (nrow(campaign_surface_summary) > 1) {
  surface_trend <- lm(total_surface_ha ~ as.numeric(factor(campaign)), data = campaign_surface_summary)
  maturant_trend <- lm(unique_maturants ~ as.numeric(factor(campaign)), data = campaign_surface_summary)
  
  cat("\nTrends over time:\n")
  cat("Surface area trend:", ifelse(coef(surface_trend)[2] > 0, "Increasing", "Decreasing"), "\n")
  cat("Maturant diversity trend:", ifelse(coef(maturant_trend)[2] > 0, "Increasing", "Decreasing"), "\n")
}

cat("\n=== ENHANCED CAMPAIGN ANALYSIS COMPLETED ===\n")
cat("All campaign-specific visualizations and summaries generated successfully!\n")

# Save enhanced results
write.csv(campaign_surface_summary, "campaign_surface_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(maturant_usage_patterns, "maturant_usage_patterns.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(maturant_campaign_matrix, "maturant_campaign_matrix.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## III.5. Sugarcane Crop Cycle and Replanting Pattern Analysis

```{r}
# 
# Analyze variety longevity, replanting frequency, and repousse patterns

# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(gridExtra)
library(forcats)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)

# Check if data exists
if (!exists("data")) {
  stop("Error: 'data' object not found. Please load your sugarcane dataset first.")
}

cat("=== SUGARCANE CROP CYCLE & REPLANTING ANALYSIS ===\n\n")

# First, let's examine the actual crop_cycle column
cat("=== EXAMINING CROP_CYCLE COLUMN ===\n")

if ("crop_cycle" %in% names(data)) {
  # Get unique values in crop_cycle
  unique_cycles <- unique(data$crop_cycle)
  unique_cycles <- unique_cycles[!is.na(unique_cycles)]
  unique_cycles_sorted <- sort(unique_cycles[!unique_cycles %in% c("Essais", "Friche", "Jachere", "Lessivage")])
  special_categories <- unique_cycles[unique_cycles %in% c("Essais", "Friche", "Jachere", "Lessivage")]
  
  cat("Unique values in crop_cycle column:\n")
  print(unique_cycles)
  
  cat("\nNumeric crop cycle values:", paste(unique_cycles_sorted, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Special categories:", paste(special_categories, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Detailed analysis of all categories including special ones
  cycle_analysis <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(crop_cycle)) %>%
    mutate(
      variety = toupper(as.character(variety)),
      campaign = as.character(campaign),
      surface_area_ha = as.numeric(surface_area_ha)
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(variety),
      !is.na(campaign), 
      !is.na(surface_area_ha),
      variety != "",
      campaign != "",
      surface_area_ha > 0
    ) %>%
    group_by(crop_cycle) %>%
    summarise(
      records = n(),
      surface_area = sum(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
      unique_varieties = n_distinct(variety),
      unique_campaigns = n_distinct(campaign),
      avg_surface_per_record = round(mean(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(surface_area)) %>%
    mutate(
      records_pct = round(records/sum(records) * 100, 1),
      surface_pct = round(surface_area/sum(surface_area) * 100, 1),
      category_type = ifelse(crop_cycle %in% c("Essais", "Friche", "Jachere", "Lessivage"), 
                            "Special Category", "Numeric Cycle")
    )
  
  cat("\nCOMPLETE CROP_CYCLE ANALYSIS (INCLUDING SPECIAL CATEGORIES):\n")
  cat("=" , rep("=", 58), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("Crop Cycle       | Type     | Records | Surface(ha) | Surface% | Records% | Varieties | Campaigns\n")
  cat("-" , rep("-", 95), "\n", sep = "")
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(cycle_analysis)) {
    cycle_info <- cycle_analysis[i, ]
    cat(sprintf("%-16s | %-8s | %7d | %11.1f | %7.1f%% | %7.1f%% | %9d | %9d\n",
                cycle_info$crop_cycle,
                cycle_info$category_type,
                cycle_info$records,
                cycle_info$surface_area,
                cycle_info$surface_pct,
                cycle_info$records_pct,
                cycle_info$unique_varieties,
                cycle_info$unique_campaigns))
  }
  
  # Focus on special categories
  special_categories_analysis <- cycle_analysis %>%
    filter(category_type == "Special Category") %>%
    arrange(desc(surface_area))
  
  cat("\nSPECIAL CATEGORIES DETAILED ANALYSIS:\n")
  cat("=" , rep("=", 37), "\n", sep = "")
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(special_categories_analysis)) {
    special_info <- special_categories_analysis[i, ]
    cat("\n", toupper(as.character(special_info$crop_cycle)), ":\n")
    cat("- Records:", special_info$records, "(", special_info$records_pct, "% of total)\n")
    cat("- Surface area:", round(special_info$surface_area, 1), "hectares (", special_info$surface_pct, "% of total)\n")
    cat("- Unique varieties:", special_info$unique_varieties, "\n")
    cat("- Unique campaigns:", special_info$unique_campaigns, "\n")
    cat("- Average surface per record:", special_info$avg_surface_per_record, "hectares\n")
    
    # Show varieties for special categories
    special_varieties <- data %>%
      filter(crop_cycle == special_info$crop_cycle, !is.na(variety), variety != "") %>%
      mutate(variety = toupper(as.character(variety))) %>%
      group_by(variety) %>%
      summarise(
        records = n(),
        surface_area = sum(as.numeric(surface_area_ha), na.rm = TRUE),
        campaigns = n_distinct(campaign),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(surface_area)) %>%
      head(10)
    
    if (nrow(special_varieties) > 0) {
      cat("- Top varieties:\n")
      for (j in 1:min(5, nrow(special_varieties))) {
        var_info <- special_varieties[j, ]
        cat("  ", j, ". ", var_info$variety, " (", round(var_info$surface_area, 1), " ha, ", 
            var_info$records, " records)\n", sep = "")
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Create visualization of all categories before filtering
  cat("\n=== CREATING PRE-FILTERING VISUALIZATION ===\n")
  
  # Custom theme
  theme_cycle <- function() {
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 15)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.5),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "gray80")
    )
  }
  
  # Plot 0: Complete crop_cycle distribution including special categories
  p0 <- ggplot(cycle_analysis, aes(x = reorder(crop_cycle, surface_area), y = surface_area, 
                                   fill = category_type)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "white", size = 0.5) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(surface_pct, "%")), hjust = -0.1, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Numeric Cycle" = "steelblue", "Special Category" = "orange"),
                      name = "Category Type") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)), labels = comma_format()) +
    labs(
      title = "Complete Crop Cycle Distribution - Before Filtering",
      subtitle = "All categories including special non-numeric values",
      x = "Crop Cycle / Category",
      y = "Surface Area (hectares)"
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_cycle()
  
  print(p0)
  
  # Plot 0b: Records count comparison
  p0b <- ggplot(cycle_analysis, aes(x = reorder(crop_cycle, records), y = records, 
                                    fill = category_type)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "white", size = 0.5) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(records_pct, "%")), hjust = -0.1, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Numeric Cycle" = "darkgreen", "Special Category" = "red"),
                      name = "Category Type") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)), labels = comma_format()) +
    labs(
      title = "Complete Crop Cycle Records Distribution - Before Filtering", 
      subtitle = "Number of records by category type",
      x = "Crop Cycle / Category",
      y = "Number of Records"
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_cycle()
  
  print(p0b)
  
  # Get numeric range for main analysis
  numeric_cycles <- as.numeric(unique_cycles_sorted)
  numeric_cycles <- numeric_cycles[!is.na(numeric_cycles)]
  
  cat("\nNumeric crop cycle range for main analysis:", min(numeric_cycles), "to", max(numeric_cycles), "\n")
  cat("Total special category records to be excluded:", sum(special_categories_analysis$records), "\n")
  cat("Total special category surface to be excluded:", round(sum(special_categories_analysis$surface_area), 1), "hectares\n")
  
} else {
  stop("Error: 'crop_cycle' column not found in the dataset!")
}

# Data preparation and cleaning (now filtering out special categories)
cat("\n=== DATA PREPARATION (FILTERING NUMERIC CYCLES ONLY) ===\n")

# Prepare crop cycle analysis data - only numeric cycles
crop_data <- data %>%
  # Ensure proper data types and uppercase variety names
  mutate(
    variety = toupper(as.character(variety)),
    campaign = as.character(campaign),
    crop_cycle_raw = crop_cycle,
    crop_cycle = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(crop_cycle))),
    surface_area_ha = as.numeric(surface_area_ha)
  ) %>%
  # Filter for valid records - ONLY NUMERIC CYCLES
  filter(
    !is.na(variety),
    !is.na(campaign),
    !is.na(crop_cycle),  # This now excludes Essais, Friche, Jachere, Lessivage
    !is.na(surface_area_ha),
    variety != "",
    campaign != "",
    surface_area_ha > 0,
    crop_cycle >= 0  # Ensure only non-negative numeric cycles
  ) %>%
  # Clean variety names
  mutate(
    variety = str_trim(variety),
    variety = str_replace_all(variety, "\\s+", " ")
  ) %>%
  # Create cycle categories based on actual numeric data range
  mutate(
    cycle_category = case_when(
      crop_cycle == 0 ~ "Plant Cane (0)",
      crop_cycle == 1 ~ "1st Repousse (1)", 
      crop_cycle == 2 ~ "2nd Repousse (2)",
      crop_cycle == 3 ~ "3rd Repousse (3)",
      crop_cycle == 4 ~ "4th Repousse (4)",
      crop_cycle == 5 ~ "5th Repousse (5)",
      crop_cycle == 6 ~ "6th Repousse (6)",
      crop_cycle == 7 ~ "7th Repousse (7)",
      crop_cycle == 8 ~ "8th Repousse (8)",
      crop_cycle == 9 ~ "9th Repousse (9)",
      crop_cycle == 10 ~ "10th Repousse (10)",
      crop_cycle == 11 ~ "11th Repousse (11)",
      crop_cycle == 12 ~ "12th Repousse (12)",
      crop_cycle == 13 ~ "13th Repousse (13)",
      crop_cycle == 14 ~ "14th Repousse (14)",
      crop_cycle == 15 ~ "15th Repousse (15)",
      crop_cycle == 16 ~ "16th Repousse (16)",
      crop_cycle == 17 ~ "17th Repousse (17)",
      crop_cycle == 18 ~ "18th Repousse (18)",
      crop_cycle >= 19 ~ paste0(crop_cycle, "th Repousse (", crop_cycle, ")"),
      TRUE ~ paste0("Cycle ", crop_cycle)
    )
  ) %>%
  # Extract numeric year from campaign for temporal analysis
  mutate(
    campaign_start_year = case_when(
      str_detect(campaign, "^\\d{2}-\\d{2}$") ~ as.numeric(paste0("20", str_sub(campaign, 1, 2))),
      str_detect(campaign, "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}$") ~ as.numeric(str_sub(campaign, 1, 4)),
      str_detect(campaign, "^\\d{4}-\\d{4}$") ~ as.numeric(str_sub(campaign, 1, 4)),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    campaign_end_year = campaign_start_year + 1
  ) %>%
  # Sort by variety, campaign, and cycle for tracking
  arrange(variety, campaign, crop_cycle)

# Show what was filtered out
excluded_records <- data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(crop_cycle),
    crop_cycle %in% c("Essais", "Friche", "Jachere", "Lessivage")
  ) %>%
  nrow()

total_excluded_surface <- data %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(crop_cycle),
    crop_cycle %in% c("Essais", "Friche", "Jachere", "Lessivage"),
    !is.na(surface_area_ha)
  ) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(as.numeric(surface_area_ha), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  pull(total)

cat("FILTERING RESULTS:\n")
cat("Records excluded (special categories):", excluded_records, "\n")
cat("Surface area excluded:", round(total_excluded_surface, 2), "hectares\n")
cat("Records retained (numeric cycles):", nrow(crop_data), "\n")
cat("Surface area retained:", round(sum(crop_data$surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "hectares\n")

cat("\nData after cleaning (NUMERIC CYCLES ONLY):\n")
cat("Total records with numeric crop cycle:", nrow(crop_data), "\n")
cat("Unique varieties:", n_distinct(crop_data$variety), "\n")
cat("Unique campaigns:", n_distinct(crop_data$campaign), "\n")
cat("Numeric crop cycle range:", min(crop_data$crop_cycle, na.rm = TRUE), "to", max(crop_data$crop_cycle, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

cat("\n=== CROP CYCLE DISTRIBUTION ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Overall crop cycle distribution
cycle_distribution <- crop_data %>%
  group_by(crop_cycle) %>%
  summarise(
    records = n(),
    surface_area = sum(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    unique_varieties = n_distinct(variety),
    unique_campaigns = n_distinct(campaign),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(crop_cycle) %>%
  mutate(
    records_pct = round(records/sum(records) * 100, 1),
    surface_pct = round(surface_area/sum(surface_area) * 100, 1),
    cycle_name = case_when(
      crop_cycle == 0 ~ "Plant Cane",
      crop_cycle == 1 ~ "1st Repousse",
      crop_cycle == 2 ~ "2nd Repousse", 
      crop_cycle == 3 ~ "3rd Repousse",
      crop_cycle == 4 ~ "4th Repousse",
      crop_cycle == 5 ~ "5th Repousse",
      crop_cycle == 6 ~ "6th Repousse",
      crop_cycle == 7 ~ "7th Repousse",
      crop_cycle == 8 ~ "8th Repousse",
      crop_cycle == 9 ~ "9th Repousse",
      crop_cycle >= 10 ~ paste0(crop_cycle, "th Repousse"),
      TRUE ~ paste0("Cycle ", crop_cycle)
    )
  )

cat("ACTUAL CROP CYCLE DISTRIBUTION:\n")
cat("=" , rep("=", 32), "\n", sep = "")
for (i in 1:nrow(cycle_distribution)) {
  cycle_info <- cycle_distribution[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("%-18s (Cycle %2d): %5d records (%5.1f%%) | %8.1f ha (%5.1f%%) | %3d varieties\n",
              cycle_info$cycle_name,
              cycle_info$crop_cycle,
              cycle_info$records,
              cycle_info$records_pct,
              cycle_info$surface_area,
              cycle_info$surface_pct,
              cycle_info$unique_varieties))
}

# ===== VARIETY-SPECIFIC CYCLE ANALYSIS =====

cat("\n=== VARIETY-SPECIFIC CYCLE ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Calculate variety statistics
variety_cycle_stats <- crop_data %>%
  group_by(variety) %>%
  summarise(
    total_records = n(),
    total_surface = sum(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    campaigns = n_distinct(campaign),
    min_cycle = min(crop_cycle, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_cycle = max(crop_cycle, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_cycle = round(mean(crop_cycle, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    weighted_avg_cycle = round(weighted.mean(crop_cycle, surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    plant_cane_records = sum(crop_cycle == min(crop_data$crop_cycle, na.rm = TRUE)),
    repousse_records = sum(crop_cycle > min(crop_data$crop_cycle, na.rm = TRUE)),
    plant_cane_surface = sum(surface_area_ha[crop_cycle == min(crop_data$crop_cycle, na.rm = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE),
    repousse_surface = sum(surface_area_ha[crop_cycle > min(crop_data$crop_cycle, na.rm = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE),
    first_campaign = min(campaign),
    last_campaign = max(campaign),
    years_cultivated = n_distinct(campaign),
    cycles_present = paste(sort(unique(crop_cycle)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    repousse_ratio = round(repousse_records / total_records * 100, 1),
    repousse_surface_ratio = round(repousse_surface / total_surface * 100, 1),
    cycle_range = max_cycle - min_cycle,
    longevity_score = max_cycle + 1  # Total potential cycles
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_surface))

# Display top varieties
cat("TOP 15 VARIETIES BY TOTAL SURFACE AREA:\n")
cat("=" , rep("=", 39), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Variety          | Surface(ha) | Campaigns | Min-Max Cycle | Avg Cycle | Repousse% | Cycles Present\n")
cat("-" , rep("-", 95), "\n", sep = "")
for (i in 1:min(15, nrow(variety_cycle_stats))) {
  var_info <- variety_cycle_stats[i, ]
  cycles_short <- if(nchar(var_info$cycles_present) > 15) {
    paste0(str_sub(var_info$cycles_present, 1, 12), "...")
  } else {
    var_info$cycles_present
  }
  cat(sprintf("%-16s | %9.1f | %9d | %4d - %-6d | %9.2f | %8.1f%% | %s\n",
              var_info$variety,
              var_info$total_surface,
              var_info$campaigns,
              var_info$min_cycle,
              var_info$max_cycle,
              var_info$weighted_avg_cycle,
              var_info$repousse_surface_ratio,
              cycles_short))
}

# ===== TOP VARIETY REPOUSSE EVOLUTION ANALYSIS =====

cat("\n=== TOP VARIETY REPOUSSE EVOLUTION ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Identify top varieties by total surface area
top_varieties_by_surface <- variety_cycle_stats %>%
  arrange(desc(total_surface)) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  pull(variety)

cat("Top 10 varieties by surface area:", paste(top_varieties_by_surface, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Detailed repousse evolution for top varieties
repousse_evolution <- crop_data %>%
  filter(variety %in% top_varieties_by_surface) %>%
  group_by(variety, campaign, campaign_start_year) %>%
  summarise(
    total_surface = sum(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_cycle = min(crop_cycle, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_cycle = max(crop_cycle, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_cycle = round(weighted.mean(crop_cycle, surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    plant_cane_surface = sum(surface_area_ha[crop_cycle == min(crop_data$crop_cycle, na.rm = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE),
    repousse_surface = sum(surface_area_ha[crop_cycle > min(crop_data$crop_cycle, na.rm = TRUE)], na.rm = TRUE),
    repousse_percentage = round(repousse_surface / total_surface * 100, 1),
    cycles_0_2 = sum(surface_area_ha[crop_cycle <= 2], na.rm = TRUE),
    cycles_3_5 = sum(surface_area_ha[crop_cycle >= 3 & crop_cycle <= 5], na.rm = TRUE),
    cycles_6_plus = sum(surface_area_ha[crop_cycle >= 6], na.rm = TRUE),
    cycles_present = paste(sort(unique(crop_cycle)), collapse = ","),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(campaign_start_year)) %>%
  arrange(variety, campaign_start_year)

# Calculate repousse duration trends for each top variety
repousse_trends <- repousse_evolution %>%
  group_by(variety) %>%
  summarise(
    campaigns = n(),
    first_year = min(campaign_start_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_year = max(campaign_start_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_avg_cycle = first(avg_cycle[!is.na(avg_cycle)]),
    last_avg_cycle = last(avg_cycle[!is.na(avg_cycle)]),
    trend_slope = if(n() > 2 && !all(is.na(avg_cycle)) && !all(is.na(campaign_start_year))) {
      cor(campaign_start_year, avg_cycle, use = "complete.obs") * 
      (sd(avg_cycle, na.rm = TRUE) / sd(campaign_start_year, na.rm = TRUE))
    } else NA_real_,
    trend_direction = case_when(
      is.na(trend_slope) ~ "Insufficient data",
      trend_slope > 0.05 ~ "Lengthening cycles",
      trend_slope < -0.05 ~ "Shortening cycles", 
      TRUE ~ "Stable cycles"
    ),
    avg_repousse_pct = round(mean(repousse_percentage, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    max_cycle_overall = max(max_cycle, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_cycle_overall = min(min_cycle, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(campaigns))

cat("REPOUSSE EVOLUTION TRENDS FOR TOP VARIETIES:\n")
cat("=" , rep("=", 47), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Variety          | Campaigns | Years | First→Last Cycle | Trend      | Min-Max | Repousse%\n")
cat("-" , rep("-", 85), "\n", sep = "")
for (i in 1:nrow(repousse_trends)) {
  trend_info <- repousse_trends[i, ]
  if (!is.na(trend_info$first_year) && !is.na(trend_info$last_year)) {
    year_range <- paste0(trend_info$first_year, "-", trend_info$last_year)
  } else {
    year_range <- "N/A"
  }
  cat(sprintf("%-16s | %9d | %5s | %7.2f → %-7.2f | %-10s | %3d-%-3d | %8.1f%%\n",
              trend_info$variety,
              trend_info$campaigns,
              year_range,
              ifelse(is.na(trend_info$first_avg_cycle), 0, trend_info$first_avg_cycle),
              ifelse(is.na(trend_info$last_avg_cycle), 0, trend_info$last_avg_cycle),
              trend_info$trend_direction,
              trend_info$min_cycle_overall,
              trend_info$max_cycle_overall,
              trend_info$avg_repousse_pct))
}

# Detailed campaign-by-campaign analysis for top 5 varieties
cat("\nDETAILED CAMPAIGN EVOLUTION (TOP 5 VARIETIES):\n")
cat("=" , rep("=", 47), "\n", sep = "")

for (var_name in head(top_varieties_by_surface, 5)) {

    cat("\n", toupper(var_name), ":\n")
    cat("Campaign | Year | Surface(ha) | Min-Max Cycle | Avg Cycle | Repousse% | Plant% | Cycles\n")
    cat("-" , rep("-", 85), "\n", sep = "")
    
    for (j in 1:nrow(var_data)) {
      camp_info <- var_data[j, ]
      plant_pct <- round(camp_info$plant_cane_surface / camp_info$total_surface * 100, 1)
      
      cat(sprintf("%-8s | %4s | %11.1f | %4d - %-6d | %9.2f | %8.1f%% | %6.1f%% | %s\n",
                  camp_info$campaign,
                  ifelse(is.na(camp_info$campaign_start_year), "N/A", as.character(camp_info$campaign_start_year)),
                  camp_info$total_surface,
                  camp_info$min_cycle,
                  camp_info$max_cycle,
                  camp_info$avg_cycle,
                  camp_info$repousse_percentage,
                  plant_pct,
                  str_sub(camp_info$cycles_present, 1, 10)))
    }
  }
}

cat("\n=== TEMPORAL TRENDS ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Analyze cycle trends over time
temporal_trends <- crop_data %>%
```
