```{r}
# Custom theme
theme_cycle <- function() {
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 15)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "gray80")
  )
}

  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma", name = "Cycle") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1)), labels = comma_format()) +

  ) +

  )

  for (i in 1:nrow(long_cycle_varieties)) {
    long_var <- long_cycle_varieties[i, ]
    cat(sprintf("%-16s | %9d | %9d | %11.1f | %9d | %9.2f\n",
                long_var$variety,
                long_var$max_cycle,
                long_var$min_cycle,
                long_var$total_surface,
                long_var$campaigns,
                long_var$weighted_avg_cycle))
  }
}

cat("\n=== CROP CYCLE ANALYSIS COMPLETED ===\n")

# Save results (updated with corrected analysis)
write.csv(variety_cycle_stats, "variety_cycle_statistics.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(cycle_distribution, "cycle_distribution_analysis.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(temporal_trends, "temporal_cycle_trends.csv", row.names = FALSE)

if (exists("repousse_evolution") && nrow(repousse_evolution) > 0) {
  write.csv(repousse_evolution, "top_variety_repousse_evolution.csv", row.names = FALSE)
}

if (exists("repousse_trends") && nrow(repousse_trends) > 0) {
  write.csv(repousse_trends, "repousse_trend_analysis.csv", row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
# Plot Saving Script for Sugarcane Crop Cycle Analysis
# Run this after the main analysis script

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)

# Check if required data objects exist
required_objects <- c("cycle_analysis", "cycle_distribution", "variety_cycle_stats", 
                     "temporal_trends", "top_varieties_by_surface")

missing_objects <- required_objects[!sapply(required_objects, exists)]
if (length(missing_objects) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing required data objects:", paste(missing_objects, collapse = ", "), 
             "\nPlease run the main analysis script first."))
}

cat("=== CREATING ENHANCED PUBLICATION-READY PLOTS ===\n")

# Enhanced theme with larger fonts for better readability
theme_publication <- function(base_size = 16) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
  theme(
    # Plot titles and subtitles
    plot.title = element_text(size = base_size + 6, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                             margin = margin(b = 15), color = "gray20"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = base_size + 1, hjust = 0.5, 
                                margin = margin(b = 20), color = "gray40"),
    
    # Axis text and titles
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = base_size + 2, face = "bold", 
                               margin = margin(t = 15), color = "gray20"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = base_size + 2, face = "bold", 
                               margin = margin(r = 15), color = "gray20"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = base_size - 1, color = "gray30"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = base_size - 1, color = "gray30"),
    
    # Legend
    legend.title = element_text(size = base_size + 1, face = "bold", color = "gray20"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1, color = "gray30"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.margin = margin(l = 20),
    
    # Panel and grid
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.6),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray95", size = 0.3),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    
    # Strip text for facets
    strip.text = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold", 
                             color = "gray20", margin = margin(b = 10)),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "gray80"),
    
    # Overall plot appearance
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(20, 30, 20, 20)
  )
}
```

True crop cycle

```{r}
# Sugarcane Parcel Tracking and True Crop Cycle Analysis
# Track individual parcels through campaigns to determine actual crop cycle durations
# Analyze variety longevity, replanting patterns, and field breaks

# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(gridExtra)
library(forcats)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)

# Check if data exists
if (!exists("data")) {
  stop("Error: 'data' object not found. Please load your sugarcane dataset first.")
}

cat("=== PARCEL-BASED CROP CYCLE TRACKING ANALYSIS ===\n\n")

# ===== DATA PREPARATION AND CLEANING =====
cat("=== DATA PREPARATION AND CLEANING ===\n")

# First examine what parcel identifiers we have
cat("Available columns for parcel identification:\n")
parcel_cols <- names(data)[grepl("parcel|plot|field|id|code", names(data), ignore.case = TRUE)]
cat("Potential parcel columns:", paste(parcel_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Show first few records to understand structure
cat("\nFirst few records (relevant columns):\n")
key_cols <- c("campaign", "variety", "crop_cycle", "surface_area_ha", parcel_cols)
key_cols <- key_cols[key_cols %in% names(data)]
print(head(data[, key_cols, drop = FALSE], 10))

# Create a comprehensive parcel identifier
# We'll use combination of available location/identification fields
clean_data <- data %>%
  # Convert to character and standardize - UPPERCASE variety and parcel components
  mutate(
    campaign = as.character(campaign),
    variety = toupper(as.character(variety)),
    crop_cycle_raw = crop_cycle,
    crop_cycle = case_when(
      crop_cycle %in% c("Essais", "Friche", "Jachere", "Lessivage") ~ crop_cycle,
      TRUE ~ as.character(as.numeric(crop_cycle))
    ),
    surface_area_ha = as.numeric(surface_area_ha)
  ) %>%
  # Filter valid records
  filter(
    !is.na(campaign),
    !is.na(variety),
    !is.na(crop_cycle),
    !is.na(surface_area_ha),
    campaign != "",
    variety != "",
    surface_area_ha > 0
  )

# Create parcel identifier - using available location fields
location_cols <- names(clean_data)[grepl("commune|district|sector|zone|block|parcel|plot|field", 
                                        names(clean_data), ignore.case = TRUE)]

if (length(location_cols) > 0) {
  cat("Using location columns for parcel identification:", paste(location_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Create composite parcel ID - UPPERCASE all components
  clean_data <- clean_data %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(location_cols), ~ toupper(as.character(.)))) %>%
    unite("parcel_id", all_of(location_cols), sep = "_", remove = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(parcel_id = toupper(parcel_id))
} else {
  cat("Warning: No clear parcel identifier found. Using row-based approximation.\n")
  clean_data <- clean_data %>%
    mutate(parcel_id = toupper(paste0("P_", row_number())))
}

# Extract campaign year for temporal ordering
clean_data <- clean_data %>%
  mutate(
    campaign_year = case_when(
      str_detect(campaign, "^\\d{2}-\\d{2}$") ~ as.numeric(paste0("20", str_sub(campaign, 1, 2))),
      str_detect(campaign, "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}$") ~ as.numeric(str_sub(campaign, 1, 4)),
      str_detect(campaign, "^\\d{4}-\\d{4}$") ~ as.numeric(str_sub(campaign, 1, 4)),
      str_detect(campaign, "^\\d{4}$") ~ as.numeric(campaign),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(campaign_year)) %>%
  arrange(parcel_id, variety, campaign_year)

cat("\nData after cleaning:\n")
cat("Total records:", nrow(clean_data), "\n")
cat("Unique parcels:", n_distinct(clean_data$parcel_id), "\n")
cat("Unique varieties:", n_distinct(clean_data$variety), "\n")
cat("Campaign years:", min(clean_data$campaign_year, na.rm = TRUE), "to", 
    max(clean_data$campaign_year, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# Analyze crop_cycle categories
cycle_summary <- clean_data %>%
  count(crop_cycle, name = "records") %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = round(records/sum(records) * 100, 1),
    category_type = case_when(
      crop_cycle %in% c("Essais", "Friche", "Jachere", "Lessivage") ~ "Field Break/Special",
      suppressWarnings(!is.na(as.numeric(crop_cycle))) ~ "Active Cultivation",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(records))

cat("\nCrop cycle categories:\n")
print(cycle_summary)

# ===== PARCEL TRACKING ANALYSIS =====
cat("\n=== PARCEL TRACKING ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Separate active cultivation from field breaks
active_cultivation <- clean_data %>%
  filter(!crop_cycle %in% c("Essais", "Friche", "Jachere", "Lessivage")) %>%
  mutate(crop_cycle_num = as.numeric(crop_cycle)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(crop_cycle_num))

field_breaks <- clean_data %>%
  filter(crop_cycle %in% c("Essais", "Friche", "Jachere", "Lessivage"))

cat("Active cultivation records:", nrow(active_cultivation), "\n")
cat("Field break records:", nrow(field_breaks), "\n")

# Track parcels through time for active cultivation
parcel_sequences <- active_cultivation %>%
  group_by(parcel_id, variety) %>%
  arrange(campaign_year) %>%
  mutate(
    year_gap = campaign_year - lag(campaign_year, default = first(campaign_year)),
    cycle_progression = crop_cycle_num - lag(crop_cycle_num, default = -1),
    is_replant = (crop_cycle_num == 0 & lag(crop_cycle_num, default = -1) > 0) | 
                 (year_gap > 2), # Assume gaps > 2 years indicate replanting
    cultivation_period = cumsum(is_replant | row_number() == 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Calculate actual crop cycle durations for each cultivation period
crop_cycle_durations <- parcel_sequences %>%
  group_by(parcel_id, variety, cultivation_period) %>%
  arrange(campaign_year) %>%
  summarise(
    start_year = min(campaign_year),
    end_year = max(campaign_year),
    duration_years = max(campaign_year) - min(campaign_year) + 1,
    max_cycle_reached = max(crop_cycle_num),
    min_cycle = min(crop_cycle_num),
    total_surface = sum(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
    campaigns_tracked = n(),
    cycle_sequence = paste(crop_cycle_num, collapse = "→"),
    started_from_plant_cane = min(crop_cycle_num) == 0,
    ended_naturally = max(crop_cycle_num) > min(crop_cycle_num),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Filter for meaningful tracking (at least 2 years or clear progression)
  filter(
    duration_years >= 2 | max_cycle_reached > min_cycle,
    campaigns_tracked >= 2
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    actual_crop_cycle = ifelse(started_from_plant_cane, max_cycle_reached + 1, duration_years),
    cycle_category = case_when(
      actual_crop_cycle <= 3 ~ "Short (≤3 years)",
      actual_crop_cycle <= 5 ~ "Medium (4-5 years)", 
      actual_crop_cycle <= 7 ~ "Long (6-7 years)",
      actual_crop_cycle <= 10 ~ "Very Long (8-10 years)",
      TRUE ~ "Exceptional (11+ years)"
    )
  )

cat("\nParcel cultivation periods identified:", nrow(crop_cycle_durations), "\n")
cat("Periods starting from plant cane:", sum(crop_cycle_durations$started_from_plant_cane), "\n")
cat("Average actual crop cycle duration:", round(mean(crop_cycle_durations$actual_crop_cycle), 1), "years\n")

# ===== VARIETY-SPECIFIC CROP CYCLE ANALYSIS =====
cat("\n=== VARIETY-SPECIFIC CROP CYCLE ANALYSIS ===\n")

variety_crop_cycles <- crop_cycle_durations %>%
  group_by(variety) %>%
  summarise(
    cultivation_periods = n(),
    total_surface_tracked = sum(total_surface, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_crop_cycle = round(mean(actual_crop_cycle, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    median_crop_cycle = round(median(actual_crop_cycle, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    min_crop_cycle = min(actual_crop_cycle, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_crop_cycle = max(actual_crop_cycle, na.rm = TRUE),
    std_dev_cycle = round(sd(actual_crop_cycle, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    plant_cane_starts = sum(started_from_plant_cane),
    plant_cane_percentage = round(plant_cane_starts / n() * 100, 1),
    short_cycles = sum(actual_crop_cycle <= 3),
    medium_cycles = sum(actual_crop_cycle %in% 4:5),
    long_cycles = sum(actual_crop_cycle %in% 6:7),
    very_long_cycles = sum(actual_crop_cycle %in% 8:10),
    exceptional_cycles = sum(actual_crop_cycle >= 11),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_surface_tracked)) %>%
  mutate(
    consistency_score = round(avg_crop_cycle / (std_dev_cycle + 1), 1), # Higher = more consistent
    variety_rank = row_number()
  )

# Display top varieties by surface area tracked
cat("TOP 15 VARIETIES BY TRACKED SURFACE AREA:\n")
cat("=" , rep("=", 45), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Variety          | Periods | Surface(ha) | Avg Cycle | Range | Std Dev | Plant%\n")
cat("-" , rep("-", 80), "\n", sep = "")

for (i in 1:min(15, nrow(variety_crop_cycles))) {
  var_info <- variety_crop_cycles[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("%-16s | %7d | %11.1f | %9.1f | %2d-%-2d | %7.1f | %6.1f%%\n",
              var_info$variety,
              var_info$cultivation_periods,
              var_info$total_surface_tracked,
              var_info$avg_crop_cycle,
              var_info$min_crop_cycle,
              var_info$max_crop_cycle,
              var_info$std_dev_cycle,
              var_info$plant_cane_percentage))
}

# Detailed cycle distribution by variety
cat("\nCROP CYCLE DISTRIBUTION BY TOP VARIETIES:\n")
cat("=" , rep("=", 42), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Variety          | Short | Med | Long | V.Long | Except | Consistency\n")
cat("-" , rep("-", 70), "\n", sep = "")

for (i in 1:min(12, nrow(variety_crop_cycles))) {
  var_info <- variety_crop_cycles[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("%-16s | %5d | %3d | %4d | %6d | %6d | %11.1f\n",
              var_info$variety,
              var_info$short_cycles,
              var_info$medium_cycles,
              var_info$long_cycles,
              var_info$very_long_cycles,
              var_info$exceptional_cycles,
              var_info$consistency_score))
}

# ===== FIELD BREAK ANALYSIS =====
cat("\n=== FIELD BREAK AND SPECIAL CATEGORY ANALYSIS ===\n")

if (nrow(field_breaks) > 0) {
  field_break_analysis <- field_breaks %>%
    group_by(crop_cycle) %>%
    summarise(
      records = n(),
      surface_area = sum(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
      unique_parcels = n_distinct(parcel_id),
      unique_varieties_before = n_distinct(variety),
      campaigns = n_distinct(campaign),
      avg_surface_per_record = round(mean(surface_area_ha), 2),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(surface_area)) %>%
    mutate(
      surface_pct = round(surface_area / sum(surface_area) * 100, 1),
      records_pct = round(records / sum(records) * 100, 1)
    )
  
  cat("FIELD BREAK CATEGORIES:\n")
  cat("Category  | Records | Surface(ha) | Surface% | Parcels | Avg Size | Campaigns\n")
  cat("-" , rep("-", 75), "\n", sep = "")
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(field_break_analysis)) {
    break_info <- field_break_analysis[i, ]
    cat(sprintf("%-9s | %7d | %11.1f | %7.1f%% | %7d | %8.2f | %9d\n",
                break_info$crop_cycle,
                break_info$records,
                break_info$surface_area,
                break_info$surface_pct,
                break_info$unique_parcels,
                break_info$avg_surface_per_record,
                break_info$campaigns))
  }
  
  # Temporal analysis of field breaks
  field_break_temporal <- field_breaks %>%
    group_by(campaign_year, crop_cycle) %>%
    summarise(
      surface_area = sum(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
      parcels = n_distinct(parcel_id),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(campaign_year, crop_cycle)
  
  cat("\nFIELD BREAK TRENDS OVER TIME:\n")
  recent_breaks <- field_break_temporal %>%
    filter(campaign_year >= max(campaign_year) - 5) %>%
    group_by(crop_cycle) %>%
    summarise(
      avg_surface = round(mean(surface_area), 1),
      avg_parcels = round(mean(parcels), 1),
      years_present = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(avg_surface))
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(recent_breaks)) {
    break_trend <- recent_breaks[i, ]
    cat(sprintf("%-9s: Avg %.1f ha/year, %.1f parcels/year (present in %d recent years)\n",
                break_trend$crop_cycle,
                break_trend$avg_surface,
                break_trend$avg_parcels,
                break_trend$years_present))
  }
}

# ===== TEMPORAL TRENDS =====
cat("\n=== TEMPORAL CROP CYCLE TRENDS ===\n")

temporal_analysis <- crop_cycle_durations %>%
  mutate(
    decade = floor(start_year / 10) * 10,
    period = case_when(
      start_year < 2005 ~ "Early (pre-2005)",
      start_year < 2010 ~ "Mid (2005-2009)",
      start_year < 2015 ~ "Recent (2010-2014)",
      TRUE ~ "Latest (2015+)"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  summarise(
    cultivation_periods = n(),
    avg_crop_cycle = round(mean(actual_crop_cycle), 1),
    median_crop_cycle = median(actual_crop_cycle),
    varieties = n_distinct(variety),
    total_surface = sum(total_surface, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(period)

cat("CROP CYCLE EVOLUTION OVER TIME:\n")
cat("Period           | Periods | Varieties | Avg Cycle | Median | Surface(ha)\n")
cat("-" , rep("-", 70), "\n", sep = "")

for (i in 1:nrow(temporal_analysis)) {
  temp_info <- temporal_analysis[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("%-16s | %7d | %9d | %9.1f | %6.1f | %11.1f\n",
              temp_info$period,
              temp_info$cultivation_periods,
              temp_info$varieties,
              temp_info$avg_crop_cycle,
              temp_info$median_crop_cycle,
              temp_info$total_surface))
}

# ===== VISUALIZATIONS =====
cat("\n=== CREATING COMPREHENSIVE VISUALIZATIONS ===\n")

# Enhanced theme
theme_enhanced <- function() {
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40", margin = margin(b = 15)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "gray80")
  )
}

# PLOT 1: Overall crop cycle duration distribution
cycle_dist_data <- crop_cycle_durations %>%
  count(actual_crop_cycle, name = "periods") %>%
  mutate(percentage = round(periods/sum(periods) * 100, 1))

p1 <- ggplot(cycle_dist_data, aes(x = actual_crop_cycle, y = periods)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(periods, "\n(", percentage, "%)")), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = min(cycle_dist_data$actual_crop_cycle):max(cycle_dist_data$actual_crop_cycle)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    title = "Actual Crop Cycle Duration Distribution",
    subtitle = "Based on parcel tracking through cultivation periods",
    x = "Crop Cycle Duration (years)",
    y = "Number of Cultivation Periods"
  ) +
  theme_enhanced()

print(p1)

# PLOT 2: Top varieties - crop cycle characteristics
top_varieties_plot <- head(variety_crop_cycles, 12)

p2_data <- top_varieties_plot %>%
  select(variety, avg_crop_cycle, min_crop_cycle, max_crop_cycle, cultivation_periods) %>%
  mutate(variety = reorder(variety, avg_crop_cycle))

p2 <- ggplot(p2_data, aes(x = variety)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = min_crop_cycle, ymax = max_crop_cycle), 
                width = 0.3, size = 1, color = "gray50") +
  geom_point(aes(y = avg_crop_cycle, size = cultivation_periods), 
             color = "darkred", alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Cultivation\nPeriods", range = c(3, 8)) +
  labs(
    title = "Variety Crop Cycle Characteristics",
    subtitle = "Average cycle duration (point) with min-max range (error bars)",
    x = "Variety",
    y = "Crop Cycle Duration (years)"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_enhanced()

print(p2)

# PLOT 3: Crop cycle category distribution by variety
if (nrow(variety_crop_cycles) >= 8) {
  cycle_category_data <- head(variety_crop_cycles, 8) %>%
    select(variety, short_cycles, medium_cycles, long_cycles, very_long_cycles, exceptional_cycles) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -variety, names_to = "cycle_category", values_to = "count") %>%
    mutate(
      cycle_category = case_when(
        cycle_category == "short_cycles" ~ "Short (≤3y)",
        cycle_category == "medium_cycles" ~ "Medium (4-5y)",
        cycle_category == "long_cycles" ~ "Long (6-7y)", 
        cycle_category == "very_long_cycles" ~ "Very Long (8-10y)",
        cycle_category == "exceptional_cycles" ~ "Exceptional (11+y)"
      ),
      cycle_category = factor(cycle_category, levels = c("Short (≤3y)", "Medium (4-5y)", 
                                                        "Long (6-7y)", "Very Long (8-10y)", 
                                                        "Exceptional (11+y)"))
    ) %>%
    filter(count > 0)
  
  p3 <- ggplot(cycle_category_data, aes(x = reorder(variety, count, sum), y = count, fill = cycle_category)) +
    geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma", name = "Cycle Duration") +
    labs(
      title = "Crop Cycle Duration Distribution by Variety",
      subtitle = "Top 8 varieties by tracked surface area",
      x = "Variety",
      y = "Number of Cultivation Periods"
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_enhanced() +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))
  
  print(p3)
}

# PLOT 4: Temporal trends in crop cycle duration
if (nrow(temporal_analysis) > 1) {
  p4 <- ggplot(temporal_analysis, aes(x = factor(period, levels = c("Early (pre-2005)", "Mid (2005-2009)", 
                                                                   "Recent (2010-2014)", "Latest (2015+)")))) +
    geom_col(aes(y = avg_crop_cycle), fill = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6) +
    geom_point(aes(y = median_crop_cycle), color = "red", size = 4) +
    geom_text(aes(y = avg_crop_cycle, label = round(avg_crop_cycle, 1)), 
              vjust = -0.5, size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    labs(
      title = "Evolution of Crop Cycle Duration Over Time",
      subtitle = "Green bars: Average duration | Red points: Median duration",
      x = "Time Period",
      y = "Crop Cycle Duration (years)"
    ) +
    theme_enhanced() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  print(p4)
}

# PLOT 5: Field break analysis (if data available)
if (nrow(field_breaks) > 0 && exists("field_break_analysis")) {

    geom_col(fill = "orange", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.7) +

      x = "Break Category",
      y = "Surface Area (hectares)"

  print(p5)
}

# PLOT 6: Variety consistency analysis
consistency_data <- head(variety_crop_cycles, 10) %>%
  select(variety, avg_crop_cycle, std_dev_cycle, cultivation_periods, consistency_score) %>%
  mutate(variety = reorder(variety, consistency_score))

p6 <- ggplot(consistency_data, aes(x = avg_crop_cycle, y = std_dev_cycle)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = cultivation_periods, color = variety), alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.3, color = "gray40") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Cultivation\nPeriods", range = c(3, 10)) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo", name = "Variety") +
  labs(
    title = "Variety Crop Cycle Consistency Analysis",
    subtitle = "Lower standard deviation indicates more consistent cycle durations",
    x = "Average Crop Cycle Duration (years)",
    y = "Standard Deviation (years)"
  ) +
  theme_enhanced()

print(p6)

# ===== COMPREHENSIVE SUMMARY =====
cat("\n=== COMPREHENSIVE ANALYSIS SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("=" , rep("=", 42), "\n", sep = "")

total_periods <- nrow(crop_cycle_durations)
overall_avg_cycle <- round(weighted.mean(crop_cycle_durations$actual_crop_cycle, 
                                        crop_cycle_durations$total_surface), 1)

cat("PARCEL TRACKING RESULTS:\n")
cat("Total cultivation periods analyzed:", total_periods, "\n")
cat("Unique parcels tracked:", n_distinct(crop_cycle_durations$parcel_id), "\n")
cat("Varieties with tracking data:", n_distinct(variety_crop_cycles$variety), "\n")
cat("Overall weighted average crop cycle:", overall_avg_cycle, "years\n")

# Distribution summary
distribution_summary <- crop_cycle_durations %>%
  group_by(cycle_category) %>%
  summarise(
    periods = n(),
    surface = sum(total_surface, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    period_pct = round(periods/sum(periods) * 100, 1),
    surface_pct = round(surface/sum(surface) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(periods))

cat("\nCROP CYCLE DURATION DISTRIBUTION:\n")
for (i in 1:nrow(distribution_summary)) {
  dist_info <- distribution_summary[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("%-20s: %3d periods (%5.1f%%) | %8.1f ha (%5.1f%%)\n",
              dist_info$cycle_category,
              dist_info$periods,
              dist_info$period_pct,
              dist_info$surface,
              dist_info$surface_pct))
}

# Top performing varieties
cat("\nTOP 5 VARIETIES BY CROP CYCLE PERFORMANCE:\n")
top_performers <- head(variety_crop_cycles, 5)
for (i in 1:nrow(top_performers)) {
  perf_info <- top_performers[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("%-16s: Avg %.1f years (%.1f-%.1f range) | %.1f ha tracked | %.1f consistency\n",
              perf_info$variety,
              perf_info$avg_crop_cycle,
              perf_info$min_crop_cycle,
              perf_info$max_crop_cycle,
              perf_info$total_surface_tracked,
              perf_info$consistency_score))
}

if (nrow(field_breaks) > 0) {
  field_break_total <- sum(field_break_analysis$surface_area)
  active_cultivation_total <- sum(crop_cycle_durations$total_surface, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  cat("\nFIELD MANAGEMENT SUMMARY:\n")
  cat("Active cultivation surface:", round(active_cultivation_total, 1), "hectares\n")
  cat("Field break surface:", round(field_break_total, 1), "hectares\n")
  cat("Break percentage of total:", round(field_break_total/(field_break_total + active_cultivation_total) * 100, 1), "%\n")
}

# Export results
cat("\n=== EXPORTING RESULTS ===\n")

write.csv(variety_crop_cycles, "variety_crop_cycle_analysis.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(crop_cycle_durations, "parcel_cultivation_periods.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(cycle_dist_data, "crop_cycle_distribution.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(temporal_analysis, "temporal_crop_cycle_trends.csv", row.names = FALSE)

if (exists("field_break_analysis") && nrow(field_break_analysis) > 0) {
  write.csv(field_break_analysis, "field_break_analysis.csv", row.names = FALSE)
}

cat("Analysis completed! Results exported to CSV files.\n")
cat("This analysis tracks", total_periods, "individual cultivation periods across", 
    n_distinct(crop_cycle_durations$parcel_id), "parcels.\n")
cat("Key finding: Average actual crop cycle duration is", overall_avg_cycle, "years.\n")
```

```{r}
# Save Parcel-Based Crop Cycle Analysis Plots
# High-quality export of all visualizations in PNG and JPEG formats

# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)

# Enhanced theme for high-quality exports

    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40", margin = margin(b = 20)),

  )

# ===== PLOT 3: Crop Cycle Category Distribution by Variety =====
cat("Creating Plot 3: Crop Cycle Category Distribution by Variety\n")

if (nrow(variety_crop_cycles) >= 8) {
  cycle_category_data <- head(variety_crop_cycles, 8) %>%
    select(variety, short_cycles, medium_cycles, long_cycles, very_long_cycles, exceptional_cycles) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -variety, names_to = "cycle_category", values_to = "count") %>%
    mutate(
      cycle_category = case_when(
        cycle_category == "short_cycles" ~ "Short (≤3y)",
        cycle_category == "medium_cycles" ~ "Medium (4-5y)",
        cycle_category == "long_cycles" ~ "Long (6-7y)", 
        cycle_category == "very_long_cycles" ~ "Very Long (8-10y)",
        cycle_category == "exceptional_cycles" ~ "Exceptional (11+y)"
      ),
      cycle_category = factor(cycle_category, levels = c("Short (≤3y)", "Medium (4-5y)", 
                                                        "Long (6-7y)", "Very Long (8-10y)", 
                                                        "Exceptional (11+y)"))
    ) %>%
    filter(count > 0)
  
  p3 <- ggplot(cycle_category_data, aes(x = reorder(variety, count, sum), y = count, fill = cycle_category)) +
    geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.7, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma", name = "Cycle Duration", direction = -1) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)), labels = comma_format()) +
    labs(
      title = "Crop Cycle Duration Distribution by Variety",
      subtitle = "Top 8 varieties by tracked surface area - cultivation period categories",
      x = "Variety",
      y = "Number of Cultivation Periods"
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_export() +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE, override.aes = list(alpha = 1)))
  
  # Save Plot 3
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "03_cycle_category_distribution_by_variety.png"), 
         plot = p3, width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "03_cycle_category_distribution_by_variety.jpg"), 
         plot = p3, width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

  ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "04_temporal_crop_cycle_trends.jpg"),
```

# IV. Sugarcane Yield & °Brix Evolution Analysis

```{r}
# Sugarcane Yield Evolution Analysis - Boxplots by Campaign and Irrigation Type
# Enhanced visualization of tc_per_ha_actual across campaigns

# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(scales)
library(gridExtra)
library(viridis)

# Assume data is already loaded and converted (from previous scripts)
# If not, uncomment and run the data loading/conversion scripts first

# Data preparation and cleaning
prepare_yield_data <- function(data) {
  cat("Preparing yield data for visualization...\n")
  
  # Select relevant columns and remove missing values
  yield_data <- data %>%
    select(campaign, irrigation_type, tc_per_ha_actual) %>%
    filter(!is.na(tc_per_ha_actual), 
           !is.na(campaign), 
           !is.na(irrigation_type),
           tc_per_ha_actual > 0) %>%  # Remove zero or negative yields
    mutate(
      # Clean campaign names and ensure proper ordering
      campaign = as.character(campaign),
      irrigation_type = as.character(irrigation_type)
    )
  
  # Remove outliers (values beyond 3 IQR)
  Q1 <- quantile(yield_data$tc_per_ha_actual, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  Q3 <- quantile(yield_data$tc_per_ha_actual, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  IQR_val <- Q3 - Q1
  
  yield_data <- yield_data %>%
    filter(tc_per_ha_actual >= (Q1 - 3 * IQR_val) & 
           tc_per_ha_actual <= (Q3 + 3 * IQR_val))
  
  # Sort campaigns chronologically
  campaigns <- unique(yield_data$campaign)
  campaigns_sorted <- sort(campaigns)
  yield_data$campaign <- factor(yield_data$campaign, levels = campaigns_sorted)
  
  cat("Data summary:\n")
  cat("- Total observations:", nrow(yield_data), "\n")
  cat("- Campaigns:", length(unique(yield_data$campaign)), "\n")
  cat("- Irrigation types:", length(unique(yield_data$irrigation_type)), "\n")
  cat("- Yield range:", round(min(yield_data$tc_per_ha_actual), 1), "to", 
      round(max(yield_data$tc_per_ha_actual), 1), "tc/ha\n\n")
  
  return(yield_data)
}

# Enhanced theme for sugarcane plots
create_enhanced_theme <- function() {
  theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      # Titles and text
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                               margin = margin(b = 15), color = "#2C3E50"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40", 
                                  margin = margin(b = 20), face = "italic"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50", hjust = 1,
                                 margin = margin(t = 15)),
      
      # Axes
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 15)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 15)),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "gray30"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray30"),
      
      # Legend
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "#2C3E50"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      legend.margin = margin(t = 20),
      legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "cm"),
      
      # Grid and background
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray95", size = 0.3),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.5),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      
      # Margins
      plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
    )
}

# Function to create color palette for irrigation types
get_irrigation_colors <- function(irrigation_types) {
  n_types <- length(unique(irrigation_types))
  
  if (n_types <= 2) {
    colors <- c("#2E8B57", "#CD853F")  # Sea Green and Peru
  } else if (n_types <= 4) {
    colors <- c("#2E8B57", "#CD853F", "#4682B4", "#DC143C")  # Green, Brown, Steel Blue, Crimson
  } else {
    colors <- viridis(n_types, option = "D")
  }
  
  return(colors[1:n_types])
}

# Main plotting function
create_yield_evolution_plot <- function(yield_data) {
  
  # Get irrigation types and colors
  irrigation_types <- sort(unique(yield_data$irrigation_type))
  colors <- get_irrigation_colors(irrigation_types)
  names(colors) <- irrigation_types
  
  # Calculate summary statistics for subtitle
  overall_mean <- round(mean(yield_data$tc_per_ha_actual, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  n_observations <- nrow(yield_data)
  
  # Create the main plot
  p <- ggplot(yield_data, aes(x = campaign, y = tc_per_ha_actual, fill = irrigation_type)) +
    
    # Boxplots with enhanced aesthetics
    geom_boxplot(
      alpha = 0.8,
      outlier.alpha = 0.6,
      outlier.size = 1.5,
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      width = 0.7
    ) +
    
    # Add mean points
    stat_summary(
      fun = mean, 
      geom = "point", 
      shape = 23, 
      size = 3, 
      color = "white",
      stroke = 1,
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
    ) +
    
    # Color scheme
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = colors,
      name = "Irrigation Type",
      guide = guide_legend(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5)
    ) +
    
    # Scales
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "Yield (tc/ha)",
      breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 8),
      labels = function(x) paste0(x, "")
    ) +
    
    scale_x_discrete(
      name = "Campaign (Growing Season)",
      labels = function(x) gsub("-", "\n", x)  # Put years on separate lines
    ) +
    
    # Labels
    labs(
      title = "Sugarcane Yield Evolution by Campaign and Irrigation Type",
      subtitle = paste0("Distribution of actual yields across growing seasons • ",
                       "Mean yield: ", overall_mean, " tc/ha • ",
                       "n = ", format(n_observations, big.mark = ",")),
      caption = "Boxplots show median, quartiles, and outliers • Diamond points indicate means"
    ) +
    
    # Apply enhanced theme
    create_enhanced_theme()
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to create individual campaign comparison plots
create_campaign_detail_plots <- function(yield_data, campaigns_per_plot = 4) {
  
  campaigns <- levels(yield_data$campaign)
  n_campaigns <- length(campaigns)
  n_plots <- ceiling(n_campaigns / campaigns_per_plot)
  
  plots <- list()
  
  for (i in 1:n_plots) {
    start_idx <- (i - 1) * campaigns_per_plot + 1
    end_idx <- min(i * campaigns_per_plot, n_campaigns)
    selected_campaigns <- campaigns[start_idx:end_idx]
    
    plot_data <- yield_data %>%
      filter(campaign %in% selected_campaigns)
    
    # Get colors
    irrigation_types <- sort(unique(plot_data$irrigation_type))
    colors <- get_irrigation_colors(irrigation_types)
    names(colors) <- irrigation_types
    
    p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = campaign, y = tc_per_ha_actual, fill = irrigation_type)) +
      geom_boxplot(
        alpha = 0.8,
        outlier.alpha = 0.6,
        outlier.size = 2,
        position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
        width = 0.7
      ) +
      
      # Add mean points
      stat_summary(
        fun = mean, 
        geom = "point", 
        shape = 23, 
        size = 4, 
        color = "white",
        stroke = 1.5,
        position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
      ) +
      
      # Add mean lines connecting campaigns for each irrigation type
      stat_summary(
        fun = mean, 
        geom = "line", 
        aes(group = irrigation_type, color = irrigation_type),
        position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
        size = 1.2,
        alpha = 0.7
      ) +
      
      scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name = "Irrigation Type") +
      scale_color_manual(values = colors, guide = "none") +
      
      scale_y_continuous(
        name = "Yield (tc/ha)",
        breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)
      ) +
      
      scale_x_discrete(name = "Campaign") +
      
      labs(
        title = paste0("Detailed View: Campaigns ", 
                      gsub("-", "-", selected_campaigns[1]), " to ", 
                      gsub("-", "-", selected_campaigns[length(selected_campaigns)])),
        subtitle = "Mean yield trends shown with connecting lines"
      ) +
      
      create_enhanced_theme() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11)
      )
    
    plots[[i]] <- p
  }
  
  return(plots)
}

# Function to create summary statistics table
create_summary_table <- function(yield_data) {
  
  summary_stats <- yield_data %>%
    group_by(campaign, irrigation_type) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_yield = round(mean(tc_per_ha_actual, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      median_yield = round(median(tc_per_ha_actual, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      sd_yield = round(sd(tc_per_ha_actual, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      min_yield = round(min(tc_per_ha_actual, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      max_yield = round(max(tc_per_ha_actual, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(campaign, irrigation_type)
  
  cat("=== YIELD SUMMARY BY CAMPAIGN AND IRRIGATION TYPE ===\n")
  print(summary_stats, n = Inf)
  
  # Overall summary by irrigation type
  overall_summary <- yield_data %>%
    group_by(irrigation_type) %>%
    summarise(
      total_n = n(),
      overall_mean = round(mean(tc_per_ha_actual, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      overall_sd = round(sd(tc_per_ha_actual, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      campaigns_count = n_distinct(campaign),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  cat("\n=== OVERALL SUMMARY BY IRRIGATION TYPE ===\n")
  print(overall_summary)
  
  return(list(detailed = summary_stats, overall = overall_summary))
}

# Main execution function
main_analysis <- function() {
  
  cat("=== SUGARCANE YIELD EVOLUTION ANALYSIS ===\n\n")
  
  # Check if data exists
  if (!exists("data")) {
    stop("Error: 'data' object not found. Please load and convert your dataset first.")
  }
  
  # Prepare data
  yield_data <- prepare_yield_data(data)
  
  # Create summary statistics
  summary_results <- create_summary_table(yield_data)
  
  # Create main evolution plot
  cat("Creating main evolution plot...\n")
  main_plot <- create_yield_evolution_plot(yield_data)
  
  # Display main plot
  print(main_plot)
  
  # Save main plot
  ggsave("sugarcane_yield_evolution_main.png", main_plot, 
         width = 16, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  # Create detailed plots
  cat("Creating detailed campaign plots...\n")
  detailed_plots <- create_campaign_detail_plots(yield_data, campaigns_per_plot = 6)
  
  # Save detailed plots
  for (i in seq_along(detailed_plots)) {
    filename <- paste0("sugarcane_yield_detail_", i, ".png")
    ggsave(filename, detailed_plots[[i]], 
           width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    print(detailed_plots[[i]])
  }
  
  # Create combined grid plot if there are multiple detailed plots
  if (length(detailed_plots) > 1) {
    combined_plot <- do.call(grid.arrange, c(detailed_plots, ncol = 1))
    ggsave("sugarcane_yield_all_details_combined.png", combined_plot,
           width = 14, height = 8 * length(detailed_plots), dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  }
  
  cat("\n=== ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
  cat("Files saved:\n")
  cat("- sugarcane_yield_evolution_main.png (main overview)\n")
  for (i in seq_along(detailed_plots)) {
    cat("- sugarcane_yield_detail_", i, ".png\n")
  }
  if (length(detailed_plots) > 1) {
    cat("- sugarcane_yield_all_details_combined.png\n")
  }
  
  # Return results for further analysis
  return(list(
    data = yield_data,
    main_plot = main_plot,
    detailed_plots = detailed_plots,
    summary = summary_results
  ))
}

# Run the analysis
# Uncomment the line below to execute
results <- main_analysis()
```

```{r}
# Sugarcane Brix Evolution Analysis - Boxplots by Campaign and Irrigation Type
# Enhanced visualization of brix_percent across campaigns

# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(scales)
library(gridExtra)
library(viridis)

# Assume data is already loaded and converted (from previous scripts)
# If not, uncomment and run the data loading/conversion scripts first

# Data preparation and cleaning for Brix analysis
prepare_brix_data <- function(data) {
  cat("Preparing Brix data for visualization...\n")
  
  # Select relevant columns and remove missing values
  brix_data <- data %>%
    select(campaign, irrigation_type, brix_percent) %>%
    filter(!is.na(brix_percent), 
           !is.na(campaign), 
           !is.na(irrigation_type),
           brix_percent > 0,      # Remove zero or negative brix
           brix_percent <= 100) %>%  # Remove impossible brix values (>100%)
    mutate(
      # Clean campaign names and ensure proper ordering
      campaign = as.character(campaign),
      irrigation_type = as.character(irrigation_type)
    )
  
  # Remove outliers for Brix (values beyond 2.5 IQR - more conservative for quality data)
  Q1 <- quantile(brix_data$brix_percent, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  Q3 <- quantile(brix_data$brix_percent, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  IQR_val <- Q3 - Q1
  
  brix_data <- brix_data %>%
    filter(brix_percent >= (Q1 - 2.5 * IQR_val) & 
           brix_percent <= (Q3 + 2.5 * IQR_val))
  
  # Sort campaigns chronologically
  campaigns <- unique(brix_data$campaign)
  campaigns_sorted <- sort(campaigns)
  brix_data$campaign <- factor(brix_data$campaign, levels = campaigns_sorted)
  
  cat("Brix data summary:\n")
  cat("- Total observations:", nrow(brix_data), "\n")
  cat("- Campaigns:", length(unique(brix_data$campaign)), "\n")
  cat("- Irrigation types:", length(unique(brix_data$irrigation_type)), "\n")
  cat("- Brix range:", round(min(brix_data$brix_percent), 1), "% to", 
      round(max(brix_data$brix_percent), 1), "%\n\n")
  
  return(brix_data)
}

# Enhanced theme for sugarcane Brix plots
create_enhanced_brix_theme <- function() {
  theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      # Titles and text
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                               margin = margin(b = 15), color = "#8B4513"),  # Brown color for sugar theme
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40", 
                                  margin = margin(b = 20), face = "italic"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50", hjust = 1,
                                 margin = margin(t = 15)),
      
      # Axes
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 15)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 15)),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "gray30"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray30"),
      
      # Legend
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "#8B4513"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      legend.margin = margin(t = 20),
      legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "cm"),
      
      # Grid and background
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray95", size = 0.3),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.5),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      
      # Margins
      plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
    )
}

# Function to create sugar-themed color palette for irrigation types
get_brix_irrigation_colors <- function(irrigation_types) {
  n_types <- length(unique(irrigation_types))
  
  # Sugar/caramel inspired colors
  if (n_types <= 2) {
    colors <- c("#D2691E", "#8B4513")  # Chocolate and Saddle Brown
  } else if (n_types <= 4) {
    colors <- c("#D2691E", "#8B4513", "#CD853F", "#A0522D")  # Browns and tans
  } else {
    # Use a brown-orange palette
    colors <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(min(n_types, 9), "Oranges")[3:(2+n_types)]
  }
  
  return(colors[1:n_types])
}

# Main plotting function for Brix evolution
create_brix_evolution_plot <- function(brix_data) {
  
  # Get irrigation types and colors
  irrigation_types <- sort(unique(brix_data$irrigation_type))
  colors <- get_brix_irrigation_colors(irrigation_types)
  names(colors) <- irrigation_types
  
  # Calculate summary statistics for subtitle
  overall_mean <- round(mean(brix_data$brix_percent, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  overall_range <- round(range(brix_data$brix_percent, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  n_observations <- nrow(brix_data)
  
  # Create quality benchmarks (typical Brix ranges for sugarcane)
  # Good quality: >18%, Excellent: >20%
  benchmark_good <- 18
  benchmark_excellent <- 20
  
  # Create the main plot
  p <- ggplot(brix_data, aes(x = campaign, y = brix_percent, fill = irrigation_type)) +
    
    # Add quality benchmark lines
    geom_hline(yintercept = benchmark_good, color = "#FF8C00", linetype = "dashed", 
               size = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = benchmark_excellent, color = "#FF4500", linetype = "dashed", 
               size = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) +
    
    # Boxplots with enhanced aesthetics
    geom_boxplot(
      alpha = 0.8,
      outlier.alpha = 0.6,
      outlier.size = 1.5,
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
      width = 0.7
    ) +
    
    # Add mean points
    stat_summary(
      fun = mean, 
      geom = "point", 
      shape = 23, 
      size = 3, 
      color = "white",
      stroke = 1,
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
    ) +
    
    # Color scheme
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = colors,
      name = "Irrigation Type",
      guide = guide_legend(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5)
    ) +
    
    # Scales
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "Brix Content (%)",
      breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 10),
      labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
      limits = c(min(brix_data$brix_percent) * 0.95, max(brix_data$brix_percent) * 1.02)
    ) +
    
    scale_x_discrete(
      name = "Campaign (Growing Season)",
      labels = function(x) gsub("-", "\n", x)  # Put years on separate lines
    ) +
    
    # Labels with quality benchmarks info
    labs(
      title = "Sugarcane Brix Evolution by Campaign and Irrigation Type",
      subtitle = paste0("Sugar content distribution across growing seasons • ",
                       "Mean: ", overall_mean, "% • Range: ", overall_range[1], "-", overall_range[2], "% • ",
                       "n = ", format(n_observations, big.mark = ",")),
      caption = paste0("Boxplots show median, quartiles, and outliers • Diamond points indicate means\n",
                      "Dashed lines: Quality benchmarks (", benchmark_good, "% = Good, ", 
                      benchmark_excellent, "% = Excellent)")
    ) +
    
    # Apply enhanced theme
    create_enhanced_brix_theme()
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to create individual campaign comparison plots for Brix
create_brix_campaign_detail_plots <- function(brix_data, campaigns_per_plot = 4) {
  
  campaigns <- levels(brix_data$campaign)
  n_campaigns <- length(campaigns)
  n_plots <- ceiling(n_campaigns / campaigns_per_plot)
  
  plots <- list()
  
  for (i in 1:n_plots) {
    start_idx <- (i - 1) * campaigns_per_plot + 1
    end_idx <- min(i * campaigns_per_plot, n_campaigns)
    selected_campaigns <- campaigns[start_idx:end_idx]
    
    plot_data <- brix_data %>%
      filter(campaign %in% selected_campaigns)
    
    # Get colors
    irrigation_types <- sort(unique(plot_data$irrigation_type))
    colors <- get_brix_irrigation_colors(irrigation_types)
    names(colors) <- irrigation_types
    
    # Quality benchmarks
    benchmark_good <- 18
    benchmark_excellent <- 20
    
    p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = campaign, y = brix_percent, fill = irrigation_type)) +
      
      # Add quality benchmark lines
      geom_hline(yintercept = benchmark_good, color = "#FF8C00", linetype = "dashed", 
                 size = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = benchmark_excellent, color = "#FF4500", linetype = "dashed", 
                 size = 0.6, alpha = 0.7) +
      
      geom_boxplot(
        alpha = 0.8,
        outlier.alpha = 0.6,
        outlier.size = 2,
        position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
        width = 0.7
      ) +
      
      # Add mean points
      stat_summary(
        fun = mean, 
        geom = "point", 
        shape = 23, 
        size = 4, 
        color = "white",
        stroke = 1.5,
        position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
      ) +
      
      # Add mean lines connecting campaigns for each irrigation type
      stat_summary(
        fun = mean, 
        geom = "line", 
        aes(group = irrigation_type, color = irrigation_type),
        position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
        size = 1.2,
        alpha = 0.7
      ) +
      
      scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name = "Irrigation Type") +
      scale_color_manual(values = colors, guide = "none") +
      
      scale_y_continuous(
        name = "Brix Content (%)",
        breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6),
        labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")
      ) +
      
      scale_x_discrete(name = "Campaign") +
      
      labs(
        title = paste0("Detailed Brix View: Campaigns ", 
                      gsub("-", "-", selected_campaigns[1]), " to ", 
                      gsub("-", "-", selected_campaigns[length(selected_campaigns)])),
        subtitle = "Mean Brix trends with quality benchmarks",
        caption = paste0("Dashed lines: ", benchmark_good, "% (Good), ", 
                        benchmark_excellent, "% (Excellent)")
      ) +
      
      create_enhanced_brix_theme() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11)
      )
    
    plots[[i]] <- p
  }
  
  return(plots)
}

# Function to create Brix summary statistics table
create_brix_summary_table <- function(brix_data) {
  
  # Quality categories
  classify_brix_quality <- function(brix) {
    case_when(
      brix >= 20 ~ "Excellent",
      brix >= 18 ~ "Good", 
      brix >= 16 ~ "Average",
      TRUE ~ "Below Average"
    )
  }
  
  # Add quality classification
  brix_data_classified <- brix_data %>%
    mutate(quality_class = classify_brix_quality(brix_percent))
  
  summary_stats <- brix_data_classified %>%
    group_by(campaign, irrigation_type) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean_brix = round(mean(brix_percent, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      median_brix = round(median(brix_percent, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      sd_brix = round(sd(brix_percent, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      min_brix = round(min(brix_percent, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      max_brix = round(max(brix_percent, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      excellent_pct = round(100 * sum(quality_class == "Excellent") / n(), 1),
      good_plus_pct = round(100 * sum(quality_class %in% c("Excellent", "Good")) / n(), 1),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(campaign, irrigation_type)
  
  cat("=== BRIX SUMMARY BY CAMPAIGN AND IRRIGATION TYPE ===\n")
  print(summary_stats, n = Inf)
  
  # Overall summary by irrigation type
  overall_summary <- brix_data_classified %>%
    group_by(irrigation_type) %>%
    summarise(
      total_n = n(),
      overall_mean_brix = round(mean(brix_percent, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      overall_sd_brix = round(sd(brix_percent, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      campaigns_count = n_distinct(campaign),
      excellent_pct = round(100 * sum(quality_class == "Excellent") / n(), 1),
      good_plus_pct = round(100 * sum(quality_class %in% c("Excellent", "Good")) / n(), 1),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  cat("\n=== OVERALL BRIX SUMMARY BY IRRIGATION TYPE ===\n")
  print(overall_summary)
  
  # Quality distribution summary
  quality_summary <- brix_data_classified %>%
    group_by(campaign, quality_class) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = quality_class, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>%
    arrange(campaign)
  
  cat("\n=== BRIX QUALITY DISTRIBUTION BY CAMPAIGN ===\n")
  print(quality_summary, n = Inf)
  
  return(list(
    detailed = summary_stats, 
    overall = overall_summary, 
    quality_dist = quality_summary
  ))
}

# Main execution function for Brix analysis
main_brix_analysis <- function() {
  
  cat("=== SUGARCANE BRIX EVOLUTION ANALYSIS ===\n\n")
  
  # Check if data exists
  if (!exists("data")) {
    stop("Error: 'data' object not found. Please load and convert your dataset first.")
  }
  
  # Prepare data
  brix_data <- prepare_brix_data(data)
  
  # Create summary statistics
  summary_results <- create_brix_summary_table(brix_data)
  
  # Create main evolution plot
  cat("Creating main Brix evolution plot...\n")
  main_plot <- create_brix_evolution_plot(brix_data)
  
  # Display main plot
  print(main_plot)
  
  # Save main plot
  ggsave("sugarcane_brix_evolution_main.png", main_plot, 
         width = 16, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  # Create detailed plots
  cat("Creating detailed Brix campaign plots...\n")
  detailed_plots <- create_brix_campaign_detail_plots(brix_data, campaigns_per_plot = 6)
  
  # Save detailed plots
  for (i in seq_along(detailed_plots)) {
    filename <- paste0("sugarcane_brix_detail_", i, ".png")
    ggsave(filename, detailed_plots[[i]], 
           width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    print(detailed_plots[[i]])
  }
  
  # Create combined grid plot if there are multiple detailed plots
  if (length(detailed_plots) > 1) {
    combined_plot <- do.call(grid.arrange, c(detailed_plots, ncol = 1))
    ggsave("sugarcane_brix_all_details_combined.png", combined_plot,
           width = 14, height = 8 * length(detailed_plots), dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  }
  
  cat("\n=== BRIX ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
  cat("Files saved:\n")
  cat("- sugarcane_brix_evolution_main.png (main overview)\n")
  for (i in seq_along(detailed_plots)) {
    cat("- sugarcane_brix_detail_", i, ".png\n")
  }
  if (length(detailed_plots) > 1) {
    cat("- sugarcane_brix_all_details_combined.png\n")
  }
  
  # Return results for further analysis
  return(list(
    data = brix_data,
    main_plot = main_plot,
    detailed_plots = detailed_plots,
    summary = summary_results
  ))
}

# Run the Brix analysis
# Uncomment the line below to execute
brix_results <- main_brix_analysis()
```

```{r}
# Sugarcane Trend Analysis with Statistical Testing
# Testing for significant trends in yield and Brix over time using t-tests for slope

# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(broom)
library(scales)
library(gridExtra)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)

# Function to convert campaign to numeric year for trend analysis
convert_campaign_to_year <- function(campaign) {
  # Extract the starting year from campaign (e.g., "02-03" -> 2002, "23-24" -> 2023)
  campaign_clean <- as.character(campaign)
  
  # Split by dash and take first part
  start_year <- sapply(strsplit(campaign_clean, "-"), function(x) x[1])
  
  # Convert to numeric, handling 2-digit years
  numeric_years <- as.numeric(start_year)
  
  # Convert 2-digit years to 4-digit (assuming 00-49 = 2000-2049, 50-99 = 1950-1999)
  full_years <- ifelse(numeric_years <= 49, 
                       2000 + numeric_years, 
                       1900 + numeric_years)
  
  return(full_years)
}

# Prepare data for trend analysis
prepare_trend_data <- function(data, variable_name, variable_label) {
  
  cat("Preparing trend data for", variable_label, "...\n")
  
  # Create the trend dataset
  if (variable_name == "tc_per_ha_actual") {
    trend_data <- data %>%
      select(campaign, irrigation_type, tc_per_ha_actual) %>%
      rename(value = tc_per_ha_actual) %>%
      filter(!is.na(value), !is.na(campaign), !is.na(irrigation_type), value > 0)
  } else if (variable_name == "brix_percent") {
    trend_data <- data %>%
      select(campaign, irrigation_type, brix_percent) %>%
      rename(value = brix_percent) %>%
      filter(!is.na(value), !is.na(campaign), !is.na(irrigation_type), 
             value > 0, value <= 100)
  }
  
  # Convert campaign to numeric year
  trend_data$year <- convert_campaign_to_year(trend_data$campaign)
  
  # Calculate annual means by irrigation type
  annual_means <- trend_data %>%
    group_by(year, irrigation_type) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_value = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_obs = n(),
      sd_value = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      se_value = sd_value / sqrt(n_obs),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    filter(n_obs >= 3)  # Minimum observations per year for reliability
  
  # Overall annual means (across all irrigation types)
  overall_annual <- trend_data %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_value = median(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_obs = n(),
      sd_value = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      se_value = sd_value / sqrt(n_obs),
      irrigation_type = "Overall",
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    filter(n_obs >= 5)  # Minimum observations per year for overall
  
  # Combine datasets
  combined_data <- bind_rows(annual_means, overall_annual)
  
  cat("Trend data prepared:\n")
  cat("- Years covered:", min(combined_data$year), "to", max(combined_data$year), "\n")
  cat("- Irrigation types:", length(unique(annual_means$irrigation_type)), "\n")
  cat("- Total annual data points:", nrow(combined_data), "\n\n")
  
  return(list(
    annual_data = combined_data,
    raw_data = trend_data,
    variable_name = variable_name,
    variable_label = variable_label
  ))
}

# Statistical trend analysis using t-test for slope
# Statistical trend analysis using t-test for slope (CORRECTED)
perform_trend_analysis <- function(trend_data_list) {
  
  annual_data <- trend_data_list$annual_data
  variable_label <- trend_data_list$variable_label
  
  cat("=== STATISTICAL TREND ANALYSIS FOR", toupper(variable_label), "===\n\n")
  
  # Function to perform trend test for each irrigation type
  test_trend <- function(data, irrigation_type_name) {
    
    if (nrow(data) < 3) {
      return(data.frame(
        n_years = nrow(data),
        slope = NA,
        intercept = NA,
        r_squared = NA,
        p_value = NA,
        significant = "Insufficient data",
        trend_direction = "Unknown",
        annual_change_pct = NA,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
    }
    
    # Fit linear model
    model <- lm(mean_value ~ year, data = data)
    
    # Extract results
    model_summary <- summary(model)
    slope <- coef(model)[2]
    intercept <- coef(model)[1]
    r_squared <- model_summary$r.squared
    p_value <- model_summary$coefficients[2, 4]  # p-value for slope
    
    # Determine significance and direction
    is_significant <- p_value < 0.05
    trend_direction <- ifelse(slope > 0, "Increasing", "Decreasing")
    significance_level <- case_when(
      p_value < 0.001 ~ "Highly significant (p < 0.001)",
      p_value < 0.01 ~ "Very significant (p < 0.01)",
      p_value < 0.05 ~ "Significant (p < 0.05)",
      p_value < 0.1 ~ "Marginally significant (p < 0.1)",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
    
    # Calculate annual change as percentage of mean
    mean_value <- mean(data$mean_value)
    annual_change_pct <- (slope / mean_value) * 100
    
    # IMPORTANT: Do NOT include irrigation_type in the returned data frame
    # group_modify() will automatically add it back
    return(data.frame(
      n_years = nrow(data),
      slope = round(slope, 4),
      intercept = round(intercept, 2),
      r_squared = round(r_squared, 3),
      p_value = round(p_value, 4),
      significant = significance_level,
      trend_direction = trend_direction,
      annual_change_pct = round(annual_change_pct, 2),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  # Perform trend analysis for each irrigation type
  trend_results <- annual_data %>%
    group_by(irrigation_type) %>%
    group_modify(~ test_trend(.x, .y$irrigation_type)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Display results
  cat("TREND ANALYSIS RESULTS:\n")
  print(trend_results, n = Inf)
  
  # Summary of significant trends
  significant_trends <- trend_results %>%
    filter(p_value < 0.05, !is.na(p_value))
  
  if (nrow(significant_trends) > 0) {
    cat("\n=== SIGNIFICANT TRENDS DETECTED ===\n")
    for (i in 1:nrow(significant_trends)) {
      result <- significant_trends[i, ]
      cat(sprintf("%s: %s trend (%.4f %s/year, %.2f%%/year, R² = %.3f, %s)\n",
                  result$irrigation_type,
                  result$trend_direction,
                  result$slope,
                  ifelse(trend_data_list$variable_name == "tc_per_ha_actual", "tc/ha", "%"),
                  result$annual_change_pct,
                  result$r_squared,
                  result$significant))
    }
  } else {
    cat("\n=== NO SIGNIFICANT TRENDS DETECTED ===\n")
  }
  
  return(trend_results)
}

# Create trend visualization plots
create_trend_plots <- function(trend_data_list, trend_results) {
  
  annual_data <- trend_data_list$annual_data
  variable_name <- trend_data_list$variable_name
  variable_label <- trend_data_list$variable_label
  
  # Enhanced theme for trend plots
  trend_theme <- theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                               margin = margin(b = 15), color = "#2C3E50"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40", 
                                  margin = margin(b = 20), face = "italic"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50", hjust = 1,
                                 margin = margin(t = 15)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.5),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
    )
  
  # Color palette for irrigation types
  irrigation_types <- sort(unique(annual_data$irrigation_type[annual_data$irrigation_type != "Overall"]))
  colors <- c(viridis(length(irrigation_types), option = "D"), "#E31A1C")  # Red for Overall
  names(colors) <- c(irrigation_types, "Overall")
  
  # Main trend plot
  y_label <- ifelse(variable_name == "tc_per_ha_actual", "Yield (tc/ha)", "Brix Content (%)")
  
  main_plot <- ggplot(annual_data, aes(x = year, y = mean_value, color = irrigation_type)) +
    
    # Add trend lines with confidence intervals
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, size = 1.2) +
    
    # Add data points
    geom_point(aes(size = n_obs), alpha = 0.8) +
    
    # Error bars
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_value - se_value, ymax = mean_value + se_value), 
                  width = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = colors, name = "Treatment") +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Sample Size", range = c(2, 6)) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Year",
      breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 8)
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = y_label,
      breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 8)
    ) +
    
    labs(
      title = paste("Long-term Trends in Sugarcane", variable_label),
      subtitle = paste("Statistical trend analysis with 95% confidence intervals •", 
                      min(annual_data$year), "to", max(annual_data$year)),
      caption = "Point size reflects sample size • Error bars show standard error • Trend lines fitted by least squares"
    ) +
    
    trend_theme
  
  # Faceted plot by irrigation type (excluding overall)
  facet_data <- annual_data %>% filter(irrigation_type != "Overall")
  
  facet_plot <- ggplot(facet_data, aes(x = year, y = mean_value)) +
    
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.3, color = "#2C3E50", fill = "#3498DB") +
    
    geom_point(aes(size = n_obs, color = irrigation_type), alpha = 0.8) +
    
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_value - se_value, ymax = mean_value + se_value), 
                  width = 0.3, alpha = 0.6, color = "gray50") +
    
    facet_wrap(~ irrigation_type, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = colors, guide = "none") +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Sample Size", range = c(2, 5)) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(name = "Year", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = y_label, breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
    
    labs(
      title = paste("Individual Trend Analysis by Irrigation Type -", variable_label),
      subtitle = "Separate trend analysis for each treatment with confidence intervals",
      caption = "Each panel shows independent trend analysis • Blue bands show 95% confidence intervals"
    ) +
    
    trend_theme +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  # Statistical summary plot
  plot_data_for_summary <- trend_results %>%
    filter(!is.na(p_value)) %>%
    mutate(
      significance_numeric = case_when(
        p_value < 0.001 ~ 4,
        p_value < 0.01 ~ 3,
        p_value < 0.05 ~ 2,
        p_value < 0.1 ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 0
      ),
      significance_label = case_when(
        p_value < 0.001 ~ "p < 0.001",
        p_value < 0.01 ~ "p < 0.01", 
        p_value < 0.05 ~ "p < 0.05",
        p_value < 0.1 ~ "p < 0.1",
        TRUE ~ "n.s."
      )
    )
  
  if (nrow(plot_data_for_summary) > 0) {
    summary_plot <- ggplot(plot_data_for_summary, aes(x = reorder(irrigation_type, slope), y = slope)) +
      
      geom_col(aes(fill = significance_numeric), alpha = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
      
      geom_text(aes(label = significance_label, 
                   y = slope + ifelse(slope > 0, max(abs(slope)) * 0.05, -max(abs(slope)) * 0.05)),
               size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
      
      scale_fill_gradient2(
        low = "#E74C3C", mid = "#F39C12", high = "#27AE60",
        midpoint = 1.5, name = "Significance",
        labels = c("Not sig.", "p < 0.1", "p < 0.05", "p < 0.01", "p < 0.001"),
        breaks = 0:4
      ) +
      
      scale_y_continuous(
        name = paste("Annual Change in", y_label),
        breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)
      ) +
      
      scale_x_discrete(name = "Treatment") +
      
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.7) +
      
      labs(
        title = paste("Statistical Significance of Trends -", variable_label),
        subtitle = "Annual rate of change with statistical significance levels",
        caption = "Positive values = increasing trends • Negative values = decreasing trends"
      ) +
      
      trend_theme +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  } else {
    summary_plot <- ggplot() + 
      geom_text(aes(x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "No trend data available"), size = 14) +
      theme_void()
  }
  
  return(list(
    main_plot = main_plot,
    facet_plot = facet_plot,
    summary_plot = summary_plot
  ))
}

# Main function to run complete trend analysis
run_trend_analysis <- function(data, variable_name, variable_label) {
  
  cat("=== STARTING TREND ANALYSIS FOR", toupper(variable_label), "===\n\n")
  
  # Prepare data
  trend_data_list <- prepare_trend_data(data, variable_name, variable_label)
  
  # Perform statistical analysis
  trend_results <- perform_trend_analysis(trend_data_list)
  
  # Create plots
  plots <- create_trend_plots(trend_data_list, trend_results)
  
  # Save plots
  file_prefix <- paste0("sugarcane_trends_", variable_name)
  
  ggsave(paste0(file_prefix, "_main.png"), plots$main_plot, 
         width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  ggsave(paste0(file_prefix, "_faceted.png"), plots$facet_plot, 
         width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  if (!is.null(plots$summary_plot)) {
    ggsave(paste0(file_prefix, "_significance.png"), plots$summary_plot, 
           width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  }
  
  # Create combined plot
  if (length(plots) >= 3) {
    combined <- grid.arrange(plots$main_plot, plots$facet_plot, plots$summary_plot, 
                           ncol = 1, heights = c(1, 1, 0.8))
    ggsave(paste0(file_prefix, "_combined.png"), combined, 
           width = 14, height = 20, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  }
  
  cat("\n=== TREND ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
  cat("Plots saved:\n")
  cat("-", paste0(file_prefix, "_main.png"), "\n")
  cat("-", paste0(file_prefix, "_faceted.png"), "\n")
  cat("-", paste0(file_prefix, "_significance.png"), "\n")
  cat("-", paste0(file_prefix, "_combined.png"), "\n\n")
  
  return(list(
    data = trend_data_list,
    results = trend_results,
    plots = plots
  ))
}

# Run both analyses
run_complete_trend_analysis <- function() {
  
  if (!exists("data")) {
    stop("Error: 'data' object not found. Please load and convert your dataset first.")
  }
  
  cat("=== COMPREHENSIVE SUGARCANE TREND ANALYSIS ===\n")
  cat("Testing for significant trends using t-tests for slope of fitted lines\n")
  cat("Following methods described in Zar (1999)\n\n")
  
  # Analyze yield trends
  yield_results <- run_trend_analysis(data, "tc_per_ha_actual", "Yield")
  
  cat("\n" %+% rep("=", 80) %+% "\n\n")
  
  # Analyze Brix trends  
  brix_results <- run_trend_analysis(data, "brix_percent", "Brix Content")
  
  cat("\n=== OVERALL SUMMARY ===\n")
  cat("Yield trend analysis completed\n")
  cat("Brix trend analysis completed\n")
  cat("All plots and statistical results saved\n")
  
  return(list(
    yield = yield_results,
    brix = brix_results
  ))
}

# Execute the complete analysis
# Uncomment to run
complete_results <- run_complete_trend_analysis()
```
