## IV. Comprehensive Block Yield Evolution Analysis

```{r}
# Comprehensive Block Yield Evolution Analysis
# Show yield trends for all blocks with great visualization

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(gridExtra)

# Enhanced theme for block analysis
block_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                             margin = margin(b = 15), color = "#2C3E50"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40", 
                                margin = margin(b = 15), face = "italic"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray50", hjust = 1,
                               margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.3),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", color = "#2C3E50"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "white"),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
  )

# Function to create comprehensive block yield evolution
create_all_blocks_yield_evolution <- function(data) {
  
  cat("Preparing comprehensive block yield evolution analysis...\n")
  
  # Convert campaign to numeric year (same as before)
  convert_campaign_to_year <- function(campaign) {
    campaign_clean <- as.character(campaign)
    start_year <- sapply(strsplit(campaign_clean, "-"), function(x) x[1])
    numeric_years <- as.numeric(start_year)
    full_years <- ifelse(numeric_years <= 49, 2000 + numeric_years, 1900 + numeric_years)
    return(full_years)
  }
  
  # Prepare data
  analysis_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(tc_per_ha_actual),
      !is.na(campaign),
      !is.na(irrigation_type),
      tc_per_ha_actual > 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      year = convert_campaign_to_year(campaign),
      block = as.character(block),
      irrigation_type = as.character(irrigation_type)
    )
  
  # Calculate block statistics to determine which blocks to show
  block_stats <- analysis_data %>%
    group_by(block, irrigation_type) %>%
    summarise(
      n_years = n_distinct(year),
      n_obs = n(),
      mean_yield = mean(tc_per_ha_actual, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_yield = sd(tc_per_ha_actual, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_year = min(year),
      max_year = max(year),
      year_span = max_year - min_year + 1,
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    # Filter for blocks with meaningful data
    filter(n_obs >= 3, n_years >= 2) %>%  # At least 3 observations and 2 different years
    arrange(desc(n_obs), desc(n_years))
  
  cat("Blocks to analyze:", nrow(block_stats), "\n")
  cat("Total observations:", sum(block_stats$n_obs), "\n")
  
  # Get blocks to display
  blocks_to_show <- block_stats$block
  
  # Filter data for selected blocks
  block_data <- analysis_data %>%
    filter(block %in% blocks_to_show) %>%
    # Add block statistics for ordering and labeling
    left_join(block_stats %>% select(block, irrigation_type, n_obs, mean_yield), 
              by = c("block", "irrigation_type")) %>%
    # Create enhanced block labels
    mutate(
      block_label = paste0("Block ", block, 
                          "\n(", irrigation_type, ", n=", n_obs, 
                          ", avg=", round(mean_yield, 1), " tc/ha)")
    )
  
  # Calculate yearly averages for each block
  block_yearly_stats <- block_data %>%
    group_by(block, year, irrigation_type, block_label) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_yield = mean(tc_per_ha_actual, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_yield = median(tc_per_ha_actual, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_plots = n(),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Determine optimal plot arrangement
  n_blocks <- length(blocks_to_show)
  if (n_blocks <= 12) {
    ncol_facet <- 4
  } else if (n_blocks <= 20) {
    ncol_facet <- 5
  } else if (n_blocks <= 30) {
    ncol_facet <- 6
  } else {
    ncol_facet <- 7
  }
  
  # Create the main faceted plot
  p1 <- ggplot(block_data, aes(x = year, y = tc_per_ha_actual)) +
    # Add all individual points with transparency
    geom_point(aes(color = irrigation_type), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2) +
    # Add yearly averages as larger points
    geom_point(data = block_yearly_stats, aes(x = year, y = mean_yield, color = irrigation_type), 
               size = 3, alpha = 0.9, shape = 16) +
    # Add trend line
    geom_smooth(aes(color = irrigation_type), method = "lm", se = TRUE, 
                alpha = 0.3, size = 1, linetype = "solid") +
    # Add local trend (loess) for comparison
    geom_smooth(aes(color = irrigation_type), method = "loess", se = FALSE, 
                alpha = 0.7, size = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
    # Facet by block
    facet_wrap(~ block_label, scales = "free_y", ncol = ncol_facet) +
    # Scales and colors
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Irrigation Type", option = "D", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Yield (tc/ha)", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 4)) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "Year", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 4)) +
    # Labels
    labs(
      title = "Yield Evolution by Block - Comprehensive Analysis",
      subtitle = paste0("Individual observations (small points), yearly averages (large points), ", 
                       "linear trends (solid lines), local trends (dashed lines)"),
      caption = paste0("Showing ", n_blocks, " blocks with ≥3 observations and ≥2 years • ",
                      "Block labels show irrigation type, sample size, and average yield")
    ) +
    block_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal"
    )
  
  # Create a summary performance plot
  p2 <- ggplot(block_stats, aes(x = n_obs, y = mean_yield, color = irrigation_type)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = year_span), alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = block), vjust = -0.7, hjust = 0.5, size = 3, 
              check_overlap = TRUE, color = "black") +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Irrigation Type", option = "D", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Year Span", range = c(3, 8), 
                         breaks = c(1, 3, 5, 10), labels = c("1", "3", "5", "10+")) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "Number of Observations", 
                       breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6),
                       trans = "log10") +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Average Yield (tc/ha)", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
    labs(
      title = "Block Performance Summary",
      subtitle = "Average yield vs data availability by block",
      caption = "Point size reflects time span covered • Block IDs labeled"
    ) +
    block_theme
  
  # Create yield distribution by block (top performers)
  top_blocks <- block_stats %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_yield)) %>%
    head(12) %>%
    pull(block)
  
  p3 <- block_data %>%
    filter(block %in% top_blocks) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(paste("Block", block), mean_yield), y = tc_per_ha_actual, fill = irrigation_type)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.size = 1) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = irrigation_type), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Irrigation", option = "D", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Irrigation", option = "D", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Yield (tc/ha)", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
    scale_x_discrete(name = "Block (ordered by average yield)") +
    labs(
      title = "Yield Distribution - Top 12 Performing Blocks",
      subtitle = "Boxplots show distribution, points show individual observations",
      caption = "Blocks ordered by average yield performance"
    ) +
    block_theme +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    coord_flip()
  
  # Create trend analysis summary
  trend_analysis <- block_data %>%
    group_by(block, irrigation_type) %>%
    do({
      if(nrow(.) >= 4) {  # Need at least 4 points for meaningful trend
        model <- lm(tc_per_ha_actual ~ year, data = .)
        data.frame(
          slope = coef(model)[2],
          p_value = summary(model)$coefficients[2, 4],
          r_squared = summary(model)$r.squared,
          n_obs = nrow(.)
        )
      } else {
        data.frame(slope = NA, p_value = NA, r_squared = NA, n_obs = nrow(.))
      }
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(slope)) %>%
    left_join(block_stats %>% select(block, irrigation_type, mean_yield), 
              by = c("block", "irrigation_type")) %>%
    mutate(
      trend_category = case_when(
        p_value < 0.05 & slope > 0 ~ "Significant Increase",
        p_value < 0.05 & slope < 0 ~ "Significant Decrease", 
        TRUE ~ "No Significant Trend"
      ),
      trend_strength = case_when(
        abs(slope) < 0.5 ~ "Weak",
        abs(slope) < 1.5 ~ "Moderate",
        TRUE ~ "Strong"
      )
    )
  
  p4 <- ggplot(trend_analysis, aes(x = slope, y = mean_yield, color = irrigation_type)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = r_squared), alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = block), vjust = -0.7, hjust = 0.5, size = 3, 
              check_overlap = TRUE, color = "black") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Irrigation", option = "D", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "R²", range = c(3, 8), 
                         labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "Yield Trend Slope (tc/ha per year)", 
                       breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Average Yield (tc/ha)", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
    labs(
      title = "Block Yield Trends Analysis",
      subtitle = "Relationship between trend direction/strength and average performance",
      caption = "Point size reflects trend reliability (R²) • Positive slope = improving yields"
    ) +
    block_theme
  
  # Print summary statistics
  cat("\n=== BLOCK ANALYSIS SUMMARY ===\n")
  cat("Total blocks analyzed:", nrow(block_stats), "\n")
  cat("Blocks with significant increasing trends:", 
      sum(trend_analysis$trend_category == "Significant Increase", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("Blocks with significant decreasing trends:", 
      sum(trend_analysis$trend_category == "Significant Decrease", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("Blocks with no significant trend:", 
      sum(trend_analysis$trend_category == "No Significant Trend", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  
  # Save all plots
  ggsave("all_blocks_yield_evolution.png", p1, 
         width = 20, height = ceiling(n_blocks/ncol_facet) * 3, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  ggsave("blocks_performance_summary.png", p2, 
         width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  ggsave("top_blocks_yield_distribution.png", p3, 
         width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  ggsave("blocks_trend_analysis.png", p4, 
         width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  return(list(
    main_plot = p1,
    summary_plot = p2, 
    distribution_plot = p3,
    trend_plot = p4,
    block_stats = block_stats,
    trend_analysis = trend_analysis,
    block_data = block_data
  ))
}

# Execute the analysis
block_results <- create_all_blocks_yield_evolution(data)

# Display the main plot
print(block_results$main_plot)
```

```{r}
    ncol_facet <- 5
  } else if (n_blocks <= 30) {
    ncol_facet <- 6
  } else {
    ncol_facet <- 7
  }
  
  # Create the main faceted plot
  p1 <- ggplot(block_data, aes(x = year, y = tc_per_ha_actual)) +
    # Add all individual points with transparency
    geom_point(aes(color = irrigation_type), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2) +
    # Add yearly averages as larger points
    geom_point(data = block_yearly_stats, aes(x = year, y = mean_yield, color = irrigation_type), 
               size = 3, alpha = 0.9, shape = 16) +
    # Add primary loess trend line (non-linear)
    geom_smooth(aes(color = irrigation_type), method = "loess", se = TRUE, 
                alpha = 0.3, size = 1.2, linetype = "solid", span = 0.7) +
    # Add smoother loess trend for long-term patterns
    geom_smooth(aes(color = irrigation_type), method = "loess", se = FALSE, 
                alpha = 0.7, size = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", span = 1.2) +
    # Facet by block
    facet_wrap(~ block_label, scales = "free_y", ncol = ncol_facet) +
    # Scales and colors
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Irrigation Type", option = "D", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Yield (tc/ha)", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 4)) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "Year", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 4)) +
    # Labels
    labs(
      title = "Yield Evolution by Block - Comprehensive Analysis",
      subtitle = paste0("Individual observations (small points), yearly averages (large points), ", 
                       "linear trends (solid lines), local trends (dashed lines)"),
      caption = paste0("Showing ", n_blocks, " blocks with ≥3 observations and ≥2 years • ",
                      "Block labels show irrigation type, sample size, and average yield")
    ) +
    block_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal"
    )
  
  # Create a summary performance plot
  p2 <- ggplot(block_stats, aes(x = n_obs, y = mean_yield, color = irrigation_type)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = year_span), alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = block), vjust = -0.7, hjust = 0.5, size = 3, 
              check_overlap = TRUE, color = "black") +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Irrigation Type", option = "D", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Year Span", range = c(3, 8), 
                         breaks = c(1, 3, 5, 10), labels = c("1", "3", "5", "10+")) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "Number of Observations", 
                       breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6),
                       trans = "log10") +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Average Yield (tc/ha)", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
    labs(
      title = "Block Performance Summary",
      subtitle = "Average yield vs data availability by block",
      caption = "Point size reflects time span covered • Block IDs labeled"
    ) +
    block_theme
  
  # Create yield distribution by block (top performers)
  top_blocks <- block_stats %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_yield)) %>%
    head(12) %>%
    pull(block)
  
  p3 <- block_data %>%
    filter(block %in% top_blocks) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(paste("Block", block), mean_yield), y = tc_per_ha_actual, fill = irrigation_type)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.size = 1) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = irrigation_type), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Irrigation", option = "D", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Irrigation", option = "D", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Yield (tc/ha)", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
    scale_x_discrete(name = "Block (ordered by average yield)") +
    labs(
      title = "Yield Distribution - Top 12 Performing Blocks",
      subtitle = "Boxplots show distribution, points show individual observations",
      caption = "Blocks ordered by average yield performance"
    ) +
    block_theme +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    coord_flip()
  
  # Create trend analysis summary
  trend_analysis <- block_data %>%
    group_by(block, irrigation_type) %>%
    do({
      if(nrow(.) >= 4) {  # Need at least 4 points for meaningful trend
        model <- lm(tc_per_ha_actual ~ year, data = .)
        data.frame(
          slope = coef(model)[2],
          p_value = summary(model)$coefficients[2, 4],
          r_squared = summary(model)$r.squared,
          n_obs = nrow(.)
        )
      } else {
        data.frame(slope = NA, p_value = NA, r_squared = NA, n_obs = nrow(.))
      }
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(slope)) %>%
    left_join(block_stats %>% select(block, irrigation_type, mean_yield), 
              by = c("block", "irrigation_type")) %>%
    mutate(
      trend_category = case_when(
        p_value < 0.05 & slope > 0 ~ "Significant Increase",
        p_value < 0.05 & slope < 0 ~ "Significant Decrease", 
        TRUE ~ "No Significant Trend"
      ),
      trend_strength = case_when(
        abs(slope) < 0.5 ~ "Weak",
        abs(slope) < 1.5 ~ "Moderate",
        TRUE ~ "Strong"
      )
    )
  
  p4 <- ggplot(trend_analysis, aes(x = slope, y = mean_yield, color = irrigation_type)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = r_squared), alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = block), vjust = -0.7, hjust = 0.5, size = 3, 
              check_overlap = TRUE, color = "black") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Irrigation", option = "D", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "R²", range = c(3, 8), 
                         labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "Yield Trend Slope (tc/ha per year)", 
                       breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Average Yield (tc/ha)", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
    labs(
      title = "Block Yield Trends Analysis",
      subtitle = "Relationship between trend direction/strength and average performance",
      caption = "Point size reflects trend reliability (R²) • Positive slope = improving yields"
    ) +
    block_theme
  
  # Print summary statistics
  cat("\n=== BLOCK ANALYSIS SUMMARY ===\n")
  cat("Total blocks analyzed:", nrow(block_stats), "\n")
  cat("Blocks with significant increasing trends:", 
      sum(trend_analysis$trend_category == "Significant Increase", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("Blocks with significant decreasing trends:", 
      sum(trend_analysis$trend_category == "Significant Decrease", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("Blocks with no significant trend:", 
      sum(trend_analysis$trend_category == "No Significant Trend", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  
  # Save all plots
  ggsave("all_blocks_yield_evolution.png", p1, 
         width = 20, height = ceiling(n_blocks/ncol_facet) * 3, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  ggsave("blocks_performance_summary.png", p2, 
         width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  ggsave("top_blocks_yield_distribution.png", p3, 
         width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  ggsave("blocks_trend_analysis.png", p4, 
         width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  return(list(
    main_plot = p1,
    summary_plot = p2, 
    distribution_plot = p3,
    trend_plot = p4,
    block_stats = block_stats,
    trend_analysis = trend_analysis,
    block_data = block_data
  ))
}

# Execute the analysis
block_results <- create_all_blocks_yield_evolution(data)

# Display the main plot
print(block_results$main_plot)
```

```{r}
# Comprehensive Block Yield Evolution Analysis
# Show yield trends for all blocks with great visualization

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(gridExtra)

# Enhanced theme for block analysis
block_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                             margin = margin(b = 15), color = "#2C3E50"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40", 
                                margin = margin(b = 15), face = "italic"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray50", hjust = 1,
                               margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.3),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", color = "#2C3E50"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "white"),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
  )

# Function to create comprehensive block yield evolution
create_all_blocks_yield_evolution <- function(data) {
  
  cat("Preparing comprehensive block yield evolution analysis...\n")
  
  # Convert campaign to numeric year (same as before)
  convert_campaign_to_year <- function(campaign) {
    campaign_clean <- as.character(campaign)
    start_year <- sapply(strsplit(campaign_clean, "-"), function(x) x[1])
    numeric_years <- as.numeric(start_year)
    full_years <- ifelse(numeric_years <= 49, 2000 + numeric_years, 1900 + numeric_years)
    return(full_years)
  }
  
  # Prepare data
  analysis_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(tc_per_ha_actual),
      !is.na(campaign),
      !is.na(irrigation_type),
      tc_per_ha_actual > 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      year = convert_campaign_to_year(campaign),
      block = as.character(block),
      irrigation_type = as.character(irrigation_type)
    )
  
  # Calculate block statistics to determine which blocks to show
  block_stats <- analysis_data %>%
    group_by(block, irrigation_type) %>%
    summarise(
      n_years = n_distinct(year),
      n_obs = n(),
      mean_yield = mean(tc_per_ha_actual, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_yield = sd(tc_per_ha_actual, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_year = min(year),
      max_year = max(year),
      year_span = max_year - min_year + 1,
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    # Filter for blocks with meaningful data
    filter(n_obs >= 3, n_years >= 2) %>%  # At least 3 observations and 2 different years
    arrange(desc(n_obs), desc(n_years))
  
  cat("Blocks to analyze:", nrow(block_stats), "\n")
  cat("Total observations:", sum(block_stats$n_obs), "\n")
  
  # Get blocks to display
  blocks_to_show <- block_stats$block
  
  # Filter data for selected blocks
  block_data <- analysis_data %>%
    filter(block %in% blocks_to_show) %>%
    # Add block statistics for ordering and labeling
    left_join(block_stats %>% select(block, irrigation_type, n_obs, mean_yield), 
              by = c("block", "irrigation_type")) %>%
    # Create enhanced block labels
    mutate(
      block_label = paste0("Block ", block, 
                          "\n(", irrigation_type, ", n=", n_obs, 
                          ", avg=", round(mean_yield, 1), " tc/ha)")
    )
  
  # Calculate yearly averages for each block
  block_yearly_stats <- block_data %>%
    group_by(block, year, irrigation_type, block_label) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_yield = mean(tc_per_ha_actual, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_yield = median(tc_per_ha_actual, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_plots = n(),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Determine optimal plot arrangement
  n_blocks <- length(blocks_to_show)
  if (n_blocks <= 12) {
    ncol_facet <- 4
  } else if (n_blocks <= 20) {
    ncol_facet <- 5
  } else if (n_blocks <= 30) {
    ncol_facet <- 6
  } else {
    ncol_facet <- 7
  }
  
  # Create the main faceted plot
  p1 <- ggplot(block_data, aes(x = year, y = tc_per_ha_actual)) +
    # Add all individual points with transparency
    geom_point(aes(color = irrigation_type), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2) +
    # Add yearly averages as larger points
    geom_point(data = block_yearly_stats, aes(x = year, y = mean_yield, color = irrigation_type), 
               size = 3, alpha = 0.9, shape = 16) +
    # Add primary loess trend line (non-linear)
    geom_smooth(aes(color = irrigation_type), method = "loess", se = TRUE, 
                alpha = 0.3, size = 1.2, linetype = "solid", span = 0.7) +
    # Add smoother loess trend for long-term patterns
    geom_smooth(aes(color = irrigation_type), method = "loess", se = FALSE, 
                alpha = 0.7, size = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", span = 1.2) +
    # Facet by block
    facet_wrap(~ block_label, scales = "free_y", ncol = ncol_facet) +
    # Scales and colors
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Irrigation Type", option = "D", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Yield (tc/ha)", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 4)) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "Year", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 4)) +
    # Labels
    labs(
      title = "Yield Evolution by Block - Non-Linear Trend Analysis",
      subtitle = paste0("Individual observations (small points), yearly averages (large points), ", 
                       "flexible trends (solid lines), long-term patterns (dashed lines)"),
      caption = paste0("Showing ", n_blocks, " blocks with ≥3 observations and ≥2 years • ",
                      "Using LOESS smoothing to capture non-linear yield patterns • ",
                      "Block labels show irrigation type, sample size, and average yield")
    ) +
    block_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal"
    )
  
  # Create a summary performance plot
  p2 <- ggplot(block_stats, aes(x = n_obs, y = mean_yield, color = irrigation_type)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = year_span), alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = block), vjust = -0.7, hjust = 0.5, size = 3, 
              check_overlap = TRUE, color = "black") +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Irrigation Type", option = "D", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Year Span", range = c(3, 8), 
                         breaks = c(1, 3, 5, 10), labels = c("1", "3", "5", "10+")) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "Number of Observations", 
                       breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6),
                       trans = "log10") +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Average Yield (tc/ha)", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
    labs(
      title = "Block Performance Summary",
      subtitle = "Average yield vs data availability by block",
      caption = "Point size reflects time span covered • Block IDs labeled"
    ) +
    block_theme
  
  # Create yield distribution by block (top performers)
  top_blocks <- block_stats %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_yield)) %>%
    head(12) %>%
    pull(block)
  
  p3 <- block_data %>%
    filter(block %in% top_blocks) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(paste("Block", block), mean_yield), y = tc_per_ha_actual, fill = irrigation_type)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8, outlier.size = 1) +
    geom_jitter(aes(color = irrigation_type), width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Irrigation", option = "D", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Irrigation", option = "D", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Yield (tc/ha)", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
    scale_x_discrete(name = "Block (ordered by average yield)") +
    labs(
      title = "Yield Distribution - Top 12 Performing Blocks",
      subtitle = "Boxplots show distribution, points show individual observations",
      caption = "Blocks ordered by average yield performance"
    ) +
    block_theme +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    coord_flip()
  
  # Create trend analysis summary using loess instead of linear
  trend_analysis <- block_data %>%
    group_by(block, irrigation_type) %>%
    do({
      if(nrow(.) >= 4) {  # Need at least 4 points for meaningful trend
        years <- .$year
        yields <- .$tc_per_ha_actual
        
        # Fit loess model
        tryCatch({
          loess_model <- loess(yields ~ years, span = 0.8)
          predicted_yields <- predict(loess_model)
          
          # Calculate trend metrics
          first_pred <- predicted_yields[which.min(years)]
          last_pred <- predicted_yields[which.max(years)]
          year_span <- max(years) - min(years)
          
          # Calculate average rate of change
          avg_change_per_year <- (last_pred - first_pred) / year_span
          
          # Calculate R-squared equivalent for loess
          total_ss <- sum((yields - mean(yields))^2)
          residual_ss <- sum((yields - predicted_yields)^2)
          pseudo_r_squared <- 1 - (residual_ss / total_ss)
          
          # Determine trend direction and magnitude
          trend_direction <- ifelse(avg_change_per_year > 0, "Increasing", "Decreasing")
          trend_magnitude <- abs(avg_change_per_year)
          
          data.frame(
            avg_change_per_year = avg_change_per_year,
            trend_magnitude = trend_magnitude,
            pseudo_r_squared = max(0, pseudo_r_squared), # Ensure non-negative
            trend_direction = trend_direction,
            n_obs = nrow(.),
            first_pred = first_pred,
            last_pred = last_pred,
            year_span = year_span
          )
        }, error = function(e) {
          data.frame(
            avg_change_per_year = NA, trend_magnitude = NA, pseudo_r_squared = NA,
            trend_direction = NA, n_obs = nrow(.), first_pred = NA, 
            last_pred = NA, year_span = NA
          )
        })
      } else {
        data.frame(
          avg_change_per_year = NA, trend_magnitude = NA, pseudo_r_squared = NA,
          trend_direction = NA, n_obs = nrow(.), first_pred = NA, 
          last_pred = NA, year_span = NA
        )
      }
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(avg_change_per_year)) %>%
    left_join(block_stats %>% select(block, irrigation_type, mean_yield), 
              by = c("block", "irrigation_type")) %>%
    mutate(
      trend_category = case_when(
        pseudo_r_squared > 0.3 & avg_change_per_year > 0.5 ~ "Strong Increase",
        pseudo_r_squared > 0.3 & avg_change_per_year < -0.5 ~ "Strong Decrease",
        pseudo_r_squared > 0.1 & avg_change_per_year > 0.2 ~ "Moderate Increase",
        pseudo_r_squared > 0.1 & avg_change_per_year < -0.2 ~ "Moderate Decrease",
        TRUE ~ "Stable/Weak Trend"
      ),
      trend_strength = case_when(
        trend_magnitude < 0.3 ~ "Weak",
        trend_magnitude < 0.8 ~ "Moderate",
        TRUE ~ "Strong"
      )
    )
  
  p4 <- ggplot(trend_analysis, aes(x = avg_change_per_year, y = mean_yield, color = irrigation_type)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = pseudo_r_squared), alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = block), vjust = -0.7, hjust = 0.5, size = 3, 
              check_overlap = TRUE, color = "black") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.5) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Irrigation", option = "D", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Pseudo R²", range = c(3, 8), 
                         labels = function(x) sprintf("%.2f", x)) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "Average Yield Change (tc/ha per year)", 
                       breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Average Yield (tc/ha)", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
    labs(
      title = "Block Non-Linear Trend Analysis",
      subtitle = "Average rate of change from LOESS smoothing vs overall performance",
      caption = "Point size reflects trend reliability (Pseudo R²) • Positive change = improving yields"
    ) +
    block_theme
  
  # Print summary statistics
  cat("\n=== BLOCK NON-LINEAR TREND ANALYSIS SUMMARY ===\n")
  cat("Total blocks analyzed:", nrow(block_stats), "\n")
  cat("Blocks with strong increasing trends:", 
      sum(trend_analysis$trend_category == "Strong Increase", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("Blocks with moderate increasing trends:", 
      sum(trend_analysis$trend_category == "Moderate Increase", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("Blocks with strong decreasing trends:", 
      sum(trend_analysis$trend_category == "Strong Decrease", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("Blocks with moderate decreasing trends:", 
      sum(trend_analysis$trend_category == "Moderate Decrease", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("Blocks with stable/weak trends:", 
      sum(trend_analysis$trend_category == "Stable/Weak Trend", na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  
  # Save all plots
  ggsave("all_blocks_yield_evolution_loess.png", p1, 
         width = 20, height = ceiling(n_blocks/ncol_facet) * 3, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  ggsave("blocks_performance_summary.png", p2, 
         width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  ggsave("top_blocks_yield_distribution.png", p3, 
         width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  ggsave("blocks_loess_trend_analysis.png", p4, 
         width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  cat("\nPlots saved:\n")
  cat("- all_blocks_yield_evolution_loess.png (main non-linear trends plot)\n")
  cat("- blocks_performance_summary.png\n") 
  cat("- top_blocks_yield_distribution.png\n")
  cat("- blocks_loess_trend_analysis.png\n")
  
  return(list(
    main_plot = p1,
    summary_plot = p2, 
    distribution_plot = p3,
    trend_plot = p4,
    block_stats = block_stats,
    trend_analysis = trend_analysis,
    block_data = block_data
  ))
}

# Function to create comprehensive block brix evolution
create_all_blocks_brix_evolution <- function(data) {
  
  cat("Preparing comprehensive block brix evolution analysis...\n")
  
  # Convert campaign to numeric year (same as before)
  convert_campaign_to_year <- function(campaign) {
    campaign_clean <- as.character(campaign)
    start_year <- sapply(strsplit(campaign_clean, "-"), function(x) x[1])
    numeric_years <- as.numeric(start_year)
    full_years <- ifelse(numeric_years <= 49, 2000 + numeric_years, 1900 + numeric_years)
    return(full_years)
  }
  
  # Prepare data
  analysis_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(brix_percent),
      !is.na(campaign),
      !is.na(irrigation_type),
      brix_percent > 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      year = convert_campaign_to_year(campaign),
      block = as.character(block),
      irrigation_type = as.character(irrigation_type)
    )
  
  # Calculate block statistics
  block_stats <- analysis_data %>%
    group_by(block, irrigation_type) %>%
    summarise(
      n_years = n_distinct(year),
      n_obs = n(),
      mean_brix = mean(brix_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_brix = sd(brix_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_year = min(year),
      max_year = max(year),
      year_span = max_year - min_year + 1,
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    filter(n_obs >= 3, n_years >= 2) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_obs), desc(n_years))
  
  cat("Blocks to analyze:", nrow(block_stats), "\n")
  
  # Get blocks to display
  blocks_to_show <- block_stats$block
  
  # Filter data for selected blocks
  block_data <- analysis_data %>%
    filter(block %in% blocks_to_show) %>%
    left_join(block_stats %>% select(block, irrigation_type, n_obs, mean_brix), 
              by = c("block", "irrigation_type")) %>%
    mutate(
      block_label = paste0("Block ", block, 
                          "\n(", irrigation_type, ", n=", n_obs, 
                          ", avg=", round(mean_brix, 1), "% brix)")
    )
  
  # Calculate yearly averages
  block_yearly_stats <- block_data %>%
    group_by(block, year, irrigation_type, block_label) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_brix = mean(brix_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_brix = median(brix_percent, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_plots = n(),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Determine plot arrangement
  n_blocks <- length(blocks_to_show)
  if (n_blocks <= 12) {
    ncol_facet <- 4
  } else if (n_blocks <= 20) {
    ncol_facet <- 5
  } else if (n_blocks <= 30) {
    ncol_facet <- 6
  } else {
    ncol_facet <- 7
  }
  
  # Create the main faceted plot
  p1 <- ggplot(block_data, aes(x = year, y = brix_percent)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = irrigation_type), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2) +
    geom_point(data = block_yearly_stats, aes(x = year, y = mean_brix, color = irrigation_type), 
               size = 3, alpha = 0.9, shape = 16) +
    geom_smooth(aes(color = irrigation_type), method = "loess", se = TRUE, 
                alpha = 0.3, size = 1.2, linetype = "solid", span = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(aes(color = irrigation_type), method = "loess", se = FALSE, 
                alpha = 0.7, size = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", span = 1.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ block_label, scales = "free_y", ncol = ncol_facet) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Irrigation Type", option = "D", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Brix Percentage (%)", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 4)) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "Year", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 4)) +
    labs(
      title = "Brix Evolution by Block - Non-Linear Trend Analysis",
      subtitle = paste0("Individual observations (small points), yearly averages (large points), ", 
                       "flexible trends (solid lines), long-term patterns (dashed lines)"),
      caption = paste0("Showing ", n_blocks, " blocks with ≥3 observations and ≥2 years • ",
                      "Using LOESS smoothing to capture non-linear brix patterns")
    ) +
    block_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  # Save plot
  ggsave("all_blocks_brix_evolution_loess.png", p1, 
         width = 20, height = ceiling(n_blocks/ncol_facet) * 3, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  cat("Brix evolution plot saved: all_blocks_brix_evolution_loess.png\n")
  
  return(list(main_plot = p1, block_stats = block_stats, block_data = block_data))
}

# Function to create comprehensive block surface area evolution
create_all_blocks_surface_evolution <- function(data) {
  
  cat("Preparing comprehensive block surface area evolution analysis...\n")
  
  # Convert campaign to numeric year
  convert_campaign_to_year <- function(campaign) {
    campaign_clean <- as.character(campaign)
    start_year <- sapply(strsplit(campaign_clean, "-"), function(x) x[1])
    numeric_years <- as.numeric(start_year)
    full_years <- ifelse(numeric_years <= 49, 2000 + numeric_years, 1900 + numeric_years)
    return(full_years)
  }
  
  # Prepare data
  analysis_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(surface_area_ha),
      !is.na(campaign),
      !is.na(irrigation_type),
      surface_area_ha > 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      year = convert_campaign_to_year(campaign),
      block = as.character(block),
      irrigation_type = as.character(irrigation_type)
    )
  
  # Calculate block statistics
  block_stats <- analysis_data %>%
    group_by(block, irrigation_type) %>%
    summarise(
      n_years = n_distinct(year),
      n_obs = n(),
      mean_surface = mean(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_surface = sd(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_year = min(year),
      max_year = max(year),
      year_span = max_year - min_year + 1,
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    filter(n_obs >= 3, n_years >= 2) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_obs), desc(n_years))
  
  cat("Blocks to analyze:", nrow(block_stats), "\n")
  
  # Get blocks to display
  blocks_to_show <- block_stats$block
  
  # Filter data for selected blocks
  block_data <- analysis_data %>%
    filter(block %in% blocks_to_show) %>%
    left_join(block_stats %>% select(block, irrigation_type, n_obs, mean_surface), 
              by = c("block", "irrigation_type")) %>%
    mutate(
      block_label = paste0("Block ", block, 
                          "\n(", irrigation_type, ", n=", n_obs, 
                          ", avg=", round(mean_surface, 1), " ha)")
    )
  
  # Calculate yearly averages
  block_yearly_stats <- block_data %>%
    group_by(block, year, irrigation_type, block_label) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_surface = mean(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_surface = median(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_plots = n(),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Determine plot arrangement
  n_blocks <- length(blocks_to_show)
  if (n_blocks <= 12) {
    ncol_facet <- 4
  } else if (n_blocks <= 20) {
    ncol_facet <- 5
  } else if (n_blocks <= 30) {
    ncol_facet <- 6
  } else {
    ncol_facet <- 7
  }
  
  # Create the main faceted plot
  p1 <- ggplot(block_data, aes(x = year, y = surface_area_ha)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = irrigation_type), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2) +
    geom_point(data = block_yearly_stats, aes(x = year, y = mean_surface, color = irrigation_type), 
               size = 3, alpha = 0.9, shape = 16) +
    geom_smooth(aes(color = irrigation_type), method = "loess", se = TRUE, 
                alpha = 0.3, size = 1.2, linetype = "solid", span = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(aes(color = irrigation_type), method = "loess", se = FALSE, 
                alpha = 0.7, size = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", span = 1.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ block_label, scales = "free_y", ncol = ncol_facet) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Irrigation Type", option = "D", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Surface Area (ha)", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 4)) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "Year", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 4)) +
    labs(
      title = "Surface Area Evolution by Block - Non-Linear Trend Analysis",
      subtitle = paste0("Individual observations (small points), yearly averages (large points), ", 
                       "flexible trends (solid lines), long-term patterns (dashed lines)"),
      caption = paste0("Showing ", n_blocks, " blocks with ≥3 observations and ≥2 years • ",
                      "Using LOESS smoothing to capture plot size changes over time")
    ) +
    block_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  # Save plot
  ggsave("all_blocks_surface_evolution_loess.png", p1, 
         width = 20, height = ceiling(n_blocks/ncol_facet) * 3, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  cat("Surface area evolution plot saved: all_blocks_surface_evolution_loess.png\n")
  
  return(list(main_plot = p1, block_stats = block_stats, block_data = block_data))
}

# Execute all three analyses
cat("=== RUNNING ALL BLOCK EVOLUTION ANALYSES ===\n\n")

# 1. Yield evolution (already defined above)
cat("1. YIELD EVOLUTION ANALYSIS\n")
yield_results <- create_all_blocks_yield_evolution(data)

# 2. Brix evolution
cat("\n2. BRIX EVOLUTION ANALYSIS\n")
brix_results <- create_all_blocks_brix_evolution(data)

# 3. Surface area evolution  
cat("\n3. SURFACE AREA EVOLUTION ANALYSIS\n")
surface_results <- create_all_blocks_surface_evolution(data)

# Display summary
cat("\nSUMMARY:\n")
cat("Yield analysis - Blocks:", nrow(yield_results$block_stats), "\n")
cat("Brix analysis - Blocks:", nrow(brix_results$block_stats), "\n") 
cat("Surface analysis - Blocks:", nrow(surface_results$block_stats), "\n")
```

## IV.2. Block Surface Area Evolution with Variety Analysis

```{r}
# Block Surface Area Evolution with Variety Analysis
# Analyze variety distribution in each block for the last campaign

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(gridExtra)
library(patchwork)

# Enhanced theme for block analysis
block_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                             margin = margin(b = 15), color = "#2C3E50"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40", 
                                margin = margin(b = 15), face = "italic"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray50", hjust = 1,
                               margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.3),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", color = "#2C3E50"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = "white"),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
  )

# Function to create enhanced surface area evolution with variety analysis
create_enhanced_surface_variety_analysis <- function(data) {
  
  cat("Preparing enhanced block surface area evolution with variety analysis...\n")
  
  # Convert campaign to numeric year
  convert_campaign_to_year <- function(campaign) {
    campaign_clean <- as.character(campaign)
    start_year <- sapply(strsplit(campaign_clean, "-"), function(x) x[1])
    numeric_years <- as.numeric(start_year)
    full_years <- ifelse(numeric_years <= 49, 2000 + numeric_years, 1900 + numeric_years)
    return(full_years)
  }
  
  # Prepare data with uppercase varieties
  analysis_data <- data %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(surface_area_ha),
      !is.na(campaign),
      !is.na(irrigation_type),
      surface_area_ha > 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      year = convert_campaign_to_year(campaign),
      block = as.character(block),
      irrigation_type = as.character(irrigation_type),
      # Convert variety to uppercase and handle missing values
      variety_clean = ifelse(is.na(variety) | variety == "" | variety == "NA", 
                            "UNKNOWN", 
                            toupper(as.character(variety)))
    )
  
  # Calculate block statistics for surface area
  block_stats <- analysis_data %>%
    group_by(block, irrigation_type) %>%
    summarise(
      n_years = n_distinct(year),
      n_obs = n(),
      mean_surface = mean(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_surface = sd(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_year = min(year),
      max_year = max(year),
      year_span = max_year - min_year + 1,
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    filter(n_obs >= 3, n_years >= 2) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_obs), desc(n_years))
  
  cat("Blocks to analyze:", nrow(block_stats), "\n")
  
  # Get blocks to display
  blocks_to_show <- block_stats$block
  
  # Find the most recent campaign (last campaign)
  last_campaign <- analysis_data %>%
    filter(block %in% blocks_to_show) %>%
    arrange(desc(year)) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    pull(campaign)
  
  last_year <- analysis_data %>%
    filter(block %in% blocks_to_show) %>%
    summarise(max_year = max(year, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(max_year)
  
  cat("Last campaign identified:", last_campaign, "(Year:", last_year, ")\n")
  
  # Analyze variety distribution for each block in the last campaign
  variety_analysis <- analysis_data %>%
    filter(block %in% blocks_to_show, year == last_year) %>%
    group_by(block, irrigation_type, variety_clean) %>%
    summarise(
      variety_surface = sum(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
      variety_plots = n(),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    group_by(block, irrigation_type) %>%
    mutate(
      total_block_surface = sum(variety_surface),
      variety_percentage = round(100 * variety_surface / total_block_surface, 1)
    ) %>%
    arrange(block, desc(variety_surface)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Create variety summary for each block (top varieties)
  variety_summary <- variety_analysis %>%
    group_by(block, irrigation_type) %>%
    arrange(desc(variety_percentage)) %>%
    mutate(
      rank = row_number(),
      variety_short = ifelse(nchar(variety_clean) > 12, 
                            paste0(substr(variety_clean, 1, 12), "..."), 
                            variety_clean)
    ) %>%
    filter(rank <= 3) %>%  # Top 3 varieties per block
    summarise(
      top_varieties = paste(paste0(variety_short, " (", variety_percentage, "%)"), 
                           collapse = "\n"),
      dominant_variety = first(variety_clean),
      dominant_percentage = first(variety_percentage),
      n_varieties = n_distinct(variety_clean),
      total_surface = first(total_block_surface),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Filter data for selected blocks and add variety info
  block_data <- analysis_data %>%
    filter(block %in% blocks_to_show) %>%
    left_join(block_stats %>% select(block, irrigation_type, n_obs, mean_surface), 
              by = c("block", "irrigation_type")) %>%
    left_join(variety_summary %>% select(block, irrigation_type, dominant_variety, 
                                        dominant_percentage, top_varieties, total_surface), 
              by = c("block", "irrigation_type")) %>%
    mutate(
      block_label = paste0("Block ", block, "\n(", irrigation_type, ", n=", n_obs, 
                          ", avg=", round(mean_surface, 1), " ha)\n",
                          "Last: ", round(total_surface, 1), " ha (", last_year, ")")
    )
  
  # Calculate yearly averages for surface area
  block_yearly_stats <- block_data %>%
    group_by(block, year, irrigation_type, block_label) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_surface = mean(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_surface = median(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_plots = n(),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  # Determine plot arrangement
  n_blocks <- length(blocks_to_show)
  if (n_blocks <= 12) {
    ncol_facet <- 4
  } else if (n_blocks <= 20) {
    ncol_facet <- 5
  } else if (n_blocks <= 30) {
    ncol_facet <- 6
  } else {
    ncol_facet <- 7
  }
  
  # Create the main surface area evolution plot
  p1 <- ggplot(block_data, aes(x = year, y = surface_area_ha)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = irrigation_type), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2) +
    geom_point(data = block_yearly_stats, aes(x = year, y = mean_surface, color = irrigation_type), 
               size = 3, alpha = 0.9, shape = 16) +
    geom_smooth(aes(color = irrigation_type), method = "loess", se = TRUE, 
                alpha = 0.3, size = 1.2, linetype = "solid", span = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(aes(color = irrigation_type), method = "loess", se = FALSE, 
                alpha = 0.7, size = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", span = 1.2) +
    facet_wrap(~ block_label, scales = "free_y", ncol = ncol_facet) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Irrigation Type", option = "D", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Surface Area (ha)", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 4)) +
    scale_x_continuous(name = "Year", breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 4)) +
    labs(
      title = "Surface Area Evolution by Block with Variety Analysis",
      subtitle = paste0("Individual observations (small), yearly averages (large), trends (solid/dashed) • ",
                       "Last campaign: ", last_campaign, " (", last_year, ")"),
      caption = paste0("Showing ", n_blocks, " blocks • Block labels include surface area for last campaign")
    ) +
    block_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  # Create variety distribution visualization for last campaign
  # Prepare data for variety plot
  variety_plot_data <- variety_analysis %>%
    left_join(variety_summary %>% select(block, irrigation_type, total_surface), 
              by = c("block", "irrigation_type")) %>%
    mutate(
      block_label = paste0("Block ", block, " (", irrigation_type, ")\n", 
                          round(total_surface, 1), " ha total"),
      variety_label = paste0(variety_clean, "\n", variety_percentage, "%")
    )
  
  # Create variety composition plot (pie charts in facets)
  p2 <- variety_plot_data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = "", y = variety_surface, fill = variety_clean)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "white", size = 0.5) +
    coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
    facet_wrap(~ block_label, ncol = ncol_facet) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Variety", option = "turbo", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Variety Distribution by Block - Campaign ", last_campaign),
      subtitle = "Pie charts show variety composition by surface area",
      caption = "Each pie shows the variety mix planted in that block for the most recent campaign"
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, color = "#2C3E50"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40", face = "italic"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray50", hjust = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", color = "#2C3E50"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 6, override.aes = list(size = 0.7)))
  
  # Create variety ranking table visualization
  variety_table_data <- variety_summary %>%
    left_join(block_stats %>% select(block, irrigation_type), 
              by = c("block", "irrigation_type")) %>%
    arrange(desc(dominant_percentage)) %>%
    mutate(
      block_info = paste0("Block ", block, " (", irrigation_type, ")"),
      rank_order = row_number()
    )
  
  # Create horizontal bar plot for dominant varieties
  p3 <- variety_table_data %>%
    slice_max(dominant_percentage, n = min(20, nrow(variety_table_data))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(block_info, dominant_percentage), y = dominant_percentage, 
               fill = dominant_variety)) +
    geom_col(alpha = 0.8, color = "white", size = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(dominant_variety, " (", dominant_percentage, "%)")), 
              hjust = -0.05, size = 3, color = "black") +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Dominant Variety", option = "turbo", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9) +
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Dominant Variety Percentage (%)", 
                       breaks = seq(0, 100, 20), limits = c(0, 110)) +
    scale_x_discrete(name = "Block") +
    labs(
      title = "Dominant Variety by Block - Most Recent Campaign",
      subtitle = "Blocks ordered by dominance of their main variety",
      caption = "Shows the most planted variety and its percentage of total block area"
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    block_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  # Save all plots
  ggsave("enhanced_surface_evolution_with_variety.png", p1, 
         width = 20, height = ceiling(n_blocks/ncol_facet) * 3, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  ggsave("variety_distribution_by_block.png", p2, 
         width = 20, height = ceiling(n_blocks/ncol_facet) * 3, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  ggsave("dominant_variety_ranking.png", p3, 
         width = 14, height = max(8, min(20, nrow(variety_table_data)) * 0.4), dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  
  # Create comprehensive summary report
  cat("\n=== VARIETY ANALYSIS SUMMARY FOR LAST CAMPAIGN ===\n")
  cat("Campaign:", last_campaign, "(Year:", last_year, ")\n")
  cat("Blocks analyzed:", n_blocks, "\n\n")
  
  # Overall variety statistics
  overall_varieties <- variety_analysis %>%
    group_by(variety_clean) %>%
    summarise(
      total_surface = sum(variety_surface),
      n_blocks = n_distinct(block),
      avg_percentage = mean(variety_percentage),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(total_surface)) %>%
    mutate(
      overall_percentage = round(100 * total_surface / sum(total_surface), 1)
    )
  
  cat("=== TOP VARIETIES ACROSS ALL BLOCKS ===\n")
  for (i in 1:min(10, nrow(overall_varieties))) {
    variety_info <- overall_varieties[i, ]
    cat(sprintf("%2d. %-20s: %6.1f ha (%5.1f%%) in %2d blocks (avg %5.1f%% per block)\n", 
                i, variety_info$variety_clean, variety_info$total_surface, 
                variety_info$overall_percentage, variety_info$n_blocks, 
                variety_info$avg_percentage))
  }
  
  cat("\n=== BLOCK-BY-BLOCK VARIETY ANALYSIS ===\n")
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(variety_summary)) {
    block_info <- variety_summary[i, ]
    cat(sprintf("\nBlock %s (%s):\n", block_info$block, block_info$irrigation_type))
    cat(sprintf("  Total surface: %.1f ha\n", block_info$total_surface))
    cat(sprintf("  Dominant variety: %s (%.1f%%)\n", 
                block_info$dominant_variety, block_info$dominant_percentage))
    cat(sprintf("  Total varieties: %d\n", block_info$n_varieties))
    cat("  Top varieties:\n")
    
    # Get detailed varieties for this block
    block_varieties <- variety_analysis %>%
      filter(block == block_info$block, irrigation_type == block_info$irrigation_type) %>%
      arrange(desc(variety_percentage))
    
    for (j in 1:min(5, nrow(block_varieties))) {
      var_info <- block_varieties[j, ]
      cat(sprintf("    %d. %s: %.1f ha (%.1f%%)\n", 
                  j, var_info$variety_clean, var_info$variety_surface, var_info$variety_percentage))
    }
  }
  
  # Create summary statistics
  diversification_stats <- variety_summary %>%
    summarise(
      avg_dominant_percentage = mean(dominant_percentage, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_dominant_percentage = min(dominant_percentage, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_dominant_percentage = max(dominant_percentage, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_varieties_per_block = mean(n_varieties, na.rm = TRUE),
      total_unique_varieties = length(unique(overall_varieties$variety_clean))
    )
  
  cat("\n=== DIVERSIFICATION STATISTICS ===\n")
  cat(sprintf("Average dominant variety percentage: %.1f%%\n", diversification_stats$avg_dominant_percentage))
  cat(sprintf("Range of dominance: %.1f%% to %.1f%%\n", 
              diversification_stats$min_dominant_percentage, diversification_stats$max_dominant_percentage))
  cat(sprintf("Average varieties per block: %.1f\n", diversification_stats$avg_varieties_per_block))
  cat(sprintf("Total unique varieties: %d\n", diversification_stats$total_unique_varieties))
  
  # Identify most and least diversified blocks
  most_diversified <- variety_summary %>%
    arrange(dominant_percentage) %>%
    head(3)
  
  least_diversified <- variety_summary %>%
    arrange(desc(dominant_percentage)) %>%
    head(3)
  
  cat("\n=== MOST DIVERSIFIED BLOCKS (lowest dominant variety %) ===\n")
  for (i in 1:nrow(most_diversified)) {
    block_info <- most_diversified[i, ]
    cat(sprintf("%d. Block %s (%s): %s %.1f%% (%d varieties)\n", 
                i, block_info$block, block_info$irrigation_type,
                block_info$dominant_variety, block_info$dominant_percentage, block_info$n_varieties))
  }
  
  cat("\n=== LEAST DIVERSIFIED BLOCKS (highest dominant variety %) ===\n")
  for (i in 1:nrow(least_diversified)) {
    block_info <- least_diversified[i, ]
    cat(sprintf("%d. Block %s (%s): %s %.1f%% (%d varieties)\n", 
                i, block_info$block, block_info$irrigation_type,
                block_info$dominant_variety, block_info$dominant_percentage, block_info$n_varieties))
  }
  
  return(list(
    main_plot = p1,
    variety_plot = p2, 
    ranking_plot = p3,
    block_stats = block_stats,
    variety_analysis = variety_analysis,
    variety_summary = variety_summary,
    overall_varieties = overall_varieties,
    diversification_stats = diversification_stats,
    block_data = block_data
  ))
}

# Execute the enhanced analysis

# Run the analysis
results <- create_enhanced_surface_variety_analysis(data)

cat("\n=== ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
```

## **Individual Variety Distribution Plots by Campaign**

```{r}
# Individual Variety Distribution Plots by Campaign - CORRECTED VERSION
# Create separate horizontal bar plot for each campaign
# Modified to show labels only for varieties >= 40%

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(gridExtra)
library(RColorBrewer)

# Enhanced theme for individual campaign plots
campaign_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                             margin = margin(b = 15), color = "#2C3E50"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40", 
                                margin = margin(b = 15), face = "italic"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray50", hjust = 1,
                               margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 1),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.3),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
  )

# Function to create individual variety plots for each campaign
create_individual_variety_plots <- function(data) {
  
  cat("Preparing individual variety distribution plots for each campaign...\n")
  
  # Convert campaign to numeric year
  convert_campaign_to_year <- function(campaign) {
    campaign_clean <- as.character(campaign)
    start_year <- sapply(strsplit(campaign_clean, "-"), function(x) x[1])
    numeric_years <- as.numeric(start_year)
    full_years <- ifelse(numeric_years <= 49, 2000 + numeric_years, 1900 + numeric_years)
    return(full_years)
  }
  
  # Prepare data with uppercase varieties FIRST
  analysis_data <- data %>%
    # Convert variety to uppercase BEFORE any filtering or processing
    mutate(
      variety_clean = ifelse(is.na(variety) | variety == "" | variety == "NA", 
                            "UNKNOWN", 
                            toupper(as.character(variety)))
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(surface_area_ha),
      !is.na(campaign),
      !is.na(variety_clean),
      surface_area_ha > 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      year = convert_campaign_to_year(campaign),
      block = as.character(block),
      irrigation_type = as.character(irrigation_type),
      # Create block-irrigation combination for better labeling
      block_irrigation = paste0("Block ", block, " (", irrigation_type, ")")
    )
  
  # Get all unique campaigns and block-irrigation combinations for consistent ordering
  campaigns <- sort(unique(analysis_data$campaign))
  all_block_irrigations <- sort(unique(analysis_data$block_irrigation))
  
  cat("Campaigns found:", length(campaigns), "\n")
  cat("Campaign list:", paste(campaigns, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("All block-irrigation combinations:", paste(all_block_irrigations, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Get all unique varieties for consistent coloring across plots
  all_varieties <- sort(unique(analysis_data$variety_clean))  # Sort alphabetically
  n_varieties <- length(all_varieties)
  cat("Total unique varieties:", n_varieties, "\n")
  cat("Varieties (alphabetical):", paste(all_varieties[1:min(10, n_varieties)], collapse = ", "), 
      if(n_varieties > 10) "..." else "", "\n")
  
  # Create CONSISTENT color palette for all varieties
  if (n_varieties <= 12) {
    color_palette <- brewer.pal(min(n_varieties, 12), "Set3")
  } else if (n_varieties <= 20) {
    color_palette <- c(brewer.pal(12, "Set3"), brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"))
  } else {
    # For many varieties, use viridis with more colors
    color_palette <- viridis(n_varieties, option = "turbo", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9)
  }
  
  # Assign colors to varieties consistently (alphabetically sorted)
  variety_colors <- setNames(color_palette[1:n_varieties], all_varieties)
  
  # Create individual plot for each campaign
  plot_list <- list()
  
  for (campaign_name in campaigns) {
    cat(sprintf("\nCreating plot for campaign: %s\n", campaign_name))
    
    # Filter data for current campaign
    campaign_data <- analysis_data %>%
      filter(campaign == campaign_name)
    
    if (nrow(campaign_data) == 0) {
      cat(sprintf("No data found for campaign %s, skipping...\n", campaign_name))
      next
    }
    
    # Calculate variety distribution for this campaign
    variety_distribution <- campaign_data %>%
      group_by(block_irrigation, variety_clean) %>%
      summarise(
        variety_surface = sum(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
        variety_plots = n(),
        .groups = 'drop'
      ) %>%
      group_by(block_irrigation) %>%
      mutate(
        total_block_surface = sum(variety_surface),
        variety_percentage = round(100 * variety_surface / total_block_surface, 1)
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      # Only show varieties with at least 3% to avoid cluttering
      filter(variety_percentage >= 3)
    
    if (nrow(variety_distribution) == 0) {
      cat(sprintf("No significant varieties found for campaign %s, skipping...\n", campaign_name))
      next
    }
    
    cat(sprintf("  Blocks in campaign: %d\n", length(unique(variety_distribution$block_irrigation))))
    cat(sprintf("  Varieties shown: %d\n", length(unique(variety_distribution$variety_clean))))
    
    # FIX 1: Create factor with FIXED alphabetical levels for consistent y-axis ordering
    variety_distribution <- variety_distribution %>%
      mutate(
        block_irrigation_factor = factor(block_irrigation, levels = all_block_irrigations)
      )
    
    # Get varieties that appear in this specific campaign for legend filtering
    campaign_varieties <- unique(variety_distribution$variety_clean)
    
    # Create horizontal bar plot for this campaign
    p <- variety_distribution %>%
      # Use consistent factor levels and ensure variety colors are consistent
      mutate(variety_clean = factor(variety_clean, levels = all_varieties)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = variety_percentage, y = block_irrigation_factor, fill = variety_clean)) +
      geom_col(position = "stack", color = "white", size = 0.3) +
      # LABELS: Show varieties >= 40% (large) and >= 10% (smaller text) using the SAME stacking position as bars
      geom_text(
        aes(label = ifelse(variety_percentage >= 10, 
                          paste0(variety_clean, " ", variety_percentage, "%"), 
                          ""),
            size = ifelse(variety_percentage >= 40, 3.5, 2.8)),
        color = "white", fontface = "bold",
        position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)  # Same position system as the bars
      ) +
      scale_size_identity() +  # Use the actual size values specified in aes()
      # FIX 2 & LEGEND FIX: Use consistent color mapping but filter legend to show only campaign varieties
      scale_fill_manual(
        name = "Variety", 
        values = variety_colors, 
        breaks = campaign_varieties,  # Only show varieties present in this campaign
        drop = TRUE  # Drop unused levels from legend
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(name = "Percentage of Block Surface Area (%)", 
                         breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), limits = c(0, 100)) +
      scale_y_discrete(name = "Block (Irrigation Type)", drop = FALSE) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Variety Distribution for Campaign", campaign_name),
        subtitle = "Horizontal stacked bars showing variety composition by block",
        caption = "Showing varieties with ≥3% of block area • Labels shown for varieties ≥10% (large text for ≥40%)"
      ) +
      campaign_theme +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8)
      ) +
      guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 6, override.aes = list(size = 0.8)))
    
    # Save individual plot
    filename <- paste0("variety_distribution_campaign_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", campaign_name), ".png")
    ggsave(filename, p, width = 16, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    cat(sprintf("  Saved: %s\n", filename))
    
    # Add to plot list
    plot_list[[campaign_name]] <- p
  }
  
  # Create summary statistics
  cat("\n=== CAMPAIGN SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
  
  campaign_summary <- analysis_data %>%
    group_by(campaign) %>%
    summarise(
      n_blocks = n_distinct(paste(block, irrigation_type)),
      n_varieties = n_distinct(variety_clean),
      total_surface = sum(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
      avg_surface_per_block = mean(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(campaign)
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(campaign_summary)) {
    campaign_info <- campaign_summary[i, ]
    cat(sprintf("Campaign %s:\n", campaign_info$campaign))
    cat(sprintf("  - Blocks: %d\n", campaign_info$n_blocks))
    cat(sprintf("  - Varieties: %d\n", campaign_info$n_varieties))
    cat(sprintf("  - Total surface: %.1f ha\n", campaign_info$total_surface))
    cat(sprintf("  - Average surface per plot: %.1f ha\n", campaign_info$avg_surface_per_block))
  }
  
  # Top varieties across all campaigns
  cat("\n=== TOP VARIETIES ACROSS ALL CAMPAIGNS ===\n")
  top_varieties_summary <- analysis_data %>%
    group_by(variety_clean) %>%
    summarise(
      total_surface = sum(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_campaigns = n_distinct(campaign),
      n_plots = n(),
      avg_surface_per_plot = mean(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(total_surface)) %>%
    head(15)
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(top_varieties_summary)) {
    variety_info <- top_varieties_summary[i, ]
    cat(sprintf("%2d. %-20s: %.1f ha total, %d campaigns, %d plots, %.1f ha/plot\n", 
                i, variety_info$variety_clean, variety_info$total_surface,
                variety_info$n_campaigns, variety_info$n_plots, variety_info$avg_surface_per_plot))
  }
  
  # Variety diversity by campaign
  cat("\n=== VARIETY DIVERSITY BY CAMPAIGN ===\n")
  diversity_summary <- analysis_data %>%
    group_by(campaign) %>%
    summarise(
      n_varieties = n_distinct(variety_clean),
      # Most common variety
      top_variety = names(sort(table(variety_clean), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
      top_variety_plots = max(table(variety_clean)),
      total_plots = n(),
      top_variety_pct = round(100 * top_variety_plots / total_plots, 1),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_varieties))
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(diversity_summary)) {
    diversity_info <- diversity_summary[i, ]
    cat(sprintf("Campaign %s: %d varieties, most common = %s (%.1f%% of plots)\n", 
                diversity_info$campaign, diversity_info$n_varieties,
                diversity_info$top_variety, diversity_info$top_variety_pct))
  }
  
  cat(sprintf("\n=== COLOR CONSISTENCY CHECK ===\n"))
  cat(sprintf("Created consistent color mapping for %d varieties:\n", n_varieties))
  for (i in 1:min(10, n_varieties)) {
    cat(sprintf("  %s -> %s\n", all_varieties[i], variety_colors[all_varieties[i]]))
  }
  if (n_varieties > 10) cat("  ... and more\n")
  
  cat(sprintf("\n=== FILES GENERATED ===\n"))
  cat(sprintf("Created %d individual campaign plots:\n", length(plot_list)))
  for (campaign_name in names(plot_list)) {
    filename <- paste0("variety_distribution_campaign_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", campaign_name), ".png")
    cat(sprintf("- %s\n", filename))
  }
  
  return(list(
    plots = plot_list,
    campaign_summary = campaign_summary,
    top_varieties_summary = top_varieties_summary,
    diversity_summary = diversity_summary,
    variety_colors = variety_colors,
    all_varieties = all_varieties,
    all_block_irrigations = all_block_irrigations
  ))
}

# Execute the individual variety analysis
cat("=== RUNNING CORRECTED INDIVIDUAL VARIETY DISTRIBUTION ANALYSIS ===\n\n")

# Run the analysis
individual_results <- create_individual_variety_plots(data)
```
