### **Animated Variety Distribution Plots Across Campaigns**

```{r}
# Animated Variety Distribution Plots Across Campaigns
# Create animated GIF showing how variety distribution changes over campaigns

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(gganimate)
library(transformr)  # For smooth transitions

# Enhanced theme for animated plots
animated_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                             margin = margin(b = 20), color = "#2C3E50"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40", 
                                margin = margin(b = 20), face = "italic"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray50", hjust = 1,
                               margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 1),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.3),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
  )

# Function to create animated variety distribution plot
create_animated_variety_plot <- function(data) {
  
  cat("Preparing animated variety distribution plot across campaigns...\n")
  
  # Convert campaign to numeric year for proper ordering
  convert_campaign_to_year <- function(campaign) {
    campaign_clean <- as.character(campaign)
    start_year <- sapply(strsplit(campaign_clean, "-"), function(x) x[1])
    numeric_years <- as.numeric(start_year)
    full_years <- ifelse(numeric_years <= 49, 2000 + numeric_years, 1900 + numeric_years)
    return(full_years)
  }
  
  # Prepare data with uppercase varieties FIRST
  analysis_data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      variety_clean = ifelse(is.na(variety) | variety == "" | variety == "NA", 
                            "UNKNOWN", 
                            toupper(as.character(variety)))
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(surface_area_ha),
      !is.na(campaign),
      !is.na(variety_clean),
      surface_area_ha > 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      year = convert_campaign_to_year(campaign),
      block = as.character(block),
      irrigation_type = as.character(irrigation_type),
      block_irrigation = paste0("Block ", block, " (", irrigation_type, ")")
    )
  
  # Get all unique campaigns sorted by year and block-irrigation combinations
  campaigns_with_years <- analysis_data %>%
    select(campaign, year) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    arrange(year, campaign)
  
  campaigns <- campaigns_with_years$campaign
  all_block_irrigations <- sort(unique(analysis_data$block_irrigation))
  
  cat("Campaigns found:", length(campaigns), "\n")
  cat("Campaign sequence:", paste(campaigns, collapse = " → "), "\n")
  
  # Get all unique varieties for consistent coloring
  all_varieties <- sort(unique(analysis_data$variety_clean))
  n_varieties <- length(all_varieties)
  cat("Total unique varieties:", n_varieties, "\n")
  
  # Create consistent color palette
  if (n_varieties <= 12) {
    color_palette <- brewer.pal(min(max(n_varieties, 3), 12), "Set3")
  } else if (n_varieties <= 20) {
    color_palette <- c(brewer.pal(12, "Set3"), brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"))
  } else {
    color_palette <- viridis(n_varieties, option = "turbo", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9)
  }
  
  variety_colors <- setNames(color_palette[1:n_varieties], all_varieties)
  
  # Prepare data for all campaigns
  all_campaign_data <- list()
  
  for (campaign_name in campaigns) {
    cat(sprintf("Processing campaign: %s\n", campaign_name))
    
    # Filter data for current campaign
    campaign_data <- analysis_data %>%
      filter(campaign == campaign_name)
    
    if (nrow(campaign_data) == 0) {
      cat(sprintf("No data found for campaign %s, skipping...\n", campaign_name))
      next
    }
    
    # Calculate variety distribution for this campaign
    variety_distribution <- campaign_data %>%
      group_by(block_irrigation, variety_clean) %>%
      summarise(
        variety_surface = sum(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
        variety_plots = n(),
        .groups = 'drop'
      ) %>%
      group_by(block_irrigation) %>%
      mutate(
        total_block_surface = sum(variety_surface),
        variety_percentage = round(100 * variety_surface / total_block_surface, 1)
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      filter(variety_percentage >= 3) %>%
      arrange(block_irrigation, desc(variety_percentage)) %>%
      group_by(block_irrigation) %>%
      mutate(
        cumulative_end = cumsum(variety_percentage),
        cumulative_start = lag(cumulative_end, default = 0),
        label_position = cumulative_start + variety_percentage / 2
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(
        campaign = campaign_name,
        year = convert_campaign_to_year(campaign_name),
        block_irrigation_factor = factor(block_irrigation, levels = all_block_irrigations),
        variety_factor = factor(variety_clean, levels = all_varieties)
      )
    
    all_campaign_data[[campaign_name]] <- variety_distribution
  }
  
  # Combine all campaign data
  combined_data <- do.call(rbind, all_campaign_data)
  
  if (nrow(combined_data) == 0) {
    stop("No data available for animation!")
  }
  
  # Create the base animated plot - EXACTLY matching individual plot format
  cat("\nCreating animated plot with same format as individual plots...\n")
  
  p <- combined_data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = variety_percentage, y = block_irrigation_factor, fill = variety_factor)) +
    geom_col(position = "stack", color = "white", size = 0.3) +  # Same line width as individual plots
    # Add labels for larger segments - EXACT same format
    geom_text(
      data = combined_data %>% filter(variety_percentage >= 8),
      aes(x = label_position, label = paste0(variety_clean, " (", variety_percentage, "%)")),
      size = 3, color = "white", fontface = "bold",  # Same size as individual plots
      hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, angle = 0
    ) +
    # Add labels for medium segments - EXACT same format
    geom_text(
      data = combined_data %>% filter(variety_percentage >= 3 & variety_percentage < 8),
      aes(x = label_position, label = paste0(variety_clean, " ", variety_percentage, "%")),
      size = 2.5, color = "white", fontface = "bold",  # Same size as individual plots
      hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, angle = 0
    ) +
    # Use the SAME scale settings as individual plots
    scale_fill_manual(name = "Variety", values = variety_colors) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Percentage of Block Surface Area (%)", 
      breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), 
      limits = c(0, 100)
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(name = "Block (Irrigation Type)", drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = "Variety Distribution for Campaign {closest_state}",  # Same title format
      subtitle = "Horizontal stacked bars showing variety composition by block • Legend shows only varieties in this campaign",  # Same subtitle
      caption = "Showing varieties with ≥3% of block area • Percentages shown for all segments"  # Same caption
    ) +
    # Use the SAME theme as individual plots (not animated_theme)
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                               margin = margin(b = 15), color = "#2C3E50"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40", 
                                  margin = margin(b = 15), face = "italic"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, color = "gray50", hjust = 1,
                                 margin = margin(t = 10)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 1),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.3),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 15, 15)
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.text = element_text(size = 8)  # Same legend text size
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 6, override.aes = list(size = 0.8))) +  # Same legend format
    # Add gganimate transitions
    transition_states(
      campaign,
      transition_length = 2,  # Smooth transition between states
      state_length = 3        # How long to pause on each state
    ) +
    ease_aes('cubic-in-out')   # Smooth easing
  
  # Render the animation with SAME dimensions as individual plots
  cat("Rendering animation with same format as individual plots (this may take a few minutes)...\n")
  
  anim <- animate(
    p,
    width = 1600, height = 800,  # Same 16:8 ratio as individual plots
    res = 300,                   # Same DPI as individual plots
    fps = 8,                     # Frames per second
    duration = length(campaigns) * 5 / 8,  # Total duration based on campaigns
    renderer = gifski_renderer(
      file = "variety_distribution_animation.gif",
      loop = TRUE
    )
  )
  
  cat(sprintf("Animation saved as: variety_distribution_animation.gif\n"))
  cat(sprintf("Animation details:\n"))
  cat(sprintf("  - Campaigns: %d\n", length(campaigns)))
  cat(sprintf("  - Total varieties: %d\n", n_varieties))
  cat(sprintf("  - Duration: ~%.1f seconds\n", length(campaigns) * 5 / 8))
  cat(sprintf("  - Resolution: 1600x900 at 150 DPI\n"))
  
  # Create a summary frame showing all campaigns
  campaign_summary <- combined_data %>%
    group_by(campaign, year) %>%
    summarise(
      n_varieties = n_distinct(variety_clean),
      n_blocks = n_distinct(block_irrigation),
      total_percentage = sum(variety_percentage, na.rm = TRUE) / n_distinct(block_irrigation),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(year)
  
  cat("\n=== ANIMATION SUMMARY ===\n")
  for (i in 1:nrow(campaign_summary)) {
    info <- campaign_summary[i, ]
    cat(sprintf("Frame %2d - Campaign %s: %d varieties, %d blocks, %.1f%% avg coverage\n", 
                i, info$campaign, info$n_varieties, info$n_blocks, info$total_percentage))
  }
  
  return(list(
    animation = anim,
    data = combined_data,
    campaign_summary = campaign_summary,
    variety_colors = variety_colors
  ))
}

# Create a simpler version for faster rendering (optional)
create_quick_animated_variety_plot <- function(data, quick_mode = TRUE) {
  
  if (quick_mode) {
    cat("Creating QUICK animation with reduced quality for faster rendering...\n")
  }
  
  # Use the same data preparation as above but with different animation settings
  result <- create_animated_variety_plot(data)
  
  if (quick_mode) {
    # Re-render with faster settings
    p_quick <- result$data %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = variety_percentage, y = block_irrigation_factor, fill = variety_factor)) +
      geom_col(position = "stack", color = "white", size = 0.4) +
      geom_text(
        data = result$data %>% filter(variety_percentage >= 10),  # Only larger segments
        aes(x = label_position, label = paste0(variety_clean, "\n", variety_percentage, "%")),
        size = 3, color = "white", fontface = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(name = "Variety", values = result$variety_colors, drop = TRUE) +
      scale_x_continuous(
        name = "Percentage of Block Surface Area (%)", 
        breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), 
        limits = c(0, 100)
      ) +
      scale_y_discrete(name = "Block (Irrigation Type)") +
      labs(
        title = "Variety Distribution: Campaign {closest_state}",
        subtitle = "Quick animated overview",
        caption = "Showing major varieties (≥10%)"
      ) +
      animated_theme +
      guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 4)) +
      transition_states(campaign, transition_length = 1, state_length = 2) +
      ease_aes('linear')
    
    anim_quick <- animate(
      p_quick,
      width = 1200, height = 700,
      res = 100,
      fps = 6,
      duration = length(unique(result$data$campaign)) * 3 / 6,
      renderer = gifski_renderer(
        file = "variety_distribution_animation_quick.gif",
        loop = TRUE
      )
    )
    
    cat("Quick animation saved as: variety_distribution_animation_quick.gif\n")
  }
  
  return(result)
}
```

```{r}
# Animated Variety Distribution Plots using gganimate - Improved Spacing
# Real smooth transitions between campaigns showing variety composition changes
# Required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(gganimate)
library(transformr)  # For smooth transitions

# Enhanced theme for animation with more spacing
animated_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, 
                             margin = margin(b = 20), color = "#2C3E50"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40", 
                                margin = margin(b = 20), face = "italic"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 12, color = "gray50", hjust = 1,
                               margin = margin(t = 20)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 1, margin = margin(r = 15)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 10)),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.margin = margin(t = 25, b = 15),
    legend.box.spacing = unit(15, "pt"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.3),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray85", size = 0.4),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(30, 40, 30, 40),  # Increased margins
    panel.spacing = unit(20, "pt")  # More space between panels if used
  )

# Function to create animated variety distribution
create_animated_variety_plots <- function(data) {
  
  cat("Preparing animated variety distribution plots...\n")
  
  # Convert campaign to numeric year for proper ordering
  convert_campaign_to_year <- function(campaign) {
    campaign_clean <- as.character(campaign)
    start_year <- sapply(strsplit(campaign_clean, "-"), function(x) x[1])
    numeric_years <- as.numeric(start_year)
    full_years <- ifelse(numeric_years <= 49, 2000 + numeric_years, 1900 + numeric_years)
    return(full_years)
  }
  
  # Prepare data with uppercase varieties
  analysis_data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      variety_clean = ifelse(is.na(variety) | variety == "" | variety == "NA", 
                            "UNKNOWN", 
                            toupper(as.character(variety)))
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(surface_area_ha),
      !is.na(campaign),
      !is.na(variety_clean),
      surface_area_ha > 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      year = convert_campaign_to_year(campaign),
      block = as.character(block),
      irrigation_type = as.character(irrigation_type),
      block_irrigation = paste0("Block ", block, " (", irrigation_type, ")")
    )
  
  # Get all unique elements for consistency
  campaigns <- analysis_data %>% 
    arrange(year) %>% 
    pull(campaign) %>% 
    unique()
  
  all_block_irrigations <- sort(unique(analysis_data$block_irrigation))
  all_varieties <- sort(unique(analysis_data$variety_clean))
  n_varieties <- length(all_varieties)
  
  cat("Campaigns (chronological):", paste(campaigns, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Total varieties:", n_varieties, "\n")
  cat("Total block-irrigation combinations:", length(all_block_irrigations), "\n")
  
  # Create consistent color palette
  if (n_varieties <= 12) {
    color_palette <- brewer.pal(min(n_varieties, 12), "Set3")
  } else if (n_varieties <= 20) {
    color_palette <- c(brewer.pal(12, "Set3"), brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"))
  } else {
    color_palette <- viridis(n_varieties, option = "turbo", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9)
  }
  variety_colors <- setNames(color_palette[1:n_varieties], all_varieties)
  
  # Prepare animation data - CRUCIAL: Complete missing combinations
  animation_data <- analysis_data %>%
    group_by(campaign, year, block_irrigation, variety_clean) %>%
    summarise(
      variety_surface = sum(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE),
      variety_plots = n(),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    # Calculate percentages within each campaign-block combination
    group_by(campaign, block_irrigation) %>%
    mutate(
      total_block_surface = sum(variety_surface),
      variety_percentage = 100 * variety_surface / total_block_surface
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    # Complete missing combinations with 0 values for smooth transitions
    complete(
      nesting(campaign, year), 
      block_irrigation = all_block_irrigations,
      variety_clean = all_varieties,
      fill = list(variety_surface = 0, variety_plots = 0, variety_percentage = 0, total_block_surface = 0)
    ) %>%
    # Recalculate total_block_surface after completion
    group_by(campaign, block_irrigation) %>%
    mutate(
      total_block_surface = sum(variety_surface),
      variety_percentage = ifelse(total_block_surface > 0, 
                                 100 * variety_surface / total_block_surface, 
                                 0)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    # Filter out combinations where the block doesn't exist in that campaign
    filter(total_block_surface > 0) %>%
    # Create factors for consistent ordering
    mutate(
      campaign_factor = factor(campaign, levels = campaigns),
      block_irrigation_factor = factor(block_irrigation, levels = all_block_irrigations),
      variety_factor = factor(variety_clean, levels = all_varieties)
    ) %>%
    group_by(variety_clean) %>%
    filter(max(variety_percentage) >= 2) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  cat("Animation data prepared with", nrow(animation_data), "rows\n")
  cat("Campaigns in animation:", length(unique(animation_data$campaign)), "\n")
  cat("Varieties after filtering:", length(unique(animation_data$variety_clean)), "\n")
  
  # Create the animated plot with more spacing
  cat("Creating animated plot...\n")
  
  p_animated <- animation_data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = variety_percentage, y = block_irrigation_factor, fill = variety_factor)) +
    # Increased bar height for more spacing
    geom_col(position = "stack", color = "white", size = 0.5, width = 0.7) +
    # NO TEXT LABELS - removed completely
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "Variety", 
      values = variety_colors,
      guide = guide_legend(
        ncol = 6,  # Reduced columns for better spacing
        override.aes = list(size = 1.5),
        keywidth = unit(1.5, "cm"),
        keyheight = unit(0.8, "cm"),
        title.position = "top",
        title.hjust = 0.5
      )
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Percentage of Block Surface Area (%)", 
      breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),  # More frequent breaks
      limits = c(0, 100),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(
      name = "Block (Irrigation Type)",
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05))  # Add space above/below
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Variety Distribution Evolution: Campaign {closest_state}",
      subtitle = "Animated transitions showing how variety composition changes over time",
      caption = "Showing varieties with ≥2% of block area in at least one campaign • See legend for variety identification"
    ) +
    animated_theme +
    theme(
      # Increase spacing between y-axis labels
      axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 1, margin = margin(r = 20)),
      # More space for legend
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(r = 8)),
      legend.key.spacing.x = unit(12, "pt"),
      legend.key.spacing.y = unit(8, "pt")
    ) +
    # gganimate specific elements
    transition_states(
      campaign_factor,
      transition_length = 2,  # Duration of transition between states
      state_length = 3        # Duration to pause at each state
    ) +
    ease_aes('cubic-in-out')  # Smooth easing function
  
  cat("Rendering animation...\n")
  
  # Render the animation with larger dimensions for more space
  animated_gif <- animate(
    p_animated, 
    width = 1600,   # Increased width
    height = 1000,  # Increased height
    res = 150,
    fps = 10,           # Frames per second
    duration = length(campaigns) * 5,  # Total duration in seconds
    end_pause = 30,     # Pause at end (frames)
    start_pause = 15,   # Pause at start (frames)
    renderer = gifski_renderer("variety_distribution_animated_spacious.gif")
  )
  
  cat("Animation saved as: variety_distribution_animated_spacious.gif\n")
  
  # Also create an MP4 version if possible
  tryCatch({
    cat("Creating MP4 version...\n")
    animated_mp4 <- animate(
      p_animated, 
      width = 1600,
      height = 1000,
      res = 150,
      fps = 10,
      duration = length(campaigns) * 5,
      end_pause = 30,
      start_pause = 15,
      renderer = av_renderer("variety_distribution_animated_spacious.mp4")
    )
    cat("Animation also saved as: variety_distribution_animated_spacious.mp4\n")
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("MP4 creation failed (av package may not be installed):", e$message, "\n")
    cat("GIF version is still available.\n")
  })
  
  return(list(
    animated_plot = p_animated,
    animation_data = animation_data,
    variety_colors = variety_colors,
    campaigns = campaigns
  ))
}

# Alternative: Create side-by-side comparison animation with improved spacing
create_comparison_animation <- function(data) {
  
  cat("Creating side-by-side comparison animation with improved spacing...\n")
  
  # Similar data preparation as above
  convert_campaign_to_year <- function(campaign) {
    campaign_clean <- as.character(campaign)
    start_year <- sapply(strsplit(campaign_clean, "-"), function(x) x[1])
    numeric_years <- as.numeric(start_year)
    full_years <- ifelse(numeric_years <= 49, 2000 + numeric_years, 1900 + numeric_years)
    return(full_years)
  }
  
  analysis_data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      variety_clean = ifelse(is.na(variety) | variety == "" | variety == "NA", 
                            "UNKNOWN", 
                            toupper(as.character(variety))),
      year = convert_campaign_to_year(campaign),
      block = as.character(block),
      irrigation_type = as.character(irrigation_type),
      block_irrigation = paste0("Block ", block, " (", irrigation_type, ")")
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(surface_area_ha),
      !is.na(campaign),
      !is.na(variety_clean),
      surface_area_ha > 0
    )
  
  campaigns <- analysis_data %>% 
    arrange(year) %>% 
    pull(campaign) %>% 
    unique()
  
  # Create pairs of consecutive campaigns for comparison
  campaign_pairs <- data.frame(
    previous = campaigns[-length(campaigns)],
    current = campaigns[-1],
    transition = paste(campaigns[-length(campaigns)], "→", campaigns[-1])
  )
  
  # Prepare comparison data
  comparison_data <- map_dfr(1:nrow(campaign_pairs), function(i) {
    prev_camp <- campaign_pairs$previous[i]
    curr_camp <- campaign_pairs$current[i]
    trans_label <- campaign_pairs$transition[i]
    
    # Get data for both campaigns
    prev_data <- analysis_data %>%
      filter(campaign == prev_camp) %>%
      group_by(block_irrigation, variety_clean) %>%
      summarise(variety_surface = sum(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
      group_by(block_irrigation) %>%
      mutate(
        total_surface = sum(variety_surface),
        percentage = 100 * variety_surface / total_surface,
        campaign_type = "Previous",
        comparison = trans_label
      ) %>%
      filter(percentage >= 5)
    
    curr_data <- analysis_data %>%
      filter(campaign == curr_camp) %>%
      group_by(block_irrigation, variety_clean) %>%
      summarise(variety_surface = sum(surface_area_ha, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
      group_by(block_irrigation) %>%
      mutate(
        total_surface = sum(variety_surface),
        percentage = 100 * variety_surface / total_surface,
        campaign_type = "Current",
        comparison = trans_label
      ) %>%
      filter(percentage >= 5)
    
    bind_rows(prev_data, curr_data)
  })
  
  # Create the comparison animation with better spacing
  p_comparison <- comparison_data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = percentage, y = block_irrigation, fill = variety_clean)) +
    geom_col(position = "stack", color = "white", size = 0.4, width = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~ campaign_type, ncol = 2) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
    labs(
      title = "Campaign Transition: {closest_state}",
      subtitle = "Side-by-side comparison of variety distributions",
      x = "Percentage of Block Surface Area (%)",
      y = "Block (Irrigation Type)",
      fill = "Variety"
    ) +
    animated_theme +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 15, t = 10)),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.spacing.x = unit(30, "pt"),  # More space between facets
      axis.text.y = element_text(hjust = 1, margin = margin(r = 15))
    ) +
    transition_states(
      comparison,
      transition_length = 2,
      state_length = 4
    ) +
    ease_aes('cubic-in-out')
  
  # Render comparison animation with larger dimensions
  comparison_gif <- animate(
    p_comparison,
    width = 1800,   # Increased width
    height = 900,   # Increased height
    res = 150,
    fps = 8,
    duration = nrow(campaign_pairs) * 6,
    renderer = gifski_renderer("variety_comparison_animated_spacious.gif")
  )
  
  cat("Comparison animation saved as: variety_comparison_animated_spacious.gif\n")
  
  return(comparison_gif)
}

cat("=== CREATING IMPROVED SPACIOUS ANIMATED VARIETY DISTRIBUTION PLOTS ===\n\n")

# Check if required packages are installed
required_packages <- c("gganimate", "transformr", "gifski")
missing_packages <- required_packages[!sapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE)]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  cat("Installing required packages:", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  install.packages(missing_packages)
  
  # Load the packages
  sapply(required_packages, library, character.only = TRUE)
}

# Run the main animation
main_results <- create_animated_variety_plots(data)
comparison_results <- create_comparison_animation(data)
```
